d: adj 一致的 always behaving in the same way or having the same attitudes, standards etc – usually used to show approval

es.e: She’s the team’s most consistent player.
es.c: 她是该队中表现最为稳定的选手。

d: n 电池 an object that provides a supply of electricity for something such as a radio, car, or toy

es.e: You have to take the top off to change the batteries .
es.c: 你得把顶盖拿掉才能更换电池。

es.e: When the red light comes on, you should recharge the battery .
es.c: 红灯亮起的时候你就应该给电池充电了。

es.e: The car’s got a flat battery .
es.c: 汽车的蓄电池没电了。

d: adj 能胜任的，有能力的 having enough skill or knowledge to do something to a satisfactory standard

es.e: A competent mechanic should be able to fix the problem.
es.c: 一名合格的机修工应该能够解决这个问题。

d: v 保存，保护 to save something or someone from being harmed or destroyed

es.e: We must encourage the planting of new trees and preserve our existing woodlands.
es.c: 我们必须鼓励栽种新树木，同时也要保护现有的林地。

d: n 拥有 if something is in your possession, you own it, or you have obtained it from somewhere

es.e: That information is not in our possession.
es.c: 那则信息不归我们所有。

es.e: How did the painting come into your possession (= how did you get it ) ?
es.c: 这幅画是怎么到你手上的？

es.e: The finance company now has possession of the house.
es.c: 这家金融公司目前拥有这所房子。

d: adv 近似，接近
n 野火 a fire that moves quickly and cannot be controlled

es.e: ...a wildfire in Montana that's already burned thousands of acres of rich grassland.
es.c: ...已经烧毁几千英亩肥沃草地的蒙大拿州野火。

d: adj 紧密的，紧凑的 packed or put together firmly and closely

es.e: The bushes grew in a compact mass.
es.c: 灌木长成茂密的一片。

d: v 违背，违抗 to refuse to obey a law or rule, or refuse to do what someone in authority tells you to do

es.e: people who openly defy the law
es.c: 公然抗拒法律的人

d: adv 当然 used to say that you completely agree with someone

es.e: ‘They could have told us, couldn't they? ’ ‘Absolutely! ’
es.c: “他们本来可以告诉我们的，不是吗？”“当然！”

d: v 过滤 to remove unwanted substances from water, air etc by passing it through a special substance or piece of equipment

es.e: The water in the tank is constantly filtered.
es.c: 鱼缸里的水在不停地被过滤。

es.e: The ozone layer filters harmful UV rays from the sun.
es.c: 臭氧层过滤掉有害的太阳紫外线。

d: n 服务器 one of the computers on a network that provides a special service

es.e: All data is stored on a central file server.
es.c: 所有数据资料都储存在中央文件服务器里。

d: v 溺爱 to give a child everything they want, or let them do whatever they want, often with the result that they behave badly

es.e: She’s an only child, but they didn’t really spoil her.
es.c: 她是独生女，不过他们也没有娇惯她。

es.e: His mother and sisters spoil him rotten (= spoil him very much ) .
es.c: 他母亲和姐姐把他给宠坏了。

d: v 发出沙沙声 if leaves, papers, clothes etc rustle, or if you rustle them, they make a noise as they rub against each other

es.e: She moved nearer, her long silk skirt rustling around her.
es.c: 她走近了，真丝长裙窸窣作响。

es.e: He rustled the papers on his desk.
es.c: 他把桌上的报纸翻得沙沙响。

d: n 转移；娱乐 a change in the direction or use of something, or the act of changing it

es.e: ...the illegal diversion of profits from secret arms sales.
es.c: …销售秘密武器所得收益的非法转移。

es.e: The party will make a pleasant diversion.
es.c: 晚会会是一个很不错的消遣。

d: n 抱怨，投诉 a statement in which someone complains about something

es.e: If you wish to make a complaint, you should see the manager.
es.c: 如果你要投诉，应该去找经理。

es.e: The sales assistants are trained to deal with customer complaints in a friendly manner.
es.c: 售货员都受过培训，要以友好的态度处理顾客的投诉。

d: v 合并 to combine, or to join things together to form one thing

es.e: The company plans to merge its subsidiaries in the US.
es.c: 该公司计划合并其在美国的几家子公司。

d: adj 无价的，难以用价格衡量的 extremely valuable

es.e: priceless antiques
es.c: 极其贵重的古董

d: adj 荣誉的 an honorary title, rank, or university degree is given to someone as an honour

es.e: Brown received an honorary doctorate from Seoul University.
es.c: 布朗获得了首尔大学的荣誉博士学位。

d: adj 长期的；慢性的 a chronic disease or illness is one that continues for a long time and cannot be cured

es.e: chronic arthritis
es.c: 慢性关节炎

es.e: chronic asthma
es.c: 慢性哮喘

es.e: chronic heart disease
es.c: 慢性心脏病

d: adj 课外的 extracurricular activities are not part of the course that a student is doing at a school or college

es.e: Each child had participated in extracurricular activities at school.
es.c: 每个孩子都参加了学校的课外活动。

d: n 游说 an attempt to persuade a government to change a law, make a new law etc

es.e: a mass lobby of Parliament by women’s organizations
es.c: 妇女团体对议会的集体游说

d: adj 用不完的，无穷无尽的 something that is inexhaustible exists in such large amounts that it can never be finished or used up

es.e: She has an inexhaustible supply of funny stories.
es.c: 她有讲不完的有趣故事。

es.e: a man of inexhaustible energy
es.c: 精力无穷的人

d: adj 不可避免的 certain to happen and impossible to avoid

es.e: A further escalation of the crisis now seems inevitable.
es.c: 危机的进一步升级现在看来已不可避免。

d: n 污染 the action or state of making or being made impure by polluting or poisoning

es.e: radioactive contamination
es.c: 放射性污染

d: v 暂停 to officially stop something from continuing, especially for a short time

es.e: Sales of the drug will be suspended until more tests are completed.
es.c: 这种药品在完成进一步检验之前将暂停销售。

es.e: Talks between the two countries have now been suspended.
es.c: 两国间的对话现已中止。

d: adj 即将来临的 an event that is imminent, especially an unpleasant one, will happen very soon

es.e: A new trade agreement is imminent.
es.c: 一项新的贸易协定即将签署。

d: n 肥胖 when someone is very fat in a way that is unhealthy

es.e: Obesity can increase the risk of heart disease.
es.c: 肥胖会增加患心脏病的危险。

d: v 援助，有助于 to help someone do something

es.e: an index to aid the reader
es.c: 方便读者的索引

d: n 解决，解决方法；溶液 a way of solving a problem or dealing with a difficult situation

es.e: The best solution would be for them to separate.
es.c: 最好的解决方法是他们分开。

es.e: a weak sugar solution
es.c: 淡淡的糖溶液。

d: n 学费 the money you pay for being taught

es.e: When I started college, tuition was 350 a quarter.
es.c: 我开始念大学的时候，学费是每学季350美元。

d: v 尊重 to respect and admire someone or something

es.e: Peden was greatly esteemed by the people of Ayrshire.
es.c: 佩登深受艾尔郡人的尊敬。

es.e: He was esteemed as a literary wit.
es.c: 他被尊为文学才子。

d: n 购买 something you buy, or the act of buying it

es.e: She paid for her purchases and left.
es.c: 她付钱买好东西离开了。

es.e: I enclose my receipt as proof of purchase .
es.c: 我附上小票作为购物凭证。

es.e: She made two purchases from my stall.
es.c: 她从我的货摊上买了两样东西。

d: v 合并 to include something as part of a group, system, plan etc

es.e: The agreement would allow the rebels to be incorporated into a new national police force.
es.c: 该协议将允许叛军并入一支新的国家警察部队。

d: v 流行，普遍 if a belief, custom, situation etc prevails, it exists among a group of people at a certain time

es.e: A similar situation prevails in Canada.
es.c: 同样的情况在加拿大也普遍存在。

d: adj 不合理的，不理性的 not based on clear thought or reason

es.e: an irrational fear of flying
es.c: 对飞行非理性的恐惧

es.e: He’s becoming increasingly irrational.
es.c: 他变得越来越不可理喻了。

d: adj 固有的 a quality that is inherent in something is a natural part of it and cannot be separated from it

es.e: Every business has its own inherent risks.
es.c: 每笔生意本身都有风险。

d: adj 过于激烈的 someone who is overexcited is very excited and not behaving sensibly

es.e: Some of the boys became overexcited.
es.c: 有些男孩变得兴奋过度了。

d: n 偏爱 if you have a preference for something, you like it more than another thing and will choose it if you can

es.e: Do you have a colour preference ?
es.c: 你有什么颜色上的偏好吗？

es.e: Parents may be able to express a preference as to the school their child will attend.
es.c: 家长也许可以表明愿意让孩子就读哪所学校。

es.e: The amount of sugar you add will depend on personal preference .
es.c: 加多少糖取决于个人的喜好。

d: n 演变；发展；进化 the gradual change and development of an idea, situation, or object

es.e: the theory of evolution
es.c: 进化论

es.e: the evolution of the computer
es.c: 计算机的发展

d: adj 异域的，外国的 something that is exotic seems unusual and interesting because it is related to a foreign country – use this to show approval

es.e: exotic birds
es.c: 外国的奇异鸟类

es.e: exotic places
es.c: 有异国风情的地方

d: n 股票经理人 a person or organization whose job is to buy and sell shares, bonds etc for people

es.e: Over the next five months, every one of them discouraged me from becoming a stockbroker.
es.c: 接下来的五个月中，他们每个人都劝阻我不要做股票经纪人。

d: v 误解 to not understand the correct meaning of something that someone says or does, or of facts that you are considering

es.e: Some parts of the report could be misinterpreted.
es.c: 报告的某些部分可能会被误解。

d: n 繁荣 when people have money and everything that is needed for a good life

es.e: a time of economic prosperity
es.c: 经济繁荣时期

d: n 水箱 a large container for storing liquid or gas

es.e: The water tank is leaking.
es.c: 水箱在漏水。

es.e: Somehow the chemical got from a storage tank into water supplies.
es.c: 不知怎么的，这种化学物从储存箱进入了供水系统。

es.e: the plane’s fuel tank
es.c: 飞机的油箱

d: adj 过时的 if something is outdated, it is no longer considered useful or effective, because something more modern exists

es.e: outdated teaching methods
es.c: 不合时宜的教学方法

es.e: a factory with outdated equipment
es.c: 设备陈旧的工厂

es.e: His writing style is now boring and outdated.
es.c: 他的写作风格如今已显得乏味而过时了。

d: v 超过 to be more in number than another group

es.e: Flats outnumber houses in this area.
es.c: 这个地区公寓房比独栋房子多。

es.e: His troops were hopelessly outnumbered.
es.c: 他的军队在数量上远远不及对方。

d: n 督导 someone who supervises a person or activity

es.e: ...a full-time job as a supervisor at a factory.
es.c: …在一家工厂担任监督员的一项全职工作。

d: v 波动 if a price or amount fluctuates, it keeps changing and becoming higher and lower

es.e: Insect populations fluctuate wildly from year to year.
es.c: 昆虫的数量每年变化很大。

d: n 物质 a particular type of solid, liquid, or gas

es.e: The leaves were covered with a strange sticky substance.
es.c: 树叶上覆着一层黏糊糊的怪东西。

d: adj 有利可图的，有利益的 producing a profit or a useful result

es.e: The advertising campaign proved very profitable.
es.c: 事实证明，这次广告宣传活动卓有成效。

es.e: a highly profitable business
es.c: 盈利高的企业

es.e: a profitable afternoon
es.c: 有收获的下午

d: adv 显著地

es.e: Her background is markedly different from her husband's.
es.c: 她的背景和她丈夫的截然不同。

es.e: This year's sales have risen markedly.
es.c: 今年的销售额明显提高了。

d: adj 无效的 something that is ineffective does not achieve what it is intended to achieve

es.e: an ineffective marketing campaign
es.c: 一场毫无成效的营销活动

d: adj 荒凉的 cold and without any pleasant or comfortable features

es.e: a bleak January afternoon
es.c: 一月里一个阴冷的下午

es.e: The landscape was bleak.
es.c: 景色一片凄凉。

d: adj 乐观的 believing that good things will happen in the future

es.e: Andrew took a more optimistic view.
es.c: 安德鲁抱有更为乐观的想法。

d: adj 最终的 the ultimate result of a long process is what happens at the end of it

es.e: The ultimate outcome of the experiment cannot be predicted.
es.c: 试验的最后结果无法预测。

d: n 消耗；消费 the amount of energy, oil, electricity etc that is used

es.e: Vigorous exercise increases oxygen consumption.
es.c: 剧烈运动增加氧的消耗。

es.e: art intended for mass consumption
es.c: 供大众消费的艺术品

d: v 促进；培养 to help a skill, feeling, idea etc develop over a period of time

es.e: The bishop helped foster the sense of a community embracing all classes.
es.c: 主教鼓励一种包容各个阶层的社区精神。

d: n 发票 a piece of paper that you are given which shows that you have paid for something

es.e: Keep your receipt in case you want to bring it back.
es.c: 保留收据以备退货之需。

d: adj 严酷的，严峻的 harsh conditions are difficult to live in and very uncomfortable

es.e: The hostages are being held in harsh conditions.
es.c: 人质被拘押在恶劣环境中。

es.e: a young girl suddenly exposed to the harsh realities of life
es.c: 骤然暴露于残酷现实生活中的小女孩

d: n 不幸；灾祸，灾难 very bad luck, or something that happens to you as a result of bad luck

es.e: It seems the banks always profit from farmers’ misfortunes.
es.c: 银行似乎总是从农民的不幸中获益。

d: n 引文 a line taken from a book, speech etc

es.e: The essay begins with a citation from ‘Hamlet’.
es.c: 这篇文章开头引用了《哈姆雷特》中的一句话。

d: n 强奸 the crime of forcing someone to have sex, especially by using violence

es.e: Police are investigating a series of violent rapes in the town.
es.c: 警察在调查镇上发生的一连串暴力强奸案。

es.e: He was arrested and charged with rape.
es.c: 他被捕并被控强奸。

es.e: He always denied that he was guilty of rape.
es.c: 他一直否认自己犯有强奸罪。

d: adj 生态学的 connected with the way plants, animals, and people are related to each other and to their environment

es.e: an ecological disaster
es.c: 生态灾难

d: v 落后 to move or develop more slowly than others

es.e: Western banks still lag behind financial institutions in most other regions of the country.
es.c: 西部地区的银行仍然落后于这个国家其他大部分地区的金融机构。

d: n 争议 a serious argument about something that involves many people and continues for a long time

es.e: a political controversy
es.c: 政治争议

es.e: the controversy surrounding Skinner’s theories
es.c: 围绕斯金纳的理论的争议

es.e: (= began ) over the use of the chemicals on crops.
es.c: 对庄稼施用化学品的做法引起了争论。

d: n 基石 something that is extremely important because everything else depends on it

es.e: Research is the cornerstone of the profession.
es.c: 研究是该职业的基石。

d: v 建立 to build something such as a building or wall

es.e: an imposing town hall, erected in 1892
es.c: 一座气势宏伟的市政厅，建于1892年

es.e: Police have erected barriers across the main roads into the town.
es.c: 警察在进城的主要道路上设立了路障。

d: adv 早熟地，过早地

es.e: The child was born prematurely.
es.c: 这孩子是早产的。

es.e: Her hair became prematurely white.
es.c: 她的头发过早地苍白了。

d: n 主动性 the ability to make decisions and take action without waiting for someone to tell you what to do

es.e: I wish my son would show more initiative.
es.c: 我希望我的儿子能表现得再主动一些。

es.e: Don’t keep asking me for advice. Use your initiative.
es.c: 别老是要我给你出主意，发挥一下你自己的决断能力吧。

es.e: Lt. Carlos was not obeying orders. He acted on his own initiative (= he was not told what to do ).
es.c: 卡洛斯中尉没有服从命令，而是自作主张。

d: v 稀释，冲淡 to make a liquid weaker by adding water or another liquid

es.e: diluted fruit juice
es.c: 稀释的果汁

d: n 观点 a particular way of thinking about a problem or subject

es.e: Different viewpoints produce different images.
es.c: 角度不同，产生的画面也不同。

d: adj 典型的 having the usual features or qualities of a particular group or thing

es.e: typical British weather
es.c: 典型的英国天气

es.e: This advertisement is a typical example of their marketing strategy.
es.c: 这则广告是他们营销策略的一个典型例子。

d: n 走失[流浪]的动物 an animal that is lost or has no home

es.e: The dog was a stray which had been adopted.
es.c: 这只狗是被收养的流浪狗。

d: n 不平衡 a lack of a fair or correct balance between two things, which results in problems or unfairness

es.e: a hormonal imbalance
es.c: 内分泌失调

d: n 隶属关系，单位团体 the connection or involvement that someone or something has with a political, religious etc organization

es.e: the newspaper’s political affiliations
es.c: 该报纸所属的政治派系

d: n 对等物 Someone's or something's counterpart is another person or thing that has a similar function or position in a different place

es.e: As soon as he heard what was afoot, he telephoned his German and Italian counterparts to protest.
es.c: 他一听到在进行中的事，马上就给德国和意大利相应人员打电话抗议。

d: v 分类 to decide what group something belongs to

es.e: We’d classify Drabble’s novels under ‘Romance’.
es.c: 我们把德拉布尔的小说归类为“言情小说”。

es.e: Families are classified according to the father’s occupation.
es.c: 各个家庭按父亲的职业分类。

d: n 展示；游行 an act of explaining and showing how to do something or how something works

es.e: a cookery demonstration
es.c: 烹饪示范

es.e: Supporters staged a demonstration outside the US embassy.
es.c: 支持者在美国大使馆外举行了示威游行。

es.e: Police opened fire on a peaceful demonstration.
es.c: 警察朝和平示威的人群开了枪。

d: v 比……活的时间长 to remain alive after someone else has died

es.e: She outlived her husband by 20 years.
es.c: 她比她丈夫多活了20年。

d: n 预定 an arrangement which you make so that a place in a hotel, restaurant, plane etc is kept for you at a particular time in the future

es.e: a dinner reservation
es.c: 预订晚餐

es.e: Customers are advised to make seat reservations well in advance.
es.c: 建议顾客提前订座。

d: n 情况，环境 the conditions that affect a situation, action, event etc

es.e: The Soviet Union had been forced by circumstances to sign a pact with Nazi Germany.
es.c: 苏联为形势所迫同纳粹德国签订了一项条约。

es.e: I can’t imagine a circumstance in which I would be willing to steal.
es.c: 我无法想象我在什么情况下会愿意去偷东西。

d: v 革命化 to completely change the way people do something or think about something

es.e: New technology is going to revolutionize everything we do.
es.c: 新科技将彻底改变我们做的每一件事。

es.e: His work revolutionized the treatment of this disease.
es.c: 他的研究成果给这种疾病的治疗带来了革命。

d: v 超过 If one thing outweighs another, the first thing is of greater importance, benefit, or significance than the second thing

es.e: The advantages of this deal largely outweigh the disadvantages.
es.c: 这笔交易的利远大于弊。

d: v 投掷，扔 to throw something somewhere

es.e: Sparks leapt as he cast more wood on the fire.
es.c: 他往火里投进更多的木块，火星四处飞溅。

d: adj 不确定的 feeling doubt about something

es.e: My whole future now seemed uncertain.
es.c: 现在我的前途似乎是个未知数。

d: n 威胁 a statement in which you tell someone that you will cause them harm or trouble if they do not do what you want

es.e: Your threats don’t scare me.
es.c: 你的那些威胁吓不倒我。

es.e: threats made against his wife and children
es.c: 对他妻儿的威胁

es.e: Nichols never carried out his threat to resign.
es.c: 尼科尔斯威胁过要辞职，但从未付诸行动。

d: adj 保守的 not liking changes or new ideas

es.e: a very conservative attitude to education
es.c: 对待教育非常守旧的态度

es.e: conservative views
es.c: 保守的观点

d: v 高估 to think something is better, more important etc than it really is

es.e: He tends to overestimate his own abilities.
es.c: 他往往高估自己的能力。

es.e: The importance of training in health and safety cannot be overestimated (= is extremely important ).
es.c: 对健康和安全方面的培训极为重要。

d: n 纪录片 a film or television or a radio programme that gives detailed information about a particular subject

es.e: ...a TV documentary on homelessness.
es.c: …一部关于无家可归现象的电视记录片。

d: v 减轻，缓解 to reduce someone’s pain or unpleasant feelings

es.e: Drugs helped to relieve the pain.
es.c: 药物有助于舒缓疼痛。

d: adv 不管，不顾 without being affected or influenced by something

es.e: The fields give high and stable yields regardless of climatic circumstances.
es.c: 不管天气条件如何， 这块地总是保持稳产高产。

es.e: The new tax laws were rammed through regardless of the opposition of the majority of the people.
es.c: 不顾大多数人民的反对，新的税法强行通过了。

d: n 暂停，迟疑 a short time during which someone stops speaking or doing something before starting again

es.e: There was a pause while Alice changed the tape.
es.c: 艾丽斯换磁带的时候出现了短暂的停顿。

es.e: After a long pause , she went on.
es.c: 停了好一会儿，她才继续下去。

d: v 发布，推出 to make a new product, book etc available for sale for the first time

es.e: The company hopes to launch the new drug by next October.
es.c: 公司希望于明年10月前推出这种新药。

d: n 公寓 a set of rooms on one floor of a large building, where someone lives

es.e: She lives in a small apartment.
es.c: 她住在一套小公寓里。

d: n 火花 a very small piece of burning material produced by a fire or by hitting or rubbing two hard objects together

es.e: sparks from the fire
es.c: 火里飞出的火星

es.e: The scrape of metal on metal sent up a shower of sparks .
es.c: 金属之间互相摩擦，迸出一串火星。

d: v 消除 to completely get rid of something that is unnecessary or unwanted

es.e: a ruthless dictator who eliminated all his rivals
es.c: 铲除所有异己的残酷独裁者

d: adv 无意地

es.e: They had unintentionally provided wrong information.
es.c: 他们无意中提供了错误的信息。

d: n 反对 strong disagreement with, or protest against, something such as a plan, law, or system

es.e: He is confident in his ability to overcome all opposition with his personal charm.
es.c: 他自信有能力以个人魅力来化解一切反对力量。

es.e: The proposals have aroused the opposition of teachers.
es.c: 这些建议引起了教师们的反对。

es.e: Strong opposition resulted in rejection of the bill.
es.c: 在强烈反对下这项议案遭到否决。

d: adj 极地的 close to or relating to the North Pole or the South Pole

es.e: As our climate warms up, the polar ice caps will begin to melt.
es.c: 随着地球气候逐渐变暖，极地的冰冠将开始融化。

d: adj 必需的，不可缺少的 Something that is an integral part of something is an essential part of that thing

es.e: Vegetables are an integral part of our diet.
es.c: 蔬菜是我们膳食中不可缺少的一部分。

d: v 保护 to protect a person, place, or object by staying near them and watching them

es.e: The Sergeant told Swift to guard the entrance.
es.c: 中士叫斯威夫特守着入口。

es.e: a lioness guarding her cubs
es.c: 守护着幼狮的母狮

d: n 分支，分公司 a local business, shop etc that is part of a larger business etc

es.e: The bank has branches all over the country.
es.c: 这家银行在全国各地都有分行。

es.e: a branch office in Boston
es.c: 在波士顿的分公司

es.e: She now works in our Denver branch.
es.c: 现在她在我们的丹佛分部工作。

d: v 使隶属于 if a group or organization affiliates to or with another larger one, it forms a close connection with it

es.e: The Society is not affiliated with any political party.
es.c: 该社团不隶属任何政党。

d: n 灌溉

es.e: Rivers and lakes provide us with water transport and irrigation.
es.c: 江河湖泽给我们以舟楫和灌溉之利。

es.e: In the United States, by contrast, 41% goes for agriculture, almost all of it for irrigation.
es.c: 与之相比，美国全年41%的水投向了农业，并几乎全都用在了灌溉上。

d: n 炉子 a thing used for heating a room or for cooking, which works by burning wood, coal, oil, or gas

es.e: a wood-burning stove
es.c: 烧木柴的火炉

d: adj 值得纪念的 very good, enjoyable, or unusual, and worth remembering

es.e: We want to make this a truly memorable day for the children.
es.c: 我们想让今天成为孩子们永远难忘的日子。

d: n 消除，淘汰 the removal or destruction of something

es.e: the elimination of lead in petrol
es.c: 除去汽油中的铅

d: n 收入 money that a business or organization receives over a period of time, especially from selling goods or services

es.e: advertising revenue
es.c: 广告收入

es.e: Strikes have cost £20 million in lost revenues .
es.c: 罢工造成的收入损失达到2,000万英镑。

d: adj 决定性的 an action, event etc that is decisive has a big effect on the way that something develops

es.e: Women can play a decisive role in the debate over cloning.
es.c: 对于克隆问题的辩论，女性能起到决定作用。

d: v 取代 to take the place or position of something or someone

es.e: Coal has been displaced by natural gas as a major source of energy.
es.c: 作为一种主要能源，煤的地位已为天然气所取代。

es.e: immigrants who displace US workers in the job market
es.c: 在就业市场上取代美国工人的移民

d: n 违反 an action that breaks a law, agreement, principle etc

es.e: human rights violations
es.c: 违反人权

d: adj 意识形态的 based on strong beliefs or ideas, especially political or economic ideas

es.e: The party is split by ideological differences.
es.c: 意识形态上的差异造成该政党分裂。

d: n 附近 the area around you or around a particular place

es.e: Is there a good Chinese restaurant in the neighborhood?
es.c: 这附近有没有好的中餐馆？

d: n 卡路里 a unit for measuring the amount of energy that food will produce

es.e: A potato has about 90 calories.
es.c: 一个马铃薯大约有90卡路里的热量。

es.e: a calorie-controlled diet
es.c: 控制热量的日常饮食

es.e: I need to burn off a few calories (= lose some weight by exercising ) .
es.c: 我要消耗掉一些卡路里。

d: adj 激烈的 done with a lot of energy and strong feelings, and sometimes violence

es.e: fierce fighting in the city
es.c: 城里的激烈战斗

d: v 提及 to talk or write about something or someone, usually quickly and without saying very much or giving details

es.e: Was my name mentioned at all?
es.c: 我的名字被提到过吗？

es.e: Some of the problems were mentioned in his report.
es.c: 其中的一些问题在他的报告里提到了。

es.e: (= it is important enough to mention ) that they only studied a very small number of cases.
es.c: 必须说明的是他们仅研究了几个个案。

d: v 延伸；延期 to continue for a longer period of time, or to make something last longer

es.e: Management have agreed to extend the deadline.
es.c: 管理层已同意延长最后期限。

d: n 专栏 an article on a particular subject or by a particular writer that appears regularly in a newspaper or magazine

es.e: He writes a weekly column for ‘The Times’.
es.c: 他每周为《泰晤士报》写一篇专栏文章。

d: adj 分析的 using scientific analysis to examine something

es.e: analytical chemistry
es.c: 分析化学

d: n 数字 a number representing an amount, especially an official number

es.e: Government figures underestimate the problem.
es.c: 政府的数据对这一问题反映不足。

es.e: It’s about 30,000 in round figures (= to the nearest 10, 20, 100 etc ).
es.c: 凑个整数大约是三万。

d: v 使害怕 to make someone feel afraid

es.e: Don’t stand so near the edge! You’re frightening me.
es.c: 别站得那么靠边！你要把我吓坏了。

es.e: She was frightened by the anger in his eyes.
es.c: 她被他眼中的怒火吓住了。

es.e: Computers used to frighten me, but not now.
es.c: 电脑过去让我感到害怕，但现在不了。

d: adj 工业化以前的

es.e: ...the transition from preindustrial to industrial society.
es.c: 从未工业化社会到工业化社会的转变

d: v 提供 to supply or provide something

es.e: Will these finds furnish more information on prehistoric man?
es.c: 这些发现是否能提供更多有关史前人类的资料？

d: n 缺乏 a situation in which there is not enough of something

es.e: ...an ever increasing scarcity of water.
es.c: …越来越匮乏的水资源。

d: v 转变 to completely change the appearance, form, or character of something or someone, especially in a way that improves it

es.e: Increased population has transformed the landscape.
es.c: 人口的增加使景观发生了变化。

d: v (mislead过去式)误导 to make someone believe something that is not true by giving them information that is false or not complete

es.e: Don’t be misled by appearances, he’s a good worker.
es.c: 不要被表象迷惑，他工作干得挺不错的。

es.e: Don’t be misled into thinking that scientific research is easy.
es.c: 不要受人误导，以为搞科学研究很容易。

d: v 干涉 to become involved in an argument, fight, or other difficult situation in order to change what happens

es.e: The army will have to intervene to prevent further fighting.
es.c: 军队将不得不干预以阻止进一步的战斗。

d: v 变化 if something varies, it changes depending on the situation

es.e: Quentin’s mood seems to vary according to the weather.
es.c: 昆廷的情绪似乎随天气而变化。

es.e: ‘What do you wear when you go out?’ ‘Well, it varies.’
es.c: “你出门的时候通常穿什么衣服？”“噢，得看情况。"

d: n 官僚主义 a complicated official system that is annoying or confusing because it has a lot of rules, processes etc

es.e: the reduction of unnecessary bureaucracy
es.c: 消除不必要的官僚体制

d: n 招聘者 someone in a company who is involved in recruiting new employees

es.e: A recruiter can give you insider pointers and advice.
es.c: 一个招聘人可以为你提供内行人的观点与建议。

d: n 模式 the regular way in which something happens, develops, or is done

es.e: Weather patterns have changed in recent years.
es.c: 气候模式近年已经发生了变化。

es.e: A general pattern began to emerge .
es.c: 一个总体模式开始显现。

es.e: Their descriptions seemed to follow a set pattern (= always develop in the same way ) .
es.c: 他们的描述似乎依据固定的模式。

d: n 必须，必要性 when something is necessary

es.e: I’m afraid it’s become a matter of economic necessity.
es.c: 恐怕这已成了一个经济需求的问题。

d: v 否认 to say that something is not true, or that you do not believe something

es.e: The government denied the existence of poverty among 16- and 17-year-olds.
es.c: 政府否认十六七岁的青少年当中存在贫困问题。

d: v 漂流 to move slowly on water or in the air

es.e: The rubber raft drifted out to sea.
es.c: 橡皮筏子漂向大海。

d: n 支持 a public statement or action showing that you support sb/sth

es.e: The election victory is a clear endorsement of their policies.
es.c: 竞选成功显然是对他们政策的支持。

d: v 勇敢，敢于做 to be brave enough to do something that is risky or that you are afraid to do – used especially in questions or negative sentences

es.e: He wanted to ask her, but he didn’t dare.
es.c: 他想问她，但又不敢。

es.e: ‘I’ll tell Dad.’ ‘You wouldn’t dare!’
es.c: “我要告诉爸爸。” “谅你也不敢！”

d: n 咨询公司 a company that gives advice on a particular subject

es.e: a management consultancy
es.c: 管理咨询公司

es.e: a consultancy firm
es.c: 咨询公司

d: adj 不断的 happening regularly or all the time

es.e: There was a constant stream of visitors to the house.
es.c: 参观这幢房子的游客川流不息。

es.e: Amy lived in constant fear of being attacked.
es.c: 埃米一直生活在害怕遭到袭击的恐惧之中。

es.e: He kept in constant contact with his family while he was in Australia.
es.c: 他在澳大利亚时一直和家人保持着联系。

d: v 存放 to put something down in a particular place；n 存款 a part of the cost of something you are buying that you pay some time before you pay the rest of it

es.e: The female deposits her eggs directly into the water.
es.c: 雌性把卵直接产在水中。

es.e: I’d like to make a deposit (= pay some money ) into my savings account.
es.c: 我想存一笔钱到我的储蓄账户里。

d: v 传播，传导 to send out electronic signals, messages etc using radio, television, or other similar equipment

es.e: The US Open will be transmitted live via satellite.
es.c: 美国公开赛将通过卫星现场直播。

es.e: The system transmits information over digital phone lines.
es.c: 这一系统通过数字电话线路传输信息。

d: v 削弱 to gradually make someone or something less strong or effective

es.e: economic policies that threaten to undermine the health care system
es.c: 可能会损害医疗保健制度的经济政策

d: v 辞职 to officially announce that you have decided to leave your job or an organization

es.e: A hospital administrator has resigned over claims he lied to get the job.
es.c: 一位医院主管因为有人声称他的职位是骗来的而辞职了。

d: adj 各自的 used before a plural noun to refer to the different things that belong to each separate person or thing mentioned

es.e: We all went back to our respective homes to wait for news.
es.c: 我们都各自回家等待消息。

es.e: the respective roles of teachers and students
es.c: 教师和学生各自不同的角色

d: n 同意 agreement about something

es.e: The chairman was elected by common consent (= with most people agreeing ) .
es.c: 主席是大家一致推选出来的。

es.e: divorce by mutual consent
es.c: 双方均同意的离婚

d: n 团聚 a social meeting of people who have not met for a long time, especially people who were at school or college together

es.e: an annual reunion
es.c: 一年一度的聚会

es.e: a family reunion
es.c: 家庭聚会

es.e: a high-school reunion
es.c: 高中同学联谊聚会

d: n 〔尤指每年缴付的〕保险费 the cost of insurance, especially the amount that you pay each year

es.e: It is too early to say whether insurance premiums will be affected.
es.c: 保险费会不会受到影响现在判定还为时过早。

d: n 解释，理解 the way in which someone explains or understands an event, information, someone’s actions etc

es.e: One possible interpretation is that they want you to resign.
es.c: 一种可能的解释是，他们想要你辞职。

es.e: It’s difficult to put an accurate interpretation on (= explain ) the survey results.
es.c: 对调查结果难以作出确切的解释。

es.e: What exactly the author meant by that statement is open to interpretation (= able to be understood or explained in different ways ).
es.c: 作者这句话的确切含义可有各种理解。

d: adj 具体的 definite and specific

es.e: What does that mean in concrete terms ?
es.c: 具体来说那到底是什么意思？

es.e: the lack of any concrete evidence
es.c: 缺少具体证据的

es.e: a dialogue about concrete issues and problems
es.c: 有关具体事情和问题的对话

d: n 设施 Facilities are buildings, pieces of equipment, or services that are provided for a particular purpose

es.e: What recreational facilities are now available?
es.c: 什么娱乐设施现在是可用的？

d: v 转换，改变 to change something into a different form, or to change something so that it can be used for a different purpose or in a different way

es.e: a 19th-century converted barn
es.c: 由19世纪谷仓改建的房子

d: v 促使 to make someone decide to do something

es.e: Japan's recession has prompted consumers to cut back on buying cars.
es.c: 日本的经济衰退已促使消费者们削减购车花销。

d: v 织布，编织 to make cloth, a carpet, a basket etc by crossing threads or thin pieces under and over each other by hand or on a loom

es.e: hand-woven scarves
es.c: 手织围巾

es.e: Only a few of the women still weave.
es.c: 只有数量很少的妇女还在编织。

es.e: traditional basket weaving
es.c: 传统的编篮技术

d: n 一致 in a way that obeys rules, customs etc

es.e: We must act in conformity with local regulations.
es.c: 我们必须按当地的法规行事。

d: n 不作为 If you refer to someone's inaction, you disapprove of the fact that they are doing nothing

es.e: He is bitter about the inaction of the other political parties.
es.c: 他为其他政党的不作为感到愤愤不平。

d: v 修剪 to make something look neater by cutting small pieces off it

es.e: Pete was trimming the lawn around the roses.
es.c: 皮特在修剪玫瑰丛周围的草坪。

es.e: I have my hair trimmed every six weeks.
es.c: 我每六周剪一次头发。

d: n 讽刺 a subtle form of humour that involves saying things that are the opposite of what you really mean

es.e: His tone was tinged with irony.
es.c: 他的语气中微含讽刺。

d: v 垄断 to have complete control over something so that other people cannot share it or take part in it

es.e: The company has monopolized the soft drinks market.
es.c: 该公司垄断了软饮料市场。

es.e: He monopolized the conversation all evening.
es.c: 整个晚上都是他一个人在说话。

d: n 工作量 the amount of work that a person or organization has to do

es.e: She’s struggling to cope with the heavy workload .
es.c: 她在努力应付繁重的工作量。

d: adj 复杂的 made of many different things or parts that are connected; difficult to understand

es.e: a complicated voting system
es.c: 复杂的选举制度

es.e: For young children, getting dressed is a complicated business.
es.c: 对幼童来说，穿衣服是件复杂的事。

d: n 财产 the thing or things that someone owns

es.e: The hotel is not responsible for any loss or damage to guests’ personal property .
es.c: 宾馆对住客个人财物的丢失和损坏概不负责。

es.e: Some of the stolen property was found in Mason’s house.
es.c: 在梅森家里找到了部分被盗财物。

d: adj 未被充分代表的 insufficiently represented or spoken on behalf of

es.e: “While that percentage has increased from 9.5 percent in 1986, it is clear that women are still underrepresented in this realm of academia,” AAUW said in a press release.
es.c: 美国高校妇女联合会在一份新闻简报中表示："尽管这一比例高于1986年时的9.5%，但女性在学术界的这一领域显然没有得到充分的代表。

d: n 哲学 the study of the nature and meaning of existence, truth, good and evil, etc

es.e: Emma studies philosophy at university.
es.c: 埃玛在大学攻读哲学。

d: n 制度，管理体制 a particular system - used especially when talking about a previous system, or one that has just been introduced

es.e: Under the new regime, all sheep and cattle will be regularly tested for disease.
es.c: 根据新制度，所有牛羊都要定期接受疾病检测。

d: adj 古怪的；奇怪的 very unusual or strange

es.e: a bizarre coincidence
es.c: 奇怪的巧合

es.e: dancers in rather bizarre costumes
es.c: 身着奇装异服的舞者

d: v 毁坏 to spoil or destroy something completely

es.e: This illness has ruined my life.
es.c: 这个病毁掉了我的生活。

es.e: His career would be ruined.
es.c: 他的事业将被毁掉。

es.e: All this mud’s going to ruin my shoes.
es.c: 这泥巴会把我的鞋弄坏。

d: v 鼓励 to encourage someone by making them feel confident and eager to do something

es.e: We need someone who can inspire the team.
es.c: 我们需要一个能鼓舞团队士气的人。

es.e: Inspired by the sunny weather, I decided to explore the woods.
es.c: 阳光明媚的天气令人振奋，我决定到森林里寻幽探胜。

d: n 砍伐森林 the cutting or burning down of all the trees in an area

es.e: the deforestation of the tropics
es.c: 热带森林的毁坏

d: adj 例外的 Exceptional situations and incidents are unusual and only likely to happen infrequently

es.e: A review panel concluded that there were no exceptional circumstances that would warrant a lesser penalty for him.
es.c: 一个评估小组作出结论：没有什么例外情况可使他获得从轻惩罚。

d: n 危险 something that may be dangerous, or cause accidents or problems

es.e: That pile of rubbish is a fire hazard (= something that is likely to cause a fire ).
es.c: 那堆垃圾是火灾隐患。

d: v 升级 to make a computer, machine, or piece of software better and able to do more things

es.e: Helicopters have been upgraded and modernized.
es.c: 直升机已经升级并且装上现代化设备。

d: adv 不正常地

es.e: abnormally high blood pressure
es.c: 异常高的血压

d: adv 偶然地，意外地 in a way that was not planned or intended deliberately

es.e: She accidentally erased the tape.
es.c: 她意外地抹去了录了音的磁带。

d: n 边境 the border of a country

es.e: Lille is close to the frontier between France and Belgium.
es.c: 里尔靠近法比边境。

d: adj 相当多的 fairly large, especially large enough to have an effect or be important

es.e: Michael has already spent considerable time in Barcelona.
es.c: 迈克尔在巴塞罗那已经待了相当长的时间了。

es.e: issues of considerable importance
es.c: 相当重要的问题

es.e: The series has aroused considerable interest.
es.c: 这套系列节目引起了观众相当浓厚的兴趣。

d: v 合法化 If something is legalized, a law is passed that makes it legal

es.e: Divorce was legalized in 1981.
es.c: 离婚在1981年被合法化了。

d: adj 可有可无的 not necessary or important and so easy to get rid of

es.e: Part-time workers are considered dispensable.
es.c: 兼职工作人员被认为是可有可无的。

d: v 保证，证明 to state that something is correct or true, especially after some kind of test

es.e: The accounts were certified by an auditor.
es.c: 这些账目经审计员核实过。

d: n 保险公司；承保人 a person or company that provides insurance

es.e: The insurer will also have to pay the additional costs of the trial.
es.c: 保险公司将不得不支付审判的额外费用。

d: v 夸张 to talk about something in a way that makes it seem more important, serious etc than it really is

es.e: To say that all motorists speed in residential areas is overstating the case.
es.c: 说所有驾驶员都在住宅区内超速行驶是言过其实了。

es.e: The importance of a child’s early years cannot be overstated (= is very important ).
es.c: 儿童幼年期的重要性怎么强调也不为过。

d: adj 深刻的；博学的 having a strong influence or effect

es.e: Tolstoy’s experiences of war had a profound effect on his work
es.c: 托尔斯泰的战争经历深刻影响了他的作品。

es.e: Jenner is a profound thinker.
es.c: 詹纳是个思想深刻的人

d: n 痛苦 very severe pain

es.e: the agony of arthritis
es.c: 关节炎的剧烈疼痛

d: n 手艺 a job or activity in which you make things with your hands, and that you usually need skill to do；v 精巧地制作 to make something using a special skill, especially with your hands

es.e: traditional rural crafts
es.c: 传统的乡村手工艺

es.e: arts and crafts
es.c: 手工艺

es.e: Each doll is crafted individually by specialists.
es.c: 每个布娃娃都由专业人员手工制作

d: n 默默无闻 the state of not being known or remembered

es.e: The group produced two albums before disappearing into obscurity.
es.c: 这个团体发行两张专辑后就淡出乐坛。

es.e: O’Brien died in obscurity.
es.c: 奥布莱恩默默无闻地死去。

es.e: She rose from obscurity to stardom.
es.c: 她从无名之辈一跃成为明星。

d: v 保证 to promise to do something or to promise that something will happen

es.e: The law guarantees equal rights for men and women.
es.c: 法律保障男女平等。

es.e: I guarantee you’ll love this film.
es.c: 我保证你会喜欢这部电影。

d: n 海豚 a very intelligent sea animal like a fish with a long grey pointed nose

es.e: a school of dolphins
es.c: 一群海豚

d: n 严重性 the quality or condition of being severe

es.e: A prison sentence should match the severity of the crime.
es.c: 刑期长短要和罪行轻重一致。

es.e: The chances of a full recovery will depend on the severity of her injuries.
es.c: 能否彻底康复取决于她受伤的严重程度。

es.e: the severity of the problem
es.c: 问题的严重性

d: v 阻止；使气馁 to make something less likely to happen

es.e: Aspirin may discourage tumour growth in some types of cancer.
es.c: 阿司匹林可能遏制某些恶性肿瘤的生长。

es.e: You should not let one failure discourage you.
es.c: 你不该失败一次就灰心丧气

d: n 过失 if something bad that has happened is your fault, you should be blamed for it, because you made a mistake or failed to do something

es.e: I’m really sorry - it’s all my fault.
es.c: 我真的很抱歉——都是我的错。

es.e: I didn’t sleep well that night, but it was my own fault .
es.c: 那天晚上我没有睡好，但这是我自己的问题。

d: n 抢劫 the crime of stealing money or things from a bank, shop etc, especially using violence

es.e: Police are investigating a series of bank robberies in South Wales.
es.c: 警方正在调查发生在南威尔士的连环银行抢劫案。

es.e: He received a 10 year prison sentence for armed robbery (= robbery using a gun ) .
es.c: 他因持枪抢劫被判十年监禁。

es.e: He admitted attempted robbery and was given a suspended sentence.
es.c: 他承认企图行劫，被判了缓刑。

d: adj 无生命的 not living

es.e: an inanimate object
es.c: 无生命的物体

d: n 计算 the act or process of using numbers to find out an amount

es.e: Cathy did a rough calculation.
es.c: 凯茜作了一个粗略的计算。

es.e: By my calculation(s), we made a profit of £20 000 last year.
es.c: 我算了一下，我们去年赢利2万英镑。

es.e: Our guess was confirmed by calculation.
es.c: 我们的猜测通过计算得到证实。

d: v 使迷惑，困惑 if something baffles you, you cannot understand or explain it at all

es.e: The question baffled me completely.
es.c: 这个问题把我彻底难倒了。

d: v 多收钱 to charge someone too much money for something

es.e: They were being overcharged for cheap beer.
es.c: 他们买的是便宜的啤酒，却被收取了高价。

d: n 小睡 a short sleep, especially during the day

es.e: an afternoon nap
es.c: 午睡

d: n 处理；支配 when you get rid of something

es.e: bomb disposal experts
es.c: 拆弹专家

es.e: Tanner had a lot of cash at his disposal .
es.c: 坦纳手头有很多现金可以动用。

d: n 当局 The authorities are the people who have the power to make decisions and to make sure that laws are obeyed

es.e: This provided a pretext for the authorities to cancel the elections.
es.c: 这给当局提供了一个取消选举的借口。

d: v 记录 to describe events in the order in which they happened

es.e: His life is chronicled in a new biography published last week.
es.c: 他的生平被写成一本新传记，于上周出版。

es.e: The book chronicles the events leading up to the war.
es.c: 该书记述了导致战争爆发的一系列事件。

d: v 为…遮阳[挡光]，遮蔽〔光线〕 to protect something from direct light

es.e: Shading her eyes, Anita scanned the horizon.
es.c: 安妮塔手搭凉棚，眺望地平线。

d: n 里程碑 a very important event in the development of something

es.e: He said the launch of the party represented a milestone in Zambian history.
es.c: 他说该党的成立代表着赞比亚历史上的一个里程碑。

d: adj 不稳定的 likely to change sud­denly and become worse

es.e: The political situation is still very unstable.
es.c: 政局依然非常动荡。

es.e: an unstable relationship
es.c: 不稳定的关系

d: n 压力 worry that is caused by having to deal with a problem or work too hard over a long period of time

es.e: I couldn’t look after him any more; the strain was too much for me.
es.c: 我不能再照看他了，压力太大。

d: adj 市政府的 relating to or belonging to the government of a town or city

es.e: the municipal waste dump
es.c: 城市垃圾场

es.e: municipal elections
es.c: 市级选举

d: adv 意识形态上地 In a way that relates to ideas or an ideology, especially of a political or economic nature.

es.e: ideologically correct
es.c: 意识上正确

d: adj 贪婪的 always wanting more food, money, power, possessions etc than you need

es.e: a greedy and selfish society
es.c: 一个贪婪自私的社会

es.e: He looked at the gold with greedy eyes.
es.c: 他贪婪地看着这些金子。

es.e: Have you eaten them all, you greedy pig?
es.c: 你把那些全吃了？你这贪吃的猪！

d: adj 强健的 a robust person is strong and healthy

es.e: a robust man of six feet four
es.c: 一个身高六英尺四英寸的壮汉

d: v 诊断 to find out what illness someone has, or what the cause of a fault is, after doing tests, examinations etc

es.e: Joe struggled in school before he was diagnosed as dyslexic.
es.c: 乔在学校里学习很吃力，后来被诊断出患有诵读困难症。

es.e: The illness was diagnosed as mumps.
es.c: 这病经诊断是流行性腮腺炎。

es.e: She was diagnosed with breast cancer.
es.c: 她被诊断出患有乳腺癌。

d: adj 一定的，确切的 clearly known, seen, or stated

es.e: It’s impossible for me to give you a definite answer.
es.c: 我不可能给你明确的答复。

es.e: We need to record sufficient data to enable definite conclusions to be reached.
es.c: 我们需要记录足够的数据，才能得出明确的结论。

es.e: He’d shown definite signs of resigning himself to the situation.
es.c: 他明显表现出安于这种状况的样子。

d: adj 保留意见的；矜持的 Someone who is reserved keeps their feelings hidden

es.e: He was unemotional, quiet, and reserved.
es.c: 他不动感情、安静而矜持。

d: n 喜爱 a feeling of liking or love and caring

es.e: She looked back on those days with affection .
es.c: 她深情地回顾那些日子。

es.e: Their father never showed them much affection .
es.c: 他们的父亲对他们从来没有表现出多少慈爱。

es.e: The church was held in great affection (=  loved and cared about a lot  ) by the local residents.
es.c: 教会深受当地民众爱戴。

d: n 材料 a solid substance such as wood, plastic, or metal

es.e: materials like wood or stone
es.c: 木材或石头之类的材料

es.e: harmful radioactive material
es.c: 有害的放射性材料

es.e: recycled material
es.c: 再生材料

d: v 进行，实行 to carry out a particular activity or process, especially in order to get information or prove facts

es.e: The memorial service was conducted by the Rev. David Prior.
es.c: 这次追悼仪式由戴维·普赖尔牧师主持。

d: n 联系 a relationship with a particular person, organization, group etc

es.e: his close association with the Green Party
es.c: 他与绿党的密切关系

d: v 撞击，碰撞 to hit something or someone that is moving in a different direction from you

es.e: A car and a van collided on the motorway.
es.c: 一辆汽车和一辆小型货车在高速公路上相撞了。

es.e: Two trains collided head-on (= when they were moving directly towards each other ) .
es.c: 两辆火车迎头相撞。

d: adj 勤奋的 someone who is industrious works hard

es.e: She was an industrious and willing worker.
es.c: 她是个勤劳肯干的工人。

d: v 使着迷 If something fascinates you, it interests and delights you so much that your thoughts tend to concentrate on it

es.e: Politics fascinated Franklin's father.
es.c: 政治让富兰克林的父亲着迷。

d: n 流行，普遍

es.e: However, no study on the prevalence of infertility has been conducted in this area.
es.c: 但是，在这个地区不曾进行过任何关于不孕症流行情况的研究。

d: v 施加 to use your power, influence etc in order to make something happen

es.e: They exerted considerable influence within the school.
es.c: 他们在校内施加了很大的影响力。

es.e: Environmental groups are exerting pressure on the government to tighten pollution laws.
es.c: 环境保护组织在向政府施加压力，要求从严执行环保法律法规。

d: adj 次要的，小的 small and not very important or serious, especially when compared with other things

es.e: We have made some minor changes to the program.
es.c: 我们对那个程序做了一些小改动。

es.e: a relatively minor error
es.c: 相对较小的错误

es.e: a minor road
es.c: 小路

d: adj 吸引人的 something that is tempting seems very good and you would like to have it or do it

es.e: a tempting job offer
es.c: 一个诱人的工作机会

es.e: That pie looks tempting.
es.c: 那馅饼看上去很诱人。

d: n 挪用 the act of taking control of something without asking permission

es.e: Other charges include fraud and illegal appropriation of land.
es.c: 其他指控包括诈骗和非法占用土地。

d: n 不公正 a situation in which people are treated very unfairly and not given their rights

es.e: The movie deals with injustices suffered by Native Americans.
es.c: 这部电影讲述印第安人受到的不公正待遇。

es.e: He had developed a deep sense of social injustice.
es.c: 他深深感到社会的不公。

d: adj 无关的 not useful or not relating to a particular situation, and therefore not important

es.e: We’re focussing too much on irrelevant details.
es.c: 我们过于关注不相干的细节。

es.e: Students viewed Latin as boring and irrelevant.
es.c: 学生认为拉丁语无聊且无关紧要。

d: n 注册，登记 the act of recording names and details on an official list

es.e: Student registration (= for a course of study ) starts the first week in September.
es.c: 学生注册在9月份的第一个星期开始。

es.e: The registration fee is $75.
es.c: 注册费是75美元。

d: n 民主 a situation or system in which everyone is equal and has the right to vote, make decisions etc

es.e: democracy within the trade unions
es.c: 工会内部的民主

d: adj 感激的 feeling that you want to thank someone because of something kind that they have done, or showing this feeling

es.e: Our grateful thanks go to all who participated.
es.c: 我们衷心感谢所有参与者。

es.e: She gave me a grateful look.
es.c: 她感激地看了我一眼。

d: n 冒犯 when you offend or upset someone by something you do or say

es.e: His words gave great offense to everybody present.
es.c: 他的发言冲犯了在场的所有人。

es.e: The problem was how to say ‘no’ to her without causing offense.
es.c: 问题是怎样拒绝她而又不得罪她。

d: n 气氛；大气（层） the feeling that an event or place gives you

es.e: The hotel had a lovely relaxed atmosphere .
es.c: 那家宾馆的气氛轻松愉快。

es.e: The atmosphere at home was rather tense.
es.c: 家里的气氛很紧张。

es.e: The shuttle Columbia will re-enter Earth's atmosphere tomorrow morning.
es.c: 哥伦比亚号航天飞机将在明天上午重进地球大气层。

d: n 方法 a method of doing something or dealing with a problem

es.e: He decided to adopt a different approach and teach the Bible through story-telling.
es.c: 他决定采用一种不同的方法，通过讲故事来教授《圣经》。

es.e: This book takes an unorthodox approach to art criticism.
es.c: 这本书采用的是非传统的艺术评论方法。

es.e: organizations which take a positive approach to creative thinking
es.c: 对创造性思维采取积极态度的组织

d: n 对手 a person, group, or organization that you compete with in sport, business, a fight etc

es.e: This gives the company a competitive advantage over its rivals.
es.c: 这使该公司与其对手相比具有一项竞争优势。

es.e: He finished 39 seconds ahead of his main rival .
es.c: 他比主要对手早39秒到达终点。

es.e: She was 2 minutes faster than her nearest rival .
es.c: 她比紧随其后的对手快两分钟。

d: n 承诺 a promise to do something or to behave in a particular way

es.e: Are you ready to make a long-term commitment ?
es.c: 你是否准备好作出长久的承诺？

d: adj 生气的；激烈的 very angry

es.e: She was absolutely furious .
es.c: 她怒不可遏。

es.e: There was a furious row over the proposals.
es.c: 关于这些提议的争论非常激烈。

d: adj 精确的 measured or calculated correctly

es.e: It is difficult to get accurate figures on population numbers.
es.c: 很难取得精确的人口统计数字。

d: adj 抽象的 based on general ideas or principles rather than specific examples or real events

es.e: By the age of seven, children are capable of thinking in abstract terms .
es.c: 儿童到了七岁就具有抽象思维的能力。

es.e: Human beings are the only creatures capable of abstract thought (=  thinking about ideas  ) .
es.c: 人类是唯一具有抽象思维能力的动物。

d: n 剥夺，匮乏 the lack of something that you need in order to be healthy, comfortable, or happy

es.e: Sleep deprivation can result in mental disorders.
es.c: 缺乏睡眠会引起精神紊乱。

d: v 指定，委派 to choose someone or something for a particular job or purpose

es.e: Some of the rooms were designated as offices.
es.c: 其中一些房间是被指定用作办公室的。

d: n 海龟 a  reptile  that lives mainly in water and has a soft body covered by a hard shell

es.e: ...a pet turtle.
es.c: …一只宠物龟。

d: n 专业知识 Expertise is special skill or knowledge that is acquired by training, study, or practice

es.e: She was not an accountant and didn't have the expertise to verify all of the financial details.
es.c: 她不是会计，不具有核查所有这些财政细目的专业知识。

d: n 血管 a vein in your body

es.e: a burst blood vessel
es.c: 破裂的血管

d: v 使通风 to let fresh air into a room, building etc

es.e: Ventilate the room properly when stripping paint.
es.c: 在刮漆的时候要适当地使房间通风。

d: n 权衡，交易 a situation where you make a compromise between two things, or where you exchange all or part of one thing for another

es.e: The newspaper's headline indicates that there was a trade-off at the summit.
es.c: 报纸的大字标题表明峰会上大家作出了妥协。

es.e: the trade-off between inflation and unemployment
es.c: 在通货膨胀与失业之间求得平衡

d: adj 无限的，没完没了的 very large in amount, size, or number

es.e: an endless stream of visitors
es.c: 川流不息的游客

es.e: The possibilities are endless.
es.c: 有无限的可能性。

es.e: He’s been in a lot of trouble – drugs, guns, blackmail – the list is endless.
es.c: 他麻烦太多了——毒品、枪支、敲诈——说都说不完。

d: n 诱惑 a strong desire to have or do something even though you know you should not

es.e: Resist the temptation to buy the item until you’re certain you need it.
es.c: 要抵挡住购买的诱惑，除非你确有需要。

es.e: I finally gave in to the temptation and had a cigarette.
es.c: 我最终还是屈从诱惑，抽了一支烟。

d: n 立法 the act or process of making a law or laws

es.e: ...a letter calling for legislation to protect women's rights.
es.c: …呼吁立法保护妇女权利的一封信。

d: n 复制品 one of two or more things that are the same in every detail

es.e: Is this a duplicate or the original?
es.c: 这是副本还是正本？

d: n 骗局，诡计 something you do in order to deceive someone

es.e: Pretending he doesn’t remember is an old trick of his.
es.c: 假装不记得是他的老花招了。

es.e: He didn’t really lose his wallet - that’s just a trick.
es.c: 他并没有真的丢了钱包——这只是一个骗局。

d: n 评价 a judgment about how good, useful, or successful something is

es.e: We need to carry out a proper evaluation of the new system.
es.c: 我们要对新系统进行合理的评估。

es.e: They took some samples of products for evaluation.
es.c: 他们抽取了一些产品样本以作评估。

d: n 放弃 The abandonment of a place, thing, or person is the act of leaving it permanently or for a long time, especially when you should not do so

es.e: ...memories of her father's complete abandonment of her.
es.c: …她父亲对她的彻底抛弃的那些记忆。

d: adj 动荡的，骚乱的 a turbulent situation or period of time is one in which there are a lot of sudden changes

es.e: the turbulent times of the French Revolution
es.c: 法国大革命的动荡时期

es.e: He has had a turbulent political career.
es.c: 他的政治生涯动荡不定。

d: v 开除，驱逐 to officially force someone to leave a school or organization

es.e: More than five-thousand high school students have been expelled for cheating.
es.c: 五千多名中学生因考试作弊而被开除。

d: n 木匠 someone whose job is making and repairing wooden objects

es.e: He is a carpenter by profession.
es.c: 他以木工为业。

es.e: At an early age, I was apprenticed to a carpenter.
es.c: 我小时候曾给木匠当过学徒。

es.e: That carpenter wanted to become a lawyer， but he was advised to stick to his last.
es.c: 那个木匠想当律师， 但别人劝他安分守己地干他自己的老本行。

d: adj 匆忙的 done in a hurry, especially with bad results

es.e: He soon regretted his hasty decision.
es.c: 他很快就对自己仓促作出的决定感到后悔了。

es.e: a hasty breakfast
es.c: 匆忙吃下的一顿早餐

d: adj 史无前例的 If something is unprecedented, it has never happened before

es.e: Such a move is rare, but not unprecedented.
es.c: 这样的举动少见，但并非从来没有过。

d: adj 极端的 very unusual and severe or serious

es.e: Force is only justified in extreme circumstances.
es.c: 只有在极端情况下才可以使用武力。

es.e: an extreme case of cruelty
es.c: 极严重的虐待案例

es.e: extreme weather/conditions etc
es.c: 极端的天气/条件等

d: v 胜过 to be more successful than someone or something else

es.e: Stocks generally outperform other investments.
es.c: 股票总体上要优于其他投资。

d: v 现代化 to make something such as a system or building more modern

es.e: They need more funds to modernize the country’s telephone system.
es.c: 他们需要更多的资金将本国的电话系统现代化。

es.e: a tastefully modernized old farmhouse
es.c: 雅致而现代化的旧农舍

d: adj 〔人与计算机程序、电视系统等〕交互的，互动的；合作的；相互交流的 an interactive computer program, television system etc allows you to communicate directly with it, and does things in reaction to your actions

es.e: interactive computer systems
es.c: 交互式电脑系统

es.e: the museum’s interactive exhibits
es.c: 博物馆的互动展品

es.e: interactive teaching methods such as role playing
es.c: 诸如角色扮演等的互动教学法

d: adv 接连着地，继续地 immediately one after another.

es.e: Our team turned the tables in the last five minutes by scoring two goals successively.
es.c: 我队在最后五分钟内连进两球，反败为胜。

d: n 创新，革新；新观念；新方法；新发明 the introduction of new ideas or methods

es.e: We must encourage innovation if the company is to remain competitive.
es.c: 公司要想保持竞争力，就必须鼓励革新。

es.e: recent innovations in English teaching
es.c: 英语教学的新创举

d: adv 复杂地，精心设计地 in a detailed and carefully arranged manner.

es.e: He elaborately devised a new computer.
es.c: 他精心设计了一台新电脑。

d: n 素食主义者 someone who does not eat meat or fish

es.e: Our youngest daughter is a vegetarian.
es.c: 我们的小女儿是个素食主义者。

es.e: dishes suitable for vegetarians
es.c: 适合素食者的菜肴

es.e: I’m thinking about becoming a vegetarian.
es.c: 我在考虑戒除荤食。

d: n 〔大学的〕全体教员 all the teachers in a university

es.e: Both faculty and students oppose the measures.
es.c: 教师和学生都反对这些措施。

d: v 给予 to give something to someone or do something, because it is your duty or because someone expects you to

es.e: an obligation to render assistance to those in need
es.c: 为有困难的人提供援助的义务

es.e: a bill of $3,200 for services rendered
es.c: 一张3,200美元服务费的账单

d: v 描述 to describe or show someone or something in a particular way, according to your opinion of them

es.e: Romantic artists portrayed nature as wild and powerful.
es.c: 浪漫主义艺术家描绘的大自然是狂野而强大的。

es.e: The President likes to portray himself as a friend of working people.
es.c: 总统喜欢以工薪阶层的朋友自居。

d: n 想法，观点 an idea, belief, or opinion

es.e: She had no notion what he meant.
es.c: 她根本不明白他是什么意思。

d: adj 热带的 coming from or existing in the hottest parts of the world

es.e: the tropical rain forests
es.c: 热带雨林

es.e: tropical fruit
es.c: 热带水果

d: n 角色；某物的特色 a person in a book, play, film etc

es.e: A soulless shopping centre stands across from one of the few buildings with character, the town hall.
es.c: 一座毫无生气的购物中心对面就是少有的几个别具特色的建筑物之一：市政厅。

es.e: Candida is the most interesting character in the play.
es.c: 坎迪达是剧中最有趣的人物。

d: adj 感染的，传染的 an infectious illness can be passed from one person to another, especially through the air you breathe

es.e: infectious diseases
es.c: 传染性疾病

es.e: Flu is highly infectious.
es.c: 流感传染性很强。

d: n 草坪 an area of ground in a garden or park that is covered with short grass

es.e: I spent all morning mowing the lawn (= cutting the grass ).
es.c: 我整个上午都在修剪草坪。

es.e: a carefully tended lawn
es.c: 受到细心呵护的草坪

d: adj 永久的 continuing to exist for a long time or for all the time in the future

es.e: He gave up a permanent job in order to freelance.
es.c: 他放弃了固定工作，为的是当一名自由职业者。

es.e: a permanent change in your eating habits
es.c: 饮食习惯的永久改变

es.e: The blindness that the disease causes will be permanent.
es.c: 这种疾病引起的失明是永久性的。

d: v 超越 to go beyond the usual limits of something

es.e: The desire for peace transcended political differences.
es.c: 对和平的渴望超越了政治分歧。

d: v 绑架 to take someone somewhere illegally by force, often in order to get money for returning them

es.e: Police appealed for witnesses after a woman was kidnapped at gunpoint.
es.c: 一名妇女遭到持枪绑架，警方呼吁目击者挺身而出。

d: v 主导，主宰 to control someone or something or to have more importance than other people or things

es.e: The industry is dominated by five multinational companies.
es.c: 这个行业受五家跨国公司控制。

es.e: New Orleans dominated throughout the game.
es.c: 新奥尔良队自始至终都控制着这场比赛。

es.e: Her loud voice totally dominated the conversation.
es.c: 她的大嗓门完全主导着这场谈话。

d: v 使稳固，使安定 to become firm, steady, or unchanging, or to make something firm or steady

es.e: The patient’s condition has now stabilized.
es.c: 病人的情况现已稳定下来了。

es.e: an attempt to stabilize the economy
es.c: 稳定经济的努力

d: v 咨询 to ask for information or advice from someone because it is their job to know something

es.e: If symptoms persist, consult a doctor without delay.
es.c: 如果症状持续的话，马上咨询医生。

d: n 简历 a short written account of your education and your previous jobs that you send to an employer when you are looking for a new job

es.e: Update your resume and cover letter.
es.c: 更新你的简历和求职信。

d: v 移民；迁徙 if people migrate, they go to live in another area or country, especially in order to find work

es.e: People migrate to cities like Jakarta in search of work.
es.c: 人们移居到雅加达这样的城市找工作。

es.e: Most birds have to fly long distances to migrate.
es.c: 大多数的鸟类不得不飞行很长的距离进行迁徙。

d: n 隔绝，隔离 when one group, person, or thing is separate from others

es.e: Because of its geographical isolation, the area developed its own unique culture.
es.c: 由于地理上的隔绝，该地区发展了自己独特的文化。

es.e: The mansion sits in splendid isolation on top of the hill (= it is far from everything and looks impressive ).
es.c: 宅邸位于山顶，远离尘嚣。

es.e: a patient’s isolation period
es.c: 病人的隔离期

d: v 获得 to get something, especially an advantage or a pleasant feeling, from something

es.e: Mr. Ying is one of those happy people who derive pleasure from helping others.
es.c: 英先生是那种助人为乐的快活人。

d: n 保护 the protection of natural things such as animals, plants, forests etc, to prevent them from being spoiled or destroyed

es.e: wildlife conservation
es.c: 野生生物保护

es.e: a local conservation group
es.c: 当地的一个环境保护团体

d: n 发生率 the number of times something happens, especially crime, disease etc

es.e: The incidence of breast cancer increases with age.
es.c: 乳腺癌的发病率随着年龄的增长而上升。

d: adj 永久的 permanent

es.e: the perpetual snows of the mountaintops
es.c: 山顶的终年积雪

d: adj 悲观的 expecting that bad things will happen in the future or that something will have a bad result

es.e: a pessimistic view of life
es.c: 对人生的悲观看法

d: n 机组人员 all the people who work on a ship or plane

es.e: The plane crashed, killing two of the crew and four passengers.
es.c: 飞机坠毁，造成两名机组人员和四名乘客死亡。

es.e: a crew member
es.c: 一名机组人员

d: v 哀悼 to feel very sad and to miss someone after they have died

es.e: Hundreds of people gathered to mourn the slain president.
es.c: 成百上千人聚集在一起悼念遇刺的总统。

d: n 恶习 a bad habit

es.e: Smoking is my only vice.
es.c: 吸烟是我唯一的恶习。

d: n 照相，照片 a photograph

es.e: We hired a photographer to take some publicity shots .
es.c: 我们雇了个摄影师来拍宣传照。

d: n 病毒 a very small living thing that causes infectious illnesses

es.e: children infected with the Aids virus
es.c: 感染艾滋病病毒的儿童

es.e: a virus infection
es.c: 病毒感染

d: n 宿舍 a  dormitory

es.e: But I had no food in my dorm, so I had to go to canteen.
es.c: 但是我在宿舍没有东西可吃，所以我只能去餐厅了。

d: v 爆发；喷出 if fighting, violence, noise etc erupts, it starts suddenly

es.e: Violence erupted after police shot a student during the demonstration.
es.c: 警察向示威人群中的一名学生开枪，暴乱随之发生。

es.e: A political row erupted over the MP’s comments.
es.c: 这名下院议员的评论引发了一场政治论战。

es.e: The volcano erupted in 1980, devastating a large area of Washington state.
es.c: 这座火山1980年喷发，摧毁了华盛顿州的大片地区。

d: n 影响 the effect or influence that an event, situation etc has on someone or something

es.e: They say they expect the meeting to have a marked impact on the future of the country.
es.c: 他们说期望这次会议对国家的未来产生显著的影响。

d: n 指数；标志，指标 a system by which prices, costs etc can be compared to those of a previous date

es.e: ...the consumer price index.
es.c: …消费价格指数。

es.e: The changing size of an infant’s head is considered an index of brain growth
es.c: 婴儿头围不断变大标志着大脑在发育。

d: v 声称；索取 to state that something is true, even though it has not been proved

es.e: I don’t claim to be a feminist, but I’d like to see more women in top jobs.
es.c: 我不会自称是女权主义者，但我希望看到更多的女性担任高职。

es.e: Opposition leaders will claim victory if the turnout is lower than 50%.
es.c: 如果投票率低于 50%，反对党领袖将宣布获胜。

es.e: He should be able to claim the price of the ticket back.
es.c: 他应该能够要回票款。

d: v 采纳，接受 to eagerly accept a new idea, opinion, religion etc

es.e: We hope these regions will embrace democratic reforms.
es.c: 我们希望这些地区会乐意接受民主改革。

es.e: Most West European countries have embraced the concept of high-speed rail networks with enthusiasm.
es.c: 大多数西欧国家都表现出极大的兴趣，欣然接受修建高速铁路网的想法。

d: adj 值得羡慕的 an enviable quality, position, or possession is good and other people would like to have it

es.e: Now he was in the enviable position of not having to work for a living.
es.c: 现在他已不必为生计而工作，着实令人羡慕。

d: n 女衬衫 a shirt for women

es.e: a silk blouse
es.c: 丝质女衬衫

d: v 递送；发表演讲 to take goods, letters, packages etc to a particular place or person

es.e: The morning mail has just been delivered.
es.c: 早晨的邮件刚送到。

es.e: Do you deliver on Saturdays?
es.c: 星期六你们送货吗？

es.e: I’m having some flowers delivered for her birthday.
es.c: 我在安排人给她送花祝贺生日。

d: n 节奏 a regular repeated pattern of sounds or movements

es.e: Drums are basic to African rhythm.
es.c: 非洲音乐节奏少不了鼓。

es.e: complicated dance rhythms
es.c: 复杂的舞蹈节奏

d: n 代号，密码 a system of words, letters, or symbols that you use instead of ordinary writing, so that the information can only be understood by someone else who knows the system

es.e: The spy sent his message in code.
es.c: 这个间谍用密码发送情报。

es.e: But we have not yet implemented this in the code.
es.c: 但我们在代码中尚未实现此功能。

es.e: The hacker came smack up against the company's policy of keeping its records in code.
es.c: 这个计算机黑客突然碰壁了，因这家公司实行了用密码保存公司纪录的政策。

d: n 垄断 if a company or government has a monopoly of a business or political activity, it has complete control of it so that other organizations cannot compete with it

es.e: a monopoly in copper trading
es.c: 对铜交易的垄断

d: adj 干涉；妨碍 to deliberately get involved in a situation where you are not wanted or needed

es.e: Don't interfere in other's private concerns.
es.c: 不要干涉别人的私事。

es.e: When others interfere, it always makes trouble.
es.c: 别人一干涉， 麻烦就来了。

es.e: Anxiety can interfere with children’s performance at school.
es.c: 焦虑会影响孩子在学校的表现。

d: n 参赛者 someone who competes in a contest

es.e: Later he applied to be a contestant on the television show.
es.c: 之后他报了名做该电视秀的参赛者。

d: adj 滑稽的，可笑的 very silly or unreasonable

es.e: That’s a ridiculous idea!
es.c: 那主意很荒唐！

es.e: Don’t be ridiculous!
es.c: 别傻了！

es.e: I’d look ridiculous in a dress like that.
es.c: 我穿那样的裙子会显得很可笑。

d: adj 有魅力的，迷人的 attractive, exciting, and related to wealth and success

es.e: She led an exciting and glamorous life.
es.c: 她生活奢华，充满刺激。

es.e: the most glamorous neighborhood in the city
es.c: 城里最繁华的街区

es.e: On television, she looks so glamorous.
es.c: 她在电视里看上去光彩照人。

d: n 商场 a large area where there are a lot of shops, usually a covered area where cars are not allowed

es.e: In the winter I head for the mall.
es.c: 在冬日里,我前往这个购物商场。

es.e: If you see something you like at the mall, walk away.
es.c: 如果在商城里看见某件你喜欢的东西，（别买）走开。

d: adv 慢性地；持久地

es.e: a hospital for the chronically ill
es.c: 慢性病医院

d: adj 长时间的 continuing for a long time

es.e: prolonged exposure to the sun
es.c: 长时间暴露在阳光下

es.e: a prolonged period of time
es.c: 很长一段时间

d: n 症状 something wrong with your body or mind which shows that you have a particular illness

es.e: One of the most common symptoms of schizophrenia is hearing imaginary voices.
es.c: 精神分裂症最常见的症状之一是幻听。

d: adj 引人注目的 very interesting or exciting, so that you have to pay attention

es.e: His life makes a compelling story .
es.c: 他的一生是个引人入胜的故事。

d: adv 非常，极大地 very much

es.e: Champagne wines became immensely popular in the 18th century.
es.c: 香槟酒在18世纪十分流行。

es.e: We enjoyed the play immensely.
es.c: 我们很喜欢这出戏。

d: n 物种 a group of animals or plants whose members are similar and can breed together to produce young animals or plants

es.e: Seven species of birds of prey have been observed.
es.c: 已有七种猛禽被观察到。

es.e: pandas and other endangered species
es.c: 熊猫以及其他濒危物种

d: n 激战，战役 a fight between opposing armies, groups of ships, groups of people etc, especially one that is part of a larger war

es.e: the Battle of Trafalgar
es.c: 特拉法尔加战役

es.e: a pitched battle (=  a long and serious battle  ) between police and drug gangs
es.c: 警方和贩毒团伙之间的一场激战

d: n 冲突 a state of disagreement or argument between people, groups, countries etc

es.e: the threat of industrial conflict in the coalfields
es.c: 煤田发生劳资纠纷的风险

es.e: Marx points out the potential conflicts below the surface of society.
es.c: 马克思指出了隐藏在社会表层之下的潜在矛盾。

es.e: His views on the literal truth of the Bible brought him into conflict with other Christian leaders.
es.c: 他坚持《圣经》字面真理的观点使他与其他的基督教领袖发生了冲突。

d: v 渗透 if liquid, gas etc permeates something, it enters it and spreads through every part of it

es.e: The smell of diesel oil permeated the air.
es.c: 空气里充斥着柴油的气味。

d: adj 错误的 erroneous ideas or information are wrong and based on facts that are not correct

es.e: His economic predictions are based on some erroneous assumptions.
es.c: 他的经济预测是基于错误假设之上的。

d: n 车厢, 隔间 a smaller enclosed space inside something larger

es.e: The bag is divided into separate compartments .
es.c: 这个包有一些独立的隔层。

es.e: engine compartment
es.c: 发动机室

es.e: She kept the money hidden in a secret compartment in her briefcase.
es.c: 她把钱藏在公文包的暗层里。

d: adj 大都市的 relating or belonging to a very large city

es.e: a metropolitan area of South Australia
es.c: 南澳大利亚的一个都市区

d: n 抓住 the way you hold something tightly, or your ability to do this

es.e: Hold the microphone in a firm grip and keep it still.
es.c: 紧紧握住麦克风不要让它动。

es.e: She felt her wrist caught in a vice-like grip .
es.c: 她觉得手腕像是卡在铁钳里被牢牢地抓住了。

es.e: Don’t loosen your grip on the rope or you’ll fall.
es.c: 抓住绳索别松手，不然你会掉下去。

d: v 压碎，压榨 to press something so hard that it breaks or is damaged

es.e: His leg was crushed in the accident.
es.c: 他的腿在事故中被压断。

es.e: Two people were crushed to death in the rush to escape.
es.c: 两个人在逃生过程中被踩死。

d: adj 先前的；优先的 existing or arranged before something else or before the present situation

es.e: You do not need any prior knowledge of the subject.
es.c: 你无需事先具备该方面的知识。

es.e: Changes may not be made without the prior approval of the council.
es.c: 未经委员会事先同意，不得作出改变。

es.e: Vegetarian meals are provided by prior agreement.
es.c: 经事先协商可提供素食。

d: n 公式 a series of numbers or letters that represent a mathematical or scientific rule

es.e: the formula for calculating distance
es.c: 计算距离的公式

es.e: Sugar is represented by the simple formula CHO.
es.c: 糖以简单的分子式CHO表示。

d: adj 不可避免的 an inescapable fact or situation is one that you cannot avoid or ignore

es.e: She didn’t want to confront the inescapable fact that she would have to sell the house.
es.c: 她不想面对必须卖掉房子这一无法逃避的事实。

es.e: The inescapable conclusion is that he was murdered by someone in his own family.
es.c: 必然的结论就是: 他是被自己的家人谋杀的。

d: adj 怀疑的 tending to disagree with what other people tell you

es.e: I’m extremely skeptical about what I read in the press.
es.c: 我对报纸上读到的东西极度怀疑。

es.e: Environmental groups are skeptical of the government’s claims.
es.c: 环境保护组织对政府的声明持怀疑态度。

es.e: He is highly skeptical of the reforms.
es.c: 他对改革持极度怀疑的态度。

d: v 利用，控制 to control and use the natural force or power of something

es.e: We can harness the power of the wind to generate electricity.
es.c: 我们可以利用风力发电。

d: n 目的地 the place that someone or something is going to

es.e: Ellis Island has become one of America's most popular tourist destinations.
es.c: 埃利斯岛已经成为美国最受欢迎的游览地之一。

d: adj 职业的 teaching or relating to the skills you need to do a particular job

es.e: vocational qualifications
es.c: 职业资格

d: n 密度 the degree to which an area is filled with people or things

es.e: areas of high population density
es.c: 人口密度高的地区

d: n 不同 the amount by which two or more things are different or by which they change

es.e: a price variance of 5%
es.c: 5%的价格差异

d: n 地标 something that is easy to recognize, such as a tall tree or building, and that helps you know where you are

es.e: One of Belfast’s most famous landmarks, the Grosvenor Hall, has been demolished.
es.c: 贝尔法斯特最著名的地标之一格罗夫纳大厦已被拆毁了。

d: v 逗留，徘徊 to stay somewhere a little longer, especially because you do not want to leave

es.e: I spent a week at Kandersteg and could happily have lingered on.
es.c: 我在坎德施泰格逗留了一个星期，本来还可以开开心心地多待几天。

d: adj 奢侈的，豪华的 very expensive, beautiful, and comfortable

es.e: a luxurious 30-room villa
es.c: 一栋有30个房间的豪华度假别墅

d: adj 天文数字的 astronomical prices, costs etc are extremely high

es.e: Houses in the subdivision are going for astronomical prices.
es.c: 该小区里的房子在以天价出售。

d: n 协调；（肌肉的）协调 the organization of people or things so that they work together well

es.e: the coordination of our economic policies
es.c: 我们经济政策的协调

es.e: Too much alcohol affects your coordination.
es.c: 喝酒太多会影响你动作的协调。

d: n 货币 the system or type of money that a country uses

es.e: The bank can supply you with foreign currency .
es.c: 这家银行能为你提供外币。

es.e: There are moves towards a single currency in Europe.
es.c: 欧洲有向单一货币发展的趋势。

es.e: The local currency is the Swiss franc.
es.c: 当地的货币是瑞士法郎。

d: v 谴责 to say or think that someone or something is responsible for something bad

es.e: Don’t blame me – it’s not my fault.
es.c: 别来怪我——又不是我的错。

es.e: I blame his mother. She does everything for him.
es.c: 怪他母亲不好，她什么事都要为他做。

d: v 解雇 to remove someone from their job

es.e: Bryant was unfairly dismissed from his post.
es.c: 布赖恩特被无理免职了。

d: v 作证；证明，检验 to make a formal statement of what is true, especially in a court of law

es.e: Mr Molto has agreed to testify at the trial.
es.c: 莫尔托先生已经同意出庭作证。

es.e: Can you testify that you saw the defendant at the scene of the crime?
es.c: 你能作证你看到被告在犯罪现场吗？

es.e: The empty shops in the high street testify to the depth of the recession.
es.c: 大街上空无一人的商店说明了经济萧条的严重程度。

d: v 使有资格 to have the right to have or do something, or to give someone this right

es.e: Free school lunches are given to children who qualify.
es.c: 符合条件的儿童可获得免费的学生午餐。

d: v 询问 to ask someone for information

es.e: ‘Why are you doing that?’ the boy inquired.
es.c: “你为什么这么做？”男孩问道。

es.e: Toby would have liked to inquire further (= ask more questions ).
es.c: 托比本想问更多的问题。

d: v 强调 to say something in a strong way

es.e: The report emphasizes the importance of improving safety standards.
es.c: 报告强调了改进安全标准的重要性。

es.e: Logan made a speech emphasizing the need for more volunteers.
es.c: 罗根发表演讲，强调需要更多的志愿者。

d: adj 压倒性的 very large or greater, more important etc than any other

es.e: There is overwhelming evidence that smoking damages your health.
es.c: 有难以辩驳的证据表明吸烟有损健康。

es.e: An overwhelming majority of the members were against the idea.
es.c: 占压倒性多数的成员反对这项主张。

es.e: The proposal has been given overwhelming support.
es.c: 这一提议得到了压倒性多数的支持。

d: n 火焰 hot bright burning gas that you see when something is on fire

es.e: Flames poured out of the windows of the building.
es.c: 火焰从大楼窗口冒出来。

es.e: They rushed past us with buckets of water and tried to douse the flames .
es.c: 他们提着一桶桶水跑过我们身边去灭火。

es.e: They sat around the campfire, watching the flickering flames .
es.c: 他们围坐在篝火旁，看着跳动的火焰。

d: v 模仿 to copy the way someone behaves, speaks, moves etc, especially in order to make people laugh

es.e: She was a splendid mimic and loved to imitate Winston Churchill.
es.c: 她是个出色的模仿者，喜欢模仿温斯顿·丘吉尔。

d: n 把手 the part of a door that you use for opening it

es.e: Then he turned the handle and went in.
es.c: 然后他转动把手走了进去。

d: n 干旱 a long period of dry weather when there is not enough water for plants and animals to live

es.e: ...a country where drought and famines have killed up to two million people during the last eighteen years.
es.c: …过去18年来干旱和饥荒致死达两百万人的一个国家。

d: n 鼓手 someone who plays drums

es.e: He was a drummer in a rock band.
es.c: 他是一支摇滚乐队的鼓手。

d: v 复兴；复苏 to bring something back after it has not been used or has not existed for a period of time

es.e: Local people have decided to revive this centuries-old tradition.
es.c: 当地人决定复兴这一延续了数个世纪的传统。

es.e: The economy is beginning to revive.
es.c: 经济开始复苏。

d: adj 脆弱的, 易受影响的 someone who is vulnerable can be easily harmed or hurt

es.e: He took advantage of me when I was at my most vulnerable.
es.c: 他在我最脆弱的时候利用了我。

es.e: We work mainly with the elderly and other vulnerable groups.
es.c: 我们主要和老年人以及其他弱势群体打交道。

d: n 点；地点，处所 a usually round area on a surface that is a different colour or is rougher, smoother etc than the rest；v 发现 to notice someone or something, especially when they are difficult to see or recognize

es.e: a white cat with brown spots
es.c: 带褐色斑点的白猫

es.e: a nice quiet spot on the beach
es.c: 海滩上一个安静的好地方

es.e: I chose a spot well away from the road.
es.c: 我选了一个远离马路的地点。

d: v 镇压，压制 to stop people from opposing the government, especially by using force

es.e: The uprising was ruthlessly suppressed.
es.c: 起义受到了残酷的镇压。

d: v 减少 to become or make something become smaller or less

es.e: The party’s share of the electorate has diminished steadily.
es.c: 支持这个政党的选民比例持续下降。

es.e: These drugs diminish blood flow to the brain.
es.c: 这些药物会减少流向脑部的血液量。

d: v 使一致；使和解，调解 if you reconcile two ideas, situations, or facts, you find a way in which they can both be true or acceptable

es.e: The possibility remains that the two theories may be reconciled.
es.c: 这两种理论仍是有可能协调的。

es.e: The pair were reconciled after Jackson made a public apology.
es.c: 杰克逊公开道歉之后，这两个人又言归于好了。

d: adj 人造的；虚伪的 not real or not made of natural things but made to be like something that is real or natural

es.e: artificial flowers
es.c: 假花

es.e: artificial light
es.c: 人造光

es.e: an artificial smile
es.c: 假笑

d: adj 强壮的；擅长运动的；运动的，运动员的 physically strong and good at sport

es.e: a tall athletic man
es.c: 一个高大强壮的男子

es.e: They have been given college scholarships purely on athletic ability.
es.c: 他们完全凭他们的运动才能获得了大学奖学金。

d: adj 对抗的，有敌意的 If you describe the way that someone behaves as confrontational, you are showing your disapproval of the fact that they are aggressive and likely to cause an argument or dispute

es.e: The committee's confrontational style of campaigning has made it unpopular.
es.c: 该委员会挑衅的宣传方式使之不得人心。

d: v 划船 to make a boat move across water using  oar s

es.e: Jenny used to row at college (= as a sport ) .
es.c: 珍妮以前在大学里经常参加划船运动。

d: v 航行，驾驶 to sail along a river or other area of water

es.e: The river is too dangerous to navigate.
es.c: 这河道太危险，不适宜航行。

d: n 惊慌 a sudden strong feeling of fear or nervousness that makes you unable to think clearly or behave sensibly

es.e: Her face distorted in panic.
es.c: 她的脸因恐慌而变相了。

es.e: The panic-stricken fled in all directions.
es.c: 惊慌的人群向四面八方逃去。

es.e: They ascribed courage to me for something I did out of sheer panic.
es.c: 由于我纯粹因惊慌而做的事，他们认为我很有勇气。

d: adj 有敌意的 angry and deliberately unfriendly towards someone, and ready to argue with them

es.e: Southampton fans gave their former coach a hostile reception .
es.c: 南安普敦队的球迷对球队的前任教练很不友善。

es.e: Carr wouldn’t meet Feng’s stare, which was openly hostile .
es.c: 卡尔不愿意面对冯公然敌视的目光。

es.e: his hostile attitude
es.c: 他敌对的态度

d: v 安慰 to make someone feel better when they are feeling sad or disappointed

es.e: No one could console her when Peter died.
es.c: 彼得去世时没人能够安慰她。

d: v 使……危险 to put someone or something in danger of being hurt, damaged, or destroyed

es.e: Smoking during pregnancy endangers your baby’s life.
es.c: 孕期吸烟会危及胎儿生命。

d: n 前景 a particular event which will probably or definitely happen in the future – used especially when you want to talk about how you feel about it

es.e: The prospect of marriage terrified Alice.
es.c: 想到要结婚，艾丽斯害怕极了。

d: v 识别 If you can discern something, you are aware of it and know what it is

es.e: You need a long series of data to be able to discern such a trend.
es.c: 你需要一大串数据才能认清这一趋势。

d: adj 司法的 relating to the law, judges, or their decisions

es.e: ...an independent judicial system.
es.c: …一个独立的司法体系。

d: v 损害 to damage something or make it not as good as it should be

es.e: The illness had impaired his ability to think and concentrate.
es.c: 这种疾病损害了他的思维能力和注意力。

d: n 汽车旅馆 a hotel for people who are travelling by car, where you can park your car outside your room

es.e: The gas station just neighbours to the motel.
es.c: 加油站就在汽车旅馆的附近。

es.e: I also have to get back to the motel. The manager took my passport last night, and now he and the passport are nowhere to be found.
es.c: 我也必须回到汽车旅馆去，因为旅馆经理昨天晚上拿走了我的护照，到现在为止他本人和我的护照都不知所踪。

d: v 标志 to be a sign that something is going to happen

es.e: the lengthening days that signal the end of winter
es.c: 白昼变长标志着冬天的结束

d: n 疗法 the treatment of an illness or injury over a fairly long period of time

es.e: new drug therapies
es.c: 新的药物疗法

es.e: radiation therapy for cancer treatment
es.c: 治疗癌症的放射疗法

d: adj 各种各样的 very different from each other

es.e: subjects as diverse as pop music and archaeology
es.c: 像流行音乐和考古学这样各不相同的学科

d: v 保留，保护 to protect something and prevent it from changing or being damaged

es.e: We must conserve our woodlands for future generations.
es.c: 我们必须为子孙后代保护林地。

es.e: efforts to conserve fish stocks
es.c: 保护鱼类资源的努力

d: n 改编版；适应 a film or television programme that is based on a book or play

es.e: Branagh won two awards for his screen adaptation of Shakespeare's Henry the Fifth.
es.c: 布拉纳因他对莎士比亚的《亨利五世》的荧幕改编而获了两次奖。

es.e: adaptation to the environment
es.c: 适应环境

d: v 抵制 to refuse to accept sth and try to stop it from happening

es.e: to resist change
es.c: 抵制变革

es.e: The bank strongly resisted cutting interest rates.
es.c: 银行强烈反对降低利率。

d: v 使……相信 If someone or something convinces you of something, they make you believe that it is true or that it exists

es.e: Although I soon convinced him of my innocence, I think he still has serious doubts about my sanity.
es.c: 尽管我很快就使他相信我是清白的，但是他还是非常怀疑我精神是否正常。

d: n 负担 something difficult or worrying that you are responsible for

es.e: His family responsibilities had started to become a burden.
es.c: 家庭责任已开始成为他的负担。

d: n 工资总额 the total amount of wages paid to all the people working in a particular company or industry

es.e: The annual payroll was $88 million.
es.c: 年度工资总支出为8,800万美元

d: adj 统一的 created from more than one part, group etc

es.e: a unified approach
es.c: 统一的方法

es.e: a unified market
es.c: 统一的市场

d: v 加速 to make something happen faster or sooner

es.e: Their departure was hastened by an abnormally cold winter.
es.c: 那个冬天异常寒冷，所以他们提前走了。

d: v 交织，纠缠 if two things intertwine, or if they are intertwined, they are twisted together

es.e: Their destinies are intertwined.
es.c: 他们的命运交织在一起。

es.e: a necklace of rubies intertwined with pearls
es.c: 缠着珍珠的红宝石项链

d: v 容纳；适应 if a room, building etc can accommodate a particular number of people or things, it has enough space for them

es.e: He bought a huge house to accommodate his library.
es.c: 他买了一座大房子来放他的藏书。

es.e: The ballroom can accommodate 400 people.
es.c: 那个舞厅可容纳400人。

es.e: Her eyes took a while to accommodate to the darkness.
es.c: 她的眼睛过了一会儿才适应黑暗。

d: v 开处方 to say what medicine or treatment a sick person should have

es.e: The physician examines the patient then diagnoses the disease and prescribes medication.
es.c: 内科医生检查了病人，然后对疾病作出诊断，并开出药方。

d: n 建筑 the process of building things such as houses, bridges, roads etc

es.e: a road construction project
es.c: 道路修建计划

es.e: construction workers
es.c: 建筑工人

d: v 忍受 to be in a difficult or painful situation for a long time without complaining

es.e: It seemed impossible that anyone could endure such pain.
es.c: 似乎谁都不可能忍受这样的疼痛。

d: n 选举 when people vote to choose someone for an official position

es.e: The Labour Party won the 2001 election by a huge majority.
es.c: 工党在2001年选举中以巨大优势获胜。

es.e: Elections for the state governorship will be on November 25.
es.c: 州长选举将于11月25日举行。

d: n 陪审团 a group of 12 ordinary people who listen to the details of a case in court and decide whether someone is guilty or not

es.e: the members of the jury
es.c: 陪审团成员

es.e: The jury found him not guilty.
es.c: 陪审团裁定他无罪。

es.e: the right to trial by jury
es.c: 由陪审团进行审理的权利

d: n 光荣，荣誉 the importance, honour, and praise that people give someone they admire a lot

es.e: She dreamt of future glory as an Olympic champion.
es.c: 她梦想着将来能得到奥运冠军的荣誉。

es.e: Goran’s moment of glory came when he defeated Rafter.
es.c: 戈兰击败拉夫特，迎来了荣耀的一刻。
