es.e: He began the season in a blaze of glory , scoring seven goals in as many games.
es.c: 这个赛季一开始他便光芒四射，七场比赛进了七个球。

d: v 缝上，缝纫 to use a needle and thread to make or repair clothes or to fasten something such as a button to them

es.e: I learned to sew at school.
es.c: 我在学校学会了缝纫。

d: n 部门 a part of an area of activity, especially of business, trade etc

es.e: ...the nation's manufacturing sector.
es.c: …该国的制造部门。

d: adj 危险的 dangerous, especially to people’s health or safety

es.e: the disposal of hazardous waste
es.c: 有害废弃物的处理

d: v 剥夺 If you deprive someone of something that they want or need, you take it away from them, or you prevent them from having it

es.e: They've been deprived of the fuel necessary to heat their homes.
es.c: 他们无法得到住房取暖必需的燃料。

d: adj 慷慨的 someone who is generous is willing to give money, spend time etc, in order to help people or give them pleasure

es.e: Dietler is generous with his time and money.
es.c: 迪特勒在他的时间和金钱方面慷慨大方。

d: v 限制 to limit something

es.e: Poor soil has constrained the level of crop production.
es.c: 贫瘠的土地限制了农作物的产量。

es.e: Women’s employment opportunities are often severely constrained by family commitments.
es.c: 女性的就业机会常常受到家庭责任的严重限制。

d: n 现象 something that happens or exists in society, science, or nature, especially something that is studied because it is difficult to understand

es.e: Homelessness is not a new phenomenon .
es.c: 无家可归已不是什么新现象。

d: v 假定，认为 to think that something is true, although you do not have definite proof

es.e: I think we can safely assume (=  it is almost certain  ) that interest rates will go up again soon.
es.c: 我想我们几乎可以肯定，利率很快会再次上调。

es.e: When it got to midnight and Paul was still not back, I began to assume the worst (=  think that the worst possible thing had happened  ) .
es.c: 到午夜时保罗还没回来，我就开始往最坏的地方想了。

d: adj 有良心的，认真负责的 careful to do everything that it is your job or duty to do

es.e: A conscientious teacher may feel inclined to take work home.
es.c: 一个认真负责的教师可能会想着把工作带回家去做。

es.e: a conscientious and hard-working student
es.c: 勤勉刻苦的学生

d: n 妥协 something that you allow someone to have in order to end an argument or a disagreement

es.e: The British were not prepared to make any concessions.
es.c: 英国人没有打算作出让步。

es.e: a policy of no concessions to terrorists
es.c: 对恐怖分子决不让步的政策

d: v 怀疑 to think that something is probably true, especially something bad；n 嫌疑犯 someone who is thought to be guilty of a crime

es.e: She strongly suspected he was lying to her.
es.c: 她非常怀疑他在对她撒谎。

es.e: She’s not going to be very happy about this, I suspect .
es.c: 我想对于此事她不会太高兴。

es.e: the two suspects for the robbery
es.c: 抢劫案的两名嫌疑犯

d: n 样本，样品 a small part or amount of something that is examined in order to find out something about the whole

es.e: They took a blood sample to test for hepatitis.
es.c: 他们取了血样做肝炎化验。

d: n 惩罚 a punishment for breaking a law, rule, or legal agreement

es.e: No littering. Penalty $500.
es.c: 禁止乱扔垃圾。 违者罚款500美元。

es.e: Withdrawing the money early will result in a 10% penalty.
es.c: 提前支取这笔钱将被处以10%的罚金。

es.e: If he is convicted, he could receive the death penalty (= be killed as a punishment ) .
es.c: 一旦定罪，他可能会被判处死刑。

d: n 代表 someone who has been chosen to speak, vote, or make decisions for someone else

es.e: a union representative
es.c: 工会代表

d: v 安慰，减轻 to make someone feel calmer and less anxious, upset, or angry

es.e: Lucy soothed the baby by rocking it in her arms.
es.c: 露西把宝宝抱在怀里摇晃着，让他安静下来。

es.e: She made a cup of tea to soothe her nerves.
es.c: 她泡了杯茶让自己平静下来。

d: v 使需要，使必须 to involve something as a necessary part or result

es.e: A new computer system entails a lot of re-training.
es.c: 使用新的计算机系统需要大量的再培训。

es.e: Some foreign travel is entailed in the job.
es.c: 做这份工作有时要到国外出差。

d: n 目标，目的 something that you are trying hard to achieve, especially in business or politics

es.e: He vowed to achieve certain objectives before the end of his presidency.
es.c: 他立誓要在他的总统任期结束之前实现某些目标。

es.e: the best way to accomplish your objectives
es.c: 完成目标的最佳方法

es.e: The degree program has two main objectives.
es.c: 该学位课程有两个主要目标。

d: v 提交 to give a plan, piece of writing etc to someone in authority for them to consider or approve

es.e: They submitted their reports to the chancellor yesterday.
es.c: 他们昨天向财政大臣提交了他们的报告。

d: v 认出，识别 to recognize and correctly name someone or something

es.e: He was too far away to be able to identify faces.
es.c: 他离得太远，没法看面孔认出谁是谁。

es.e: The police took fingerprints and identified the body.
es.c: 警方采集了指纹，对尸体作了身份确认。

d: v 感染 to give someone a disease

es.e: People with the virus may feel perfectly well, but they can still infect others.
es.c: 带有这种病毒的人可能毫无症状，却仍可能传染他人。

d: n 埋葬 the act or ceremony of putting a dead body into a  grave

es.e: The priest prepared the body for burial.
es.c: 牧师为尸体做好了下葬的准备。

d: n 天才 a very high level of intelligence, mental skill, or ability, which only a few people have

es.e: The film reveals Fellini’s genius.
es.c: 这部影片展现了费里尼的天赋。

es.e: a work of pure genius
es.c: 天才之作

d: v 淹没 to cover something completely with water or another liquid

es.e: The tunnel entrance was submerged by rising sea water.
es.c: 隧道入口被涨起的海水淹没。

d: n 刻板印象，固有印象 A stereotype is a fixed general image or set of characteristics that a lot of people believe represent a particular type of person or thing.

es.e: There's always been a stereotype about successful businessmen.
es.c: 对成功的商人们总有一种成见。

d: v 澄清，明确 to make something clearer or easier to understand

es.e: Reporters asked him to clarify his position (= say exactly what his beliefs are ) on welfare reform.
es.c: 记者们要求他阐明他在福利改革问题上的立场。

d: n 转变 when you change something from one form, purpose, or system to a different one

es.e: ...the conversion of disused rail lines into cycle routes.
es.c: …把废弃的铁路改变成自行车道。

d: n 居民 someone who lives or stays in a particular place

es.e: the residents of Westville
es.c: 韦斯特维尔的居民

es.e: The archbishop called on the government to build more low cost homes for local residents.
es.c: 这位大主教呼吁该政府为当地居民建更多的廉价住宅。

d: n 方面 one part of a situation, idea, plan etc that has many parts

es.e: Dealing with people is the most important aspect of my work.
es.c: 与人打交道是我工作中最重要的一方面。

d: v 道歉 to tell someone that you are sorry that you have done something wrong

es.e: I’m so sorry, I do apologize.
es.c: 非常对不起，我真心道歉。

d: adj 像样的；正派的，规矩的 of a good enough standard or quality

es.e: Don’t you have a decent jacket?
es.c: 你就没有一件像样的外套吗？

es.e: Paul visited the local bars more frequently than was decent for a senior lecturer.
es.c: 保罗过于频繁地光顾当地酒吧，不太合乎高级讲师的身份。

d: n 固定装置 a piece of equipment that is fixed inside a house or building and is sold as part of the house

es.e: light fixtures
es.c: 照明设备

d: n 机构 a large organization that has a particular kind of work or purpose

es.e: powerful institutions such as world banks
es.c: 诸如世界银行之类的强大机构

es.e: the Institution of Electrical Engineers
es.c: 电机工程师学会

d: n 香味 a pleasant smell that something has

es.e: a yellow rose with a lovely scent
es.c: 香气怡人的黄玫瑰

d: n 幸福；福利 someone’s welfare is their health and happiness

es.e: Our only concern is the children’s welfare.
es.c: 我们唯一关心的是孩子们的幸福。

es.e: the provision of education and welfare services
es.c: 提供教育和福利服务

d: n 补助 money that is paid by a government or organization to make prices lower, reduce the cost of producing goods etc

es.e: European farmers are planning a massive demonstration against farm subsidy cuts.
es.c: 欧洲的农场主们正在策划一场反对削减农场补贴的大游行。

d: adj 表面的 seeming to have a particular quality, although this is not true or real

es.e: Beneath his refined manners and superficial elegance lay something treacherous.
es.c: 在他温文尔雅、貌似高贵的举止下隐藏着某种奸诈。

d: adj 私人的 for use by one person or group, not for everyone

es.e: Morris has a private jet.
es.c: 莫里斯拥有一架私人喷气式飞机。

es.e: He made some notes for his private use.
es.c: 他记了些笔记供自己所用。

es.e: They objected to any form of private property .
es.c: 他们反对任何形式的私有财产。

d: adj 传统的 a conventional method, product, practice etc has been used for a long time and is considered the usual type

es.e: Internet connections through conventional phone lines are fairly slow.
es.c: 通过传统的电话线来连接因特网速度很慢。

es.e: Bake for 20 minutes in a conventional oven; 8 in a microwave.
es.c: 在传统的烤炉中烘烤20分钟，在微波炉里则烤8分钟。

d: v 想知道，好奇 to think about something that you are not sure about and try to guess what is true, what will happen etc

es.e: What are they going to do now, I wonder ?
es.c: 我想知道，他们现在打算怎么办呢？

es.e: He’s been leaving work early a lot – it makes you wonder , doesn’t it?
es.c: 他最近经常提早下班——让人觉得奇怪，是不是？

d: adj 冗长的 something that is tedious continues for a long time and is not interesting

es.e: The work was tiring and tedious.
es.c: 这工作既累人又枯燥。

d: adj 从属的；次要的 in a less important position than someone else

es.e: a subordinate officer
es.c: 下级官员

es.e: These aims were subordinate to the main aims of the mission.
es.c: 和这次任务的主要目标相比，这些目标是次要的。

d: v 制定，拟定〔计划、体制等〕 to organize and develop a plan, system etc

es.e: Newman played a central role in framing the new law.
es.c: 纽曼在拟定新法的过程中发挥了主要作用。

d: v 走私 to take something or someone illegally from one country to another

es.e: My message is "If you try to smuggle drugs you are stupid."
es.c: 我的讯息是，“你若企图走私毒品，那是犯傻。”

d: n 返还费用 If you receive reimbursement for money that you have spent, you get your money back, for example because the money should have been paid by someone else.

es.e: She is demanding reimbursement for medical and other expenses.
es.c: 她在要求医疗和其他费用的报销。

d: v 消失 to become impossible to see any longer

es.e: At this point the path seemed to disappear altogether (= disappear completely ) .
es.c: 小路到这里好像完全消失了。

d: v 吸入 to breathe in air, smoke, or gas

es.e: It is dangerous to inhale ammonia fumes.
es.c: 吸入氨气是很危险的。

es.e: Myra lit another cigarette and inhaled deeply  (= breathed in a lot of smoke ).
es.c: 迈拉又点上一支烟，深深地吸了一口。

d: n 大多数 most of the people or things in a group

es.e: The Labour Party won a huge majority at the last general election.
es.c: 工党在上次大选中以巨大的票数优势获胜。

d: v 熟记 to learn words, music etc so that you know them perfectly

es.e: He studied his map, trying to memorize the way to Rose's street.
es.c: 他研究了地图，努力记住去罗丝家那条街的路。

d: adj 积累的 increasing gradually as more of something is added or happens

es.e: Learning is a cumulative process.
es.c: 学习是个逐渐积累的过程。

d: v 捕捉 to catch an animal or bird using a trap

es.e: The locals were encouraged to trap and kill mice to stop the spread of the virus.
es.c: 当地人被鼓励用捕捉器捕杀老鼠以阻止病毒的传播。

d: adj 高耸的；崇高的 lofty mountains, buildings etc are very high and impressive

es.e: He stayed at the Four Seasons Hotel, from whose lofty heights he could see across New York.
es.c: 他住在四季酒店，从酒店高处可以看到纽约的全景。

es.e: lofty ideals of equality and social justice
es.c: 平等和社会正义的崇高理想

d: n 清晰，清楚 the clarity of a piece of writing, law, argument etc is its quality of being expressed clearly

es.e: Letters may be edited for length and clarity.
es.c: 信件可能要加以修改以求篇幅合适，意思明了。

es.e: a lack of clarity in the law on property rights
es.c: 产权法律含糊不清

d: v 互动 if people interact with each other, they talk to each other, work together etc

es.e: While the other children interacted and played together, Ted ignored them.
es.c: 当其他孩子们相互交往、一起玩耍时，泰德却不理他们。

d: v 提炼；改进，完善 When a substance is refined, it is made pure by having all other substances removed from it

es.e: Oil is refined to remove naturally occurring impurities.
es.c: 油经过提炼去除天然生成的杂质。

es.e: Surgical techniques are constantly being refined.
es.c: 外科手术技术正在不断得到完善。

d: v 授予 to officially give someone a title etc, especially as a reward for something they have achieved

es.e: The constitution also confers large powers on Brazil's 25 constituent states.
es.c: 宪法还授予巴西25个成员州极大的权力。

d: adj 匿名的 unknown by name

es.e: the anonymous author of a collection of poems
es.c: 一本诗集的佚名作者

es.e: According to one employee, who wishes to remain anonymous , the company engaged in illegal activities.
es.c: 根据一位不愿透露姓名的员工所述，这家公司曾从事非法活动。

d: n 评论员 someone who knows a lot about a particular subject, and who writes about it or discusses it on the television or radio

es.e: political commentators
es.c: 政治评论员

d: adj 敏锐的；浓厚的 someone with a keen mind is quick to understand things

es.e: a keen understanding of commerce
es.c: 对商业敏锐的理解力

es.e: He took a keen interest in his grandson's education.
es.c: 他对孙子的教育很感兴趣。

d: v 强迫，迫使 to make something happen or force someone to do something

es.e: It is unlikely that a record company would enforce its views on an established artist.
es.c: 唱片公司未必能强迫一位已出名的艺人接受他们的意见。

d: n 杂货店 a shop/store that sells food and other things used in the home

es.e: They run a small grocery store.
es.c: 他们经营一家小食品杂货店。

d: v 传播，扩散 if something spreads or is spread, it becomes larger or moves so that it affects more people or a larger area

es.e: The industrial revolution, which started a couple of hundred years ago in Europe, is now spreading across the world.
es.c: 几百年前始于欧洲的工业革命现在正向全世界扩散。

d: v 招聘 to find new people to work in a company, join an organization, do a job etc

es.e: We’re having difficulty recruiting enough qualified staff.
es.c: 我们难以招聘到足够的合格职员。

es.e: Many government officials were recruited from private industry.
es.c: 很多政府官员是从私营企业招募来的。

d: adj 正当的 having an acceptable explanation or reason

es.e: In the Chief Constable’s view, the use of force was fully justified.
es.c: 在警察局局长看来，使用武力是完全正当的。

d: adj 古怪的 behaving in a way that is unusual and different from most people

es.e: His eccentric behaviour lost him his job.
es.c: 他古怪的行为使他丢了工作。

es.e: Aunt Nessy was always a bit eccentric.
es.c: 内西姑妈总是有点古怪。

d: v 架桥于…之上；缩小 to build or form a bridge over something

es.e: a fallen tree bridging the stream
es.c: 倒下来架在小溪上的树

es.e: Alvin managed to bridge the gap between ballet and modern dance.
es.c: 阿尔文设法弥合了芭蕾舞和现代舞蹈之间的差异。

d: v 疏忽；忽视 to fail to look after someone or something properly

es.e: She smoked and drank, neglected the children, and left the clothes unmended.
es.c: 她抽烟喝酒，既不照顾孩子，也不缝补衣服。

es.e: The building has been badly neglected.
es.c: 这栋大楼严重疏于维护。

es.e: Many of these ideas have been neglected by modern historians.
es.c: 这些观点有许多都被现代的历史学家忽略了。

d: n 道德原则；原则 a moral rule or belief about what is right and wrong, that influences how you behave

es.e: Schools try to teach children a set of principles.
es.c: 学校设法教给孩子们一套道德准则。

es.e: He’s got no principles at all!
es.c: 他毫无道德准则！

es.e: It’s against my principles to accept gifts from clients.
es.c: 收受客户礼物违背我的原则。

d: n 污渍，污点 a mark that is difficult to remove, especially one made by a liquid such as blood, coffee, or ink

es.e: Remove stains by soaking in a mild solution of bleach.
es.c: 用温和的漂白溶液浸泡以去除污渍。

d: v 鼓励 to give someone the courage or confidence to do something

es.e: I want to thank everyone who has encouraged and supported me.
es.c: 我要感谢每一位鼓励和支持过我的人。

d: adj 令人信服的 making you believe that something is true or right

es.e: convincing evidence of his guilt
es.c: 证明他有罪的有力证据

d: adv 不加选择地，不加区分地 in a random manner; unsystematically.

es.e: The soldiers fired indiscriminately into the crowd.
es.c: 士兵对着人群胡乱开枪。

d: adj 坚定的 doing something in a very determined way because you have very strong beliefs, aims etc

es.e: resolute opposition
es.c: 坚决的反对

es.e: resolute leadership
es.c: 果断的领导

es.e: She remained resolute in her belief that the situation would improve.
es.c: 她依然坚信情况将会好转。

d: adj 指示的 to be a clear sign that a particular situation exists or that something is likely to be true

es.e: This behaviour is indicative of her whole attitude, I’m afraid.
es.c: 这一行为恐怕已表明了她的总体态度。

d: v 死亡 to die, especially in a terrible or sudden way

es.e: Hundreds perished when the ship went down.
es.c: 轮船沉没，数百人罹难。

d: n 哲学家 someone who studies and develops ideas about the nature and meaning of existence, truth, good and evil etc

es.e: Plato, Aristotle, and other Greek philosophers
es.c: 柏拉图、亚里士多德和其他希腊哲学家

d: n 食谱；秘诀 a set of instructions for cooking a particular type of food

es.e: a recipe book
es.c: 一本烹饪书

es.e: What's her recipe for success?
es.c: 她成功的秘诀是什么？

d: adj 过度的 much more than is reasonable or necessary

es.e: his excessive drinking
es.c: 他的酗酒

es.e: $15 for two beers seems a little excessive.
es.c: 两杯啤酒要15美元，似乎有点过分。

d: n 严格，严谨 great care and thoroughness in making sure that something is correct

es.e: Their research seems to me to be lacking in rigor.
es.c: 他们的研究在我看来不够严谨。

d: adj 不足的，缺乏的 not containing or having enough of something

es.e: Women who are dieting can become iron deficient.
es.c: 节食的女性有可能缺铁。

d: n 无能 lack of the ability or skill to do a job properly

es.e: The incompetence of government officials is appalling.
es.c: 政府官员的无能令人吃惊。

d: v 使具有资格 to give someone the official right to do or have something

es.e: If the warranty is limited, the terms may entitle you to a replacement or refund.
es.c: 如果保修单有限制，这些条款可让你有权换货或退款。

d: n 冒险者 someone who enjoys adventure

es.e: an adventurer travelling the world
es.c: 周游世界的冒险家

d: v 加快 to become quicker or make something quicker

es.e: Ray glanced at his watch and quickened his pace (= began to walk faster ).
es.c: 雷瞥了一眼手表，加快了步伐。

es.e: Companies are finding it hard to cope with the quickening pace of technological change.
es.c: 各家公司都发现科技的日新月异让他们难以应付。

d: v 使转向；转移注意力 to change the direction in which something travels

es.e: The high street is closed and traffic is being diverted .
es.c: 大街封闭，车辆正改道而行。

es.e: He’d been trying to divert suspicion away from himself.
es.c: 他一直试图转移别人对他的怀疑

d: v 推荐 to say that something or someone is good, or suggest them for a particular purpose or job

es.e: I recommend the butter chicken - it’s delicious.
es.c: 我推荐黄油焗鸡，非常好吃。

es.e: Can you recommend a good lawyer?
es.c: 你能介绍一位好律师吗？

d: adj 不可估量的，无法计算的 too great to be calculated

es.e: Her contribution to our work is incalculable.
es.c: 她对我们工作的贡献极大。

d: n 结果 the final result of a meeting, discussion, war etc – used especially when no one knows what it will be until it actually happens

es.e: People who had heard the evidence at the trial were surprised at the outcome.
es.c: 在审判过程中听过证词的人都对此结果感到吃惊。

d: n 脚手架 a set of poles and boards that are built into a structure for workers to stand on when they are working on the outside of a building

es.e: Workers have erected scaffolding around the base of the tower below the roadway.
es.c: 工人们已经在车行道下的塔基四周竖起了脚手架。

d: n 车库 a building for keeping a car in, usually next to or attached to a house

es.e: I’ll just go and put the car in the garage.
es.c: 我把车停到车库去。

es.e: an automatic garage door
es.c: 车库自动门

d: adj 国内的 relating to or happening in one particular country and not involving any other countries

es.e: ...over 100 domestic flights a day to 30 leading U.S. destinations.
es.c: …每天飞往美国30个主要目的地的100多个国内航班。

d: v 培养 to work hard to develop a particular skill, attitude, or quality

es.e: Try to cultivate a more relaxed and positive approach to life.
es.c: 要努力养成更为放松和积极的生活态度。

d: v 制定，规划 to develop something such as a plan or a set of rules, and decide all the details of how it will be done

es.e: He formulated Labour Party education policy in 1922.
es.c: 1922年，他制定了工党教育政策。

d: v 洒 (热血) To shed blood means to kill people in a violent way. If someone sheds their blood, they are killed in a violent way, usually when they are fighting in a war.

es.e: ...young warriors, eager to shed blood.
es.c: …渴望洒热血的年轻武士们。

d: adv 世界范围地，全世界 If something exists or happens worldwide, it exists or happens throughout the world

es.e: His books have sold more than 20 million copies worldwide.
es.c: 他的书在全世界卖出了两千多万本。

d: n 小题大做 anxious behaviour or activity that is usually about unimportant things

es.e: James said he’d better be getting back or there’d be a fuss .
es.c: 詹姆斯说他最好回来，否则就会有人小题大做了。

es.e: The Steamatic enables you to clean any carpet with the minimum of fuss .
es.c: 蒸汽清洁器可以让你轻轻松松地清洁地毯。

d: n 争论 argument and disagreement between people

es.e: The issue of hunting is a source of contention.
es.c: 狩猎问题是争论的焦点。

d: v 劫持 to use violence or threats to take control of a plane, vehicle, or ship

es.e: The airliner was hijacked by a group of terrorists.
es.c: 该航班被一帮恐怖分子劫持。

d: n 居住者 a person or animal that lives in a particular place

es.e: City dwellers suffer higher pollution levels.
es.c: 城市居民承受的污染程度更严重。

d: v 反对 to oppose something in a direct way；n 美元 a US, Canadian, or Australian dollar

es.e: He was a rebel who bucked the system (=  opposed rules or authority  ) .
es.c: 他是一个反抗体制的叛逆者。

es.e: He owes me ten bucks.
es.c: 他欠我十美元。

d: v 看待 to think about something or someone in a particular way

es.e: The law should be viewed as a way of meeting certain social goals.
es.c: 这项法规应被视为实现某些社会目标的一种途径。

es.e: It’s an issue that can be viewed from several perspectives.
es.c: 这是一个可从多个角度来看待的问题。

d: n 代词 a word that is used instead of a noun or noun phrase, such as ‘he’ instead of ‘Peter’ or ‘the man’

es.e: demonstrative/interrogative/possessive/relative pronouns
es.c: 指示 / 疑问 / 物主 / 关系代词

d: n 贡献 something that you give or do in order to help something be successful

es.e: Einstein was awarded the Nobel Prize for his contribution to Quantum Theory.
es.c: 爱因斯坦因对量子论的贡献而获授诺贝尔奖。

es.e: The school sees its job as preparing students to make a contribution to society.
es.c: 这所学校以培养学生为社会作贡献为己任。

d: adj 不确定的 not having made a decision about something important

es.e: After college she was still undecided as to what career she wanted to pursue.
es.c: 大学毕业后她仍无法决定自己要追求什么事业。

d: v 限制 to limit or control the size, amount, or range of something

es.e: The new law restricts the sale of hand guns.
es.c: 新法规限制手枪的销售。

es.e: You may need to restrict access to certain files (= limit the number of people who can read them ) .
es.c: 某些档案可能需要限制查阅。

es.e: The agreement will restrict competition.
es.c: 这个协议将限制竞争。

d: adj 相反的 the opposite order etc to what is usual or to what has just been stated

es.e: The results were read out in reverse order (= with the worst first and the best last ) .
es.c: 成绩是按逆序宣读的。

d: v 理解；抓住 to completely understand a fact or an idea, especially a complicated one

es.e: At that time, we did not fully grasp the significance of what had happened.
es.c: 当时，我们没有完全明白所发生之事的重要性。

es.e: Some people find the idea of relativity difficult to grasp.
es.c: 有些人觉得相对论的概念很难理解。

es.e: I grasped his arm firmly and led him away.
es.c: 我紧紧抓住他的胳膊把他带走。

d: v 激怒 to make someone angry, especially deliberately

es.e: The dog would not have attacked if it hadn’t been provoked.
es.c: 如果不是被惹恼了，那狗原本不会攻击的。

es.e: Paul tried to provoke Fletch into a fight.
es.c: 保罗试图激怒弗莱琪打一架。

d: n 质地 the way a surface or material feels when you touch it, especially how smooth or rough it is

es.e: This cloth has a silky texture.
es.c: 这种布具有丝的质地。

es.e: the smooth texture of silk
es.c: 丝绸的光滑质感

d: n 宣传 Publicity is information or actions that are intended to attract the public's attention to someone or something

es.e: Much advance publicity was given to the talks.
es.c: 会谈之前做了大量的宣传。

es.e: ...government publicity campaigns.
es.c: …政府的宣传活动。

d: n 形式 the way in which something such as a television show or meeting is organized or arranged

es.e: The courses were run to a consistent format.
es.c: 这些课程的编排是有连续性的。

d: adj 冷漠的 If you accuse someone of being indifferent to something, you mean that they have a complete lack of interest in it

es.e: People have become indifferent to the suffering of others.
es.c: 人们已经变得对别人的痛苦漠不关心。

d: n 刺激 something that encourages you to work harder, start a new activity etc

es.e: As an added incentive, there’s a bottle of champagne for the best team.
es.c: 给最优秀的队发一瓶香槟作为额外的鼓励。

d: n 偏见 an unreasonable dislike and distrust of people who are different from you in some way, especially because of their race, sex, religion etc – used to show disapproval

es.e: Women still face prejudice in the workplace.
es.c: 女性在职场中仍然面临歧视。

es.e: It takes a long time to overcome these kinds of prejudices.
es.c: 战胜这些偏见需要假以时日。

d: n 假设 something that you think is true although you have no definite proof

es.e: A lot of people make the assumption that poverty only exists in the Third World.
es.c: 许多人以为贫困仅仅存在于第三世界。

d: adj 习惯的 usual or typical of someone

es.e: James took his habitual morning walk around the garden.
es.c: 詹姆斯又像往常习惯的那样绕花园作晨间散步去了。

d: n 雕塑 an object made out of stone, wood, clay etc by an artist

es.e: ...stone sculptures of figures and animals.
es.c: …人物及动物石雕。

d: n 责任 a duty to be in charge of someone or something, so that you make decisions and can be blamed if something bad happens

es.e: Kelly’s promotion means more money and more responsibility.
es.c: 凯利获得提升，这意味着钱多了，责任也更大了。

d: n 手稿 a book or piece of writing before it is printed

es.e: Unfortunately, parts of the original manuscript have been lost.
es.c: 遗憾的是，部分原始手稿丢失了。

d: n 副本，复制品 an exact copy of something that you can use in the same way

es.e: She kept both the duplicate and the original.
es.c: 她把复制本和原本都保留着。

d: n 生态系统 all the animals and plants in a particular area, and the way in which they are related to each other and to their environment

es.e: ...the forest ecosystem.
es.c: …森林生态系统。

d: adj 幽默的 funny and enjoyable

es.e: humorous stories
es.c: 诙谐的故事

es.e: The film has some mildly humorous moments.
es.c: 那部电影中有些略显幽默的片段。

d: v 污染，弄脏 to make a place or substance dirty or harmful by putting something such as chemicals or poison in it

es.e: Drinking water supplies are believed to have been contaminated.
es.c: 据信饮用水已受到污染。

d: n 轨道 the curved path travelled by an object which is moving around another much larger object such as the Earth, the Sun etc

es.e: Mars and Earth have orbits which change with time.
es.c: 火星和地球的轨道随着时间而发生改变。

d: v 进化 if an animal or plant evolves, it changes gradually over a long period of time

es.e: Animals have evolved camouflage to protect themselves from predators.
es.c: 动物进化形成了伪装，以保护自身不被捕食性动物所捕食。

d: v 猛增 if a price or an amount skyrockets, it greatly increases very quickly

es.e: The trade deficit has skyrocketed.
es.c: 贸易逆差已经急剧增长。

es.e: skyrocketing inflation
es.c: 飙升的通货膨胀率

d: n 部分 a part of something larger, especially a part that is different from the other parts

es.e: Damage was confined to a small portion of the castle.
es.c: 城堡仅有一小部分受到了损坏。

d: adj 谨慎的 careful to avoid danger or risks

es.e: a cautious driver
es.c: 一位谨慎的司机

es.e: a cautious approach to the crisis
es.c: 处理危机的谨慎态度

es.e: The air-pollution board has reacted with cautious optimism to the announcement.
es.c: 空气污染委员会对这项通告表示谨慎乐观。

d: v 刺杀，暗杀 to murder an important person

es.e: a plot to assassinate the President
es.c: 刺杀总统的阴谋

d: v 变窄，缩小 to make something narrower or to become narrower

es.e: He narrowed his eyes and gazed at the horizon.
es.c: 他眯起眼睛凝望着地平线。

es.e: The track divided into two and narrowed.
es.c: 小道分成两条并且变窄了。

d: adj 植物学的 relating to plants or the scientific study of plants

es.e: The area is of great botanical interest.
es.c: 该地区很有植物学研究价值。

d: v 征服 to get control of a country by fighting

es.e: The Normans conquered England in 1066.
es.c: 诺曼人于 1066 年征服英格兰。

es.e: Egypt was conquered by the Persian king Kambyses.
es.c: 埃及被波斯国王冈比西斯征服。

d: v 重新获得 to get something back, especially an ability or quality, that you have lost

es.e: The family never quite regained its former influence.
es.c: 这个家族再也没有恢复往昔的影响力。

es.e: He somehow managed to regain his balance .
es.c: 他总算恢复了平衡。

es.e: Government forces have regained control of the city.
es.c: 政府军已重新控制了这座城市。

d: n 作文 a short piece of writing about a particular subject, that is done at school

es.e: I had to write a composition about the Royal visit.
es.c: 我得写一篇关于皇室出访的作文。

d: v 强调 to emphasize a statement, fact, or idea

es.e: Crawford stressed the need for more housing downtown.
es.c: 克劳福德强调市中心需要建更多的住宅。

es.e: She stressed the importance of a balanced diet.
es.c: 她强调了均衡饮食的重要性。

d: v 产生 to produce a result, answer, or piece of information

es.e: Our research has only recently begun to yield important results.
es.c: 直到最近我们的研究才开始取得重要成果。

d: n 景象 a very impressive show or scene

es.e: a multimedia dance and opera spectacle
es.c: 盛大的多媒体舞蹈戏剧表演

d: v 主持 to provide the place and everything that is needed for an organized event

es.e: Which country is going to host the next World Cup?
es.c: 哪个国家将主办下一届世界杯？

d: v 释放；发布 to let someone go free, after having kept them somewhere

es.e: Police arrested several men, who were later released.
es.c: 警察逮捕了几个人，后来都释放了。

es.e: The new trade figures have just been released.
es.c: 新的贸易数字刚刚公布。

d: adj 恶毒的 very unkind and cruel, and deliberately behaving in a way that is likely to upset or hurt someone

es.e: a malicious girl
es.c: 恶毒的女孩

d: adj 流行的 existing or accepted in a particular place or at a particular time

es.e: The prevailing mood of public opinion remained hostile.
es.c: 公众仍普遍持敌对情绪。

es.e: the prevailing economic conditions in Northern Ireland
es.c: 北爱尔兰普遍的经济状况

d: n 感激 the feeling of being grateful

es.e: Tears of gratitude filled her eyes.
es.c: 她眼里充满感激的泪水。

d: n 流动性；活动性 the ability to move easily from one job, area, or social class to another

es.e: There is greater mobility of labour (= movement of workers ) between jobs and areas.
es.c: 工作岗位之间和地区之间的劳动力流动性更大了。

es.e: It improves the strength and mobility of joints.
es.c: 它能提高关节的力量和灵活性。

d: v 上升 to move up through the air

es.e: The plane ascended rapidly.
es.c: 飞机迅速爬升。

d: n 假货 a copy of a valuable object, painting etc that is intended to deceive people

es.e: The painting was judged a fake.
es.c: 这幅画被鉴定为赝品。

es.e: Jones can spot a fake from 20 feet away.
es.c: 琼斯在20英尺开外就能认出假货。

d: n 通货膨胀 a continuing increase in prices, or the rate at which prices increase

es.e: Inflation is now at over 16%.
es.c: 通货膨胀率现已超过16%。

d: n 情节 the events that form the main story of a book, film, or play

es.e: The plot was a little confusing.
es.c: 情节有些费解。

es.e: We discover that Jack isn’t as innocent as he seems, as the plot unfolds (= gradually becomes clearer ) .
es.c: 随着情节的展开，我们发现杰克并不像表面上看起来那么清白。

d: v 生产，制造 to use machines to make goods or materials, usually in large numbers or amounts

es.e: the company that manufactured the drug
es.c: 生产这种药的公司

es.e: manufactured goods
es.c: 工业品，制成品

d: n 批评 remarks that say what you think is bad about someone or something

es.e: Despite strong criticism , the new system is still in place.
es.c: 尽管遭到了猛烈的批评，新制度依然原封不动。

es.e: There has been widespread criticism of the decision.
es.c: 这一决定受到了普遍的批评。

es.e: We try to give students constructive criticism .
es.c: 我们设法对学生提出有建设性的批评。

d: v 外包 If a company outsources work or things, it pays workers from outside the company and often outside the country to do the work or supply the things

es.e: ...companies that outsource IT functions.
es.c: …将信息技术方面的工作外包的公司。

es.e: The company began looking for ways to cut costs, which led to the decision to outsource.
es.c: 该公司开始寻找降低成本的途径，这使他们决定外包。

d: n 阻碍 something that makes it difficult to achieve something

es.e: The tax puts obstacles in the way of companies trying to develop trade overseas.
es.c: 这项税收为想在海外发展贸易的公司设置了障碍。

es.e: Women still have to overcome many obstacles to gain equality.
es.c: 妇女要获得平等仍需克服重重障碍。

es.e: We want to remove all obstacles to travel between the two countries.
es.c: 我们想要消除在这两个国家之间旅行的所有障碍。

d: adj 表示赞赏的，感谢的 feeling or showing that you enjoy something or are pleased about it

es.e: There is a murmur of appreciative laughter.
es.c: 有一阵低低的赞赏的笑声。

d: adv 占主导地位地 You use predominantly to indicate which feature or quality is most noticeable in a situation

es.e: The landscape has remained predominantly rural in appearance.
es.c: 该风景看上去主要保留了乡村风貌。

d: n 入侵 when the army of one country enters another country by force, in order to take control of it

es.e: the invasion of Normandy
es.c: 对诺曼底的入侵

d: v 发现 to notice or discover something, especially something that is not easy to see, hear etc

es.e: Many forms of cancer can be cured if detected early.
es.c: 如果发现得早，许多种癌症都可以治愈。

d: n 吸毒上瘾者；对…着迷的人 someone who is unable to stop taking drugs

es.e: a recovering heroin addict
es.c: 一个正在康复的海洛因吸食者

es.e: My nephew is a complete video game addict.
es.c: 我侄子绝对是个电子游戏迷。

d: v 猛削，劈，砍；削减 to cut or try to cut something violently with a knife, sword etc

es.e: Someone had slashed the tires.
es.c: 有人把轮胎割破了。

es.e: The workforce has been slashed by 50%.
es.c: 劳动力已削减了 50%。

d: adj 认知的 related to the process of knowing, understanding, and learning something

es.e: cognitive psychology
es.c: 认知心理学

d: v 熄灭；使消亡 to make a fire or light stop burning or shining

es.e: Please extinguish all cigarettes.
es.c: 请把香烟都熄灭了。

es.e: Firemen were called to extinguish the blaze.
es.c: 有人打电话叫消防队员来扑灭大火。

es.e: All hope was almost extinguished.
es.c: 所有的希望都快要破灭了。

d: n 缺点，不利条件 something that causes problems, or that makes someone or something less likely to be successful or effective

es.e: Criminal behaviour can be linked to economic disadvantage.
es.c: 犯罪行为可能会与经济困难有关。

d: adj 陌生的 very different from what you are used to, especially in a way that is difficult to understand or accept

es.e: the alien environment of the city
es.c: 城里陌生的环境

d: adv 几乎不，仅仅 almost not

es.e: She was barely aware of his presence.
es.c: 她几乎没有注意到他的存在。

es.e: Joe and his brother are barely on speaking terms.
es.c: 乔和他哥哥几乎不说话。

d: v 模拟，模仿 to make or produce something that is not real but has the appearance or feeling of being real

es.e: a machine that simulates conditions in space
es.c: 一台模拟太空环境的机器

es.e: Interviews can be simulated in the classroom.
es.c: 可以在教室里模拟面试。

d: adj 预期的；未来的 expected to do sth or to become sth

es.e: a prospective buyer
es.c: 可能的买主

es.e: They are worried about prospective changes in the law.
es.c: 他们担心即将修改法律。

d: n 相互影响，相互作用；互动 a process by which two or more things affect each other

es.e: Price is determined through the interaction of demand and supply.
es.c: 价格是通过供需消长而定的。

es.e: the degree of interaction between teacher and student
es.c: 师生之间交流的程度

d: v 实现 to happen or appear in the way that you expected

es.e: Problems were expected, but they never materialized.
es.c: 估计会有问题，但一直没有发生。

es.e: The money we had been promised failed to materialize .
es.c: 答应给我们的钱并没有兑现。

d: v 有助于，促成；捐赠 to help to make something happen

es.e: Enya’s success has contributed substantially to the current interest in Celtic music.
es.c: 时下人们对凯尔特音乐感兴趣，这很大程度上要归功于恩雅的成功。

es.e: City employees cannot contribute to political campaigns.
es.c: 市政府雇员不得捐助政治宣传活动。

d: adj 不诚实的 not honest, and so deceiving or cheating people

es.e: dishonest traders
es.c: 奸商

es.e: People on welfare are wrongly seen as lazy or dishonest.
es.c: 靠福利救济的人被误以为懒惰或不老实。

d: n 请求，呼吁,；上诉 an urgent request for something important

es.e: The girl’s family have made a public appeal for help to try and catch her killer.
es.c: 那名遇害女孩的家人吁请公众协助捉拿凶手。

es.e: an appeal to the European Court of Human Rights
es.c: 向欧洲人权法庭提出的上诉

d: n 申请者 someone who has formally asked, usually in writing, for a job, university place etc

es.e: We have had lots of applicants for these positions.
es.c: 对这些职位我们已有了很多申请人。

d: adj 聪明的 an intelligent person has a high level of mental ability and is good at understanding ideas and thinking clearly

es.e: a group of highly intelligent (= very intelligent )students
es.c: 一组聪明异常的学生

es.e: Sontag was once famously described as the most intelligent woman in America.
es.c: 桑塔格曾被称为美国最聪明的女人，这是众人皆知的事。

d: adj 宽敞的 a spacious house, room etc is large and has plenty of space to move around in

es.e: a spacious living area
es.c: 宽敞的居住空间

d: adj 致命的 resulting in someone’s death

es.e: potentially fatal diseases
es.c: 潜在致命的疾病

es.e: If it is not treated correctly, the condition can prove fatal (= be fatal ) .
es.c: 如果治疗不当，这种病可能会致命。

d: n 咨询顾问 A counselor is a person whose job is to give advice to people who need it, especially advice on their personal problems.

es.e: For some people, a paid career counselor or coach is the best approach.
es.c: 对有些人来说，付钱请职业顾问或教练是最好的方法。

d: adj 潜在的 likely to develop into a particular type of person or thing in the future；n 潜力 the possibility that something will develop in a particular way, or have a particular effect

es.e: The company has identified 60 potential customers.
es.c: 该公司已确定了60位潜在的客户。

es.e: The company certainly has the potential for growth.
es.c: 那家公司肯定有发展潜力。

d: v 同化 if people assimilate, or are assimilated into a country or group, they become part of that group and are accepted by the people in that group

es.e: Refugees find it difficult to become assimilated into the community.
es.c: 难民觉得难以融入社区。

d: n 农田 an area of land on which crops are grown

es.e: Forests had been cut or burned to provide additional cropland.
es.c: 为了扩大农田,许多森林遭到砍伐和焚烧。

d: adj 轻松的，缓解的 feeling happy because you are no longer worried about something

es.e: A relieved smile spread over his face.
es.c: 他脸上绽开了宽慰的笑容。

d: v 强迫 to force someone to do something

es.e: ...the introduction of legislation to compel cyclists to wear a helmet.
es.c: …强制骑车人戴头盔的法律的引入。

d: v 计划，安排 a series of actions which are designed to achieve something important

es.e: Who's behind this program?
es.c: 谁支持这项计划?

d: n 能力；容量 someone’s ability to do something

es.e: a child’s capacity for learning
es.c: 孩子的学习能力

es.e: a capacity to think in an original way
es.c: 创造性的思维能力

es.e: The room had seating capacity for about 80.
es.c: 这房间能坐80个人左右。

d: v 使确定方向；使适应 to find exactly where you are by looking around you or using a map

es.e: She looked at the street names, trying to orient herself.
es.c: 她看看街名，试图确定自己的方位。

es.e: It takes new students a while to orientate themselves to college life.
es.c: 新生要经过一段时间才能适应大学生活。

d: n 任务，事情 an important job, piece of work, or activity that you are responsible for

es.e: Starting a new business can be a risky undertaking.
es.c: 创办新企业有时是一件有风险的事情。

d: v 转移注意力；转变 to change a situation, discussion etc by giving special attention to one idea or subject instead of to a previous one

es.e: The White House hopes to shift the media’s attention away from foreign policy issues.
es.c: 白宫希望把媒体的注意力从外交政策问题上转移开。

es.e: Attitudes to mental illness have shifted in recent years.
es.c: 对精神病的态度近年来已稍微有所改变。

d: n 解放 the seeking of equal status or just treatment for or on behalf of any group believed to be discriminated against

es.e: They pant after liberation.
es.c: 他们渴望解放。

es.e: All his life was submerged in the liberation of the people.
es.c: 他的一生全部献身于人民的解放事业。

es.e: They consecrated their lives to the liberation of their motherland.
es.c: 他们把生命献给了祖国的解放事业。

d: adv 完全地，彻底地 completely – used especially to emphasize that something is very bad, or that a feeling is very strong

es.e: You look utterly miserable.
es.c: 你看起来很痛苦。

d: adj 巨大的 extremely large

es.e: People who travel by rail still read an immense amount.
es.c: 人们坐火车旅行时仍然会读很多书。

es.e: Regular visits from a social worker can be of immense value to old people living alone.
es.c: 对于独居老人来说社工的经常探望很重要。

d: adj 比……差 not good, or not as good as someone or something else

es.e: I felt very inferior among all those academics.
es.c: 与那些大学教师在一起，我自惭形秽。

d: v 积累 if money accrues or is accrued, it gradually increases over a period of time

es.e: Interest will accrue until payment is made.
es.c: 利息将会累计增加，直至付清款项。

d: adj 真的；由衷的 a genuine feeling, desire etc is one that you really feel, not one you pretend to feel

es.e: ‘Did he really?’ Her surprise seemed genuine.
es.c: “他真的这样？”她好像是真的惊讶。

d: v 提名 to officially suggest someone or something for an important position, duty, or prize

es.e: This week one of them will be nominated by the Democratic Party for the presidency of the United States.
es.c: 本周他们中的一人将被民主党提名为美国总统职位的候选人。

d: adj 与众不同的 having a special quality, character, or appearance that is different and easy to recognize

es.e: a rock band with a distinctive sound
es.c: 音色独特的摇滚乐队

d: n 管理不当 Someone's mismanagement of a system or organization is the bad way they have dealt with it or organized it

es.e: His gross mismanagement left the company desperately in need of restructuring.
es.c: 他处理事务的严重不当使得公司急需重组。

d: v 认为，评价 spoken to think or suppose something

es.e: ‘There’s nothing we can do about it.’ ‘You reckon (= used to express doubt or disagreement ) ?’
es.c: “这件事我们无能为力。”“是吗？”

d: n 面具 something that covers all or part of your face, to protect or to hide it；v 掩饰，掩盖 to hide your feelings or the truth about a situation

es.e: a surgical face mask
es.c: 外科手术口罩

es.e: Men often mask their true feelings with humour.
es.c: 男人常常用幽默来掩饰他们真实的情感。

d: v 伪造；锻造 to illegally copy something, especially something printed or written, to make people think that it is real

es.e: Someone stole my credit card and forged my signature.
es.c: 有人偷了我的信用卡，并假冒我的签名。

es.e: swords forged from steel
es.c: 用钢锻造的刀剑

d: adj 相同的 exactly the same, or very similar

es.e: four identical houses
es.c: 四幢一模一样的房子

d: adj 帝国的 relating to an empire or to the person who rules it

es.e: Britain’s imperial expansion in the 19th century
es.c: 19世纪英帝国的扩张

d: n 目标 something that you are trying to achieve, such as a total, an amount, or a time；v 把…作为目标 to make something have an effect on a particular limited group or area

es.e: There is no target date for completion of the new project.
es.c: 这个新的项目何时完工没有预定日期。

es.e: The government may fail to meet (= achieve ) its target of recycling 25% of domestic waste.
es.c: 政府可能达不到回收利用25%的生活垃圾的目标。

es.e: The programme is targeted at improving the health of women of all ages.
es.c: 该计划的目的是提高各年龄层妇女的健康水平。

d: v 断开 to remove the supply of power, gas, water etc from a machine or piece of equipment

es.e: The family agreed to disconnect her life support system.
es.c: 家人同意切断她的生命维持系统。

d: n 移民 someone who enters another country to live there permanently

es.e: an illegal immigrant
es.c: 非法移民

es.e: a new wave of immigrants from the Middle East
es.c: 来自中东的一股新兴的移民浪潮

d: adj 不合格的，不胜任的 not having the right knowledge, experience, or education to do something

es.e: unqualified staff
es.c: 不合格的员工

d: v 编校；编辑；剪辑 to prepare a book, piece of film etc for printing or broadcasting by removing mistakes or parts that are not acceptable

es.e: I know that this draft text will need to be edited.
es.c: 我知道这篇草稿需要校订。

es.e: a collection of essays edited by John Gay
es.c: 由约翰·盖伊编辑的论文集

es.e: He taught me to edit and splice film.
es.c: 他教我剪辑合成影片。

d: v 管理 to officially and legally control a country and make all the decisions about taxes, laws, public services etc

es.e: the leaders who govern the country
es.c: 治理这个国家的领导人

es.e: The party had been governing for seven months.
es.c: 该党执政已经有七个月了。

d: v 主张，断言 to state firmly that something is true

es.e: French cooking, she asserted, is the best in the world.
es.c: 她坚称法国菜是世界上最好的。

d: adj 轻松愉快的 a breezy person is happy, confident, and relaxed

es.e: a breezy and relaxed air of confidence
es.c: 轻松自信的神态

d: v 犹豫 If you hesitate, you do not speak or act for a short time, usually because you are uncertain, embarrassed, or worried about what you are going to say or do.

es.e: So if someone asks you out, never hesitate.
es.c: 如果有人叫你出去玩，千万别犹豫！

es.e: I hesitate.
es.c: 我犹豫。

es.e: I hesitate in this work.
es.c: 我在这个作品中有所犹豫。

d: n 总统任期 the position of being the president of a country or organization, or the period of time during which someone is president

es.e: Roosevelt was elected four times to the presidency of the US.
es.c: 罗斯福四次当选美国总统。

es.e: There were few real improvements during his presidency.
es.c: 在他的总统任期内几乎没有什么真正的改善。

d: n 配额 an official limit on the number or amount of something that is allowed in a particular period

es.e: The government has decided to scrap quotas on car imports.
es.c: 政府决定取消汽车进口配额。

es.e: There are plans to introduce strict immigration quotas.
es.c: 有计划要推行严格的移民限额制度。

d: n 辍学学生 someone who leaves school or college before they have finished

es.e: a high school dropout
es.c: 中学退学者

d: v 逮捕；捕捉 to catch a person and keep them as a prisoner

es.e: Government troops have succeeded in capturing the rebel leader.
es.c: 政府军已经成功抓获叛乱分子的头目。

es.e: 40 captured French soldiers
es.c: 40名被俘虏的法国士兵

es.e: These photographs capture the essence of working-class life at the turn of the century.
es.c: 这些相片捕捉到了世纪之交工人阶级生活的神韵。

d: n 正直 the quality of being honest and strong about what you believe to be right

es.e: I have always regarded him as a man of integrity.
es.c: 我一直把他当作一个正直诚实的人。

d: v 离开 to leave somewhere very quickly, in order to escape from danger

es.e: His attackers turned and fled.
es.c: 袭击他的人转身逃走了。

es.e: Masaari spent six months in prison before fleeing the country .
es.c: 正有蹲了六个月监狱，然后逃出了该国。

d: n 证书 an official document that says that someone is allowed to do a certain job, that something is of good quality etc

es.e: We successfully completed the certification for open water diving.
es.c: 我们成功地拿到了开放水域潜水证书。

d: adj 立即的 happening or produced immediately

es.e: an instant success
es.c: 马到成功

es.e: a system that provides instant access to client information
es.c: 能立即查到客户信息的系统

es.e: The women took an instant dislike to one another.
es.c: 这些女人立刻就彼此厌恶起来。

d: adj 犯罪的 relating to crime；n 罪犯 someone who is involved in illegal activities or has been proved guilty of a crime

es.e: Experts cannot agree on the causes of criminal behaviour .
es.c: 专家对犯罪行为的原因不能取得一致意见。

es.e: I was sure he was involved in some kind of criminal activity .
es.c: 我肯定他在从事某种犯罪活动。

es.e: She has not committed a criminal offence (= a crime ) .
es.c: 她没有犯罪。

d: n 线索 an object or piece of information that helps someone solve a crime or mystery

es.e: Police have found a vital clue .
es.c: 警方发现了至关重要的线索。

es.e: Archaeological evidence will provide clues about what the building was used for.
es.c: 考古证据将为这幢建筑的用途提供线索。

es.e: a desperate search for clues
es.c: 拼命寻找线索

d: adj 傲慢无礼的 behaving in an unpleasant or rude way because you think you are more important than other people

es.e: He was unbearably arrogant.
es.c: 他的傲慢让人无法忍受。

es.e: an arrogant attitude
es.c: 傲慢的态度

d: v 提升；举起 to move someone or something to a more important level or rank, or make them better than before

es.e: Language has elevated humans above the other animals.
es.c: 语言使人类高于其他动物。

es.e: Gradually elevate the patient into an upright position.
es.c: 把病人慢慢托到直立的位置。

d: n 扩张；扩大 when a company, business etc becomes larger by opening new shops, factories etc

es.e: The industry underwent a period of rapid expansion.
es.c: 该产业经历了一轮快速扩张。

es.e: The rapid expansion of cities can cause social and economic problems.
es.c: 城市规模的迅速扩大会带来各种社会和经济问题。

d: n 权威；当局 the power you have because of your official position

es.e: Only the president has the authority to declare war.
es.c: 只有总统才有权宣战。

es.e: an agreement between the US and Colombian authorities
es.c: 美国和哥伦比亚当局的一份协议

d: v 宣传 to give information about something to the public, so that they know about it

es.e: television’s failure to publicize the unemployment issue
es.c: 电视未能报道失业问题

d: adj 反映的，反射的；深思熟虑的 a reflective surface reflects light

es.e: Stick reflective tape on your school bag.
es.c: 给你的书包贴上反光带。

es.e: She was in a reflective mood.
es.c: 她陷入沉思。

d: n 数量 an amount of something that can be counted or measured

es.e: Your work has improved in quantity and quality this term.
es.c: 这学期你的作业在完成数量和质量上都有提高。

d: adv 强烈地 feeling or noticing something very strongly

es.e: Students are becoming acutely aware that they need more than just paper qualifications.
es.c: 学生越来越强烈地意识到他们需要的不仅是一纸文凭。

d: v 使隔离 to separate one person, group, or thing from other people or things

es.e: The town was isolated by the floods.
es.c: 洪水使该镇与外界隔绝。

es.e: The US has sought to isolate Cuba both economically and politically.
es.c: 美国一直想在经济和政治上孤立古巴。

d: adj 积极的；精力充沛的 using a lot of energy and strength or determination

es.e: Your dog needs at least 20 minutes of vigorous exercise every day.
es.c: 你的狗每天需要进行至少20分钟的剧烈运动。

es.e: Environmentalists have begun a vigorous campaign to oppose nuclear dumping in the area.
es.c: 环保人士已经发动了一场积极的运动，反对在该地区倾倒核废物。

es.e: a vigorous debate
es.c: 一场激烈的辩论

d: v 建议，忠告 to advise someone

es.e: My advisers counselled me to do nothing.
es.c: 我的顾问建议我不要做任何事情。

d: adj 生动的 vivid memories, dreams, descriptions etc are so clear that they seem real

es.e: I’ve got vivid memories of that summer.
es.c: 我对那年夏天记忆犹新。

es.e: He had a vivid picture of her in his mind.
es.c: 他的脑海中清晰地留着她的形象。

d: n 敌意 when someone is unfriendly and full of anger towards another person

es.e: The last decade has witnessed a serious rise in the levels of racism and hostility to black and ethnic groups.
es.c: 过去的10年里，种族主义及对黑人和少数民族的敌意变得更加严重了。

d: v 合作 to work together with a person or group in order to achieve something, especially in science or art

es.e: During the late seventies, he collaborated with the legendary Muddy Waters.
es.c: 70年代后期，他和大名鼎鼎的马迪•沃特斯合作过。

d: n 商议 a discussion in which people who are affected by or involved in something can give their opinions

es.e: They retired to another room for private consultation.
es.c: 他们退到另一房间秘密磋商。

es.e: This is a critical question that we must answer together through consultation and coordination.
es.c: 这是一个我们必须通过磋商和协调共同回答的关键问题。

d: n 过渡 when something changes from one form or state to another

es.e: Making the transition from youth to adulthood can be very painful.
es.c: 从青少年过渡到成年有时是一个非常痛苦的过程。

es.e: a society that is in transition
es.c: 一个正在转型的社会

es.e: the period of transition to full democracy
es.c: 向全面民主的过渡时期

d: v 恶化 to become worse

es.e: Ethel’s health has deteriorated.
es.c: 埃塞尔的健康状况恶化了。

es.e: America’s deteriorating economy
es.c: 美国日渐恶化的经济

d: n 牧场 land or a field that is covered with grass and is used for cattle, sheep etc to feed on

es.e: large areas of rough upland pasture
es.c: 大片起伏的山地牧场

es.e: the lush pastures of the southern counties
es.c: 南部各郡茂盛的牧场

d: n 目击者 someone who has seen something such as a crime happen, and is able to describe it afterwards

es.e: One eyewitness said he saw her talking to a man in a blue car.
es.c: 一名目击者说他看见她在跟一个坐在蓝色汽车里的男子说话。

d: n 特点 a particular quality in someone’s character

es.e: The study found that some alcoholics had clear personality traits showing up early in childhood.
es.c: 这项研究发现一些酗酒者早在孩童时就表现出明显的个性特征。

d: v 期望，预期 to expect that something will happen and be ready for it

es.e: Sales are better than anticipated.
es.c: 销量比预期要好。

es.e: A good speaker is able to anticipate an audience’s needs and concerns.
es.c: 好的演讲者能够预先考虑到听众需要什么、关注什么。

d: adj 无数的 If people or things are numerous, they exist or are present in large numbers.

es.e: Numerous attempts have been made to hide the truth.
es.c: 为掩盖事实作了很多尝试。

d: n 组合，结合 two or more different things that exist together or are used or put together

es.e: A combination of factors may be responsible for the increase in cancer.
es.c: 各种因素的综合作用可能导致了癌症发病率的上升。

d: adv 轻微地 Slightly means to some degree but not to a very large degree

es.e: His family then moved to a slightly larger house.
es.c: 他的家后来搬到了一间稍微大一点儿的房子。

es.e: Each person learns in a slightly different way.
es.c: 每个人学习的方式都略有不同。

d: n 分红，红利 a part of a company’s profit that is divided among the people with shares in the company

es.e: The first quarter dividend has been increased by nearly 4 percent.
es.c: 第一季度的股息增加了近4％。

d: adj 最低的，最小限度的 very small in degree or amount, especially the smallest degree or amount possible

es.e: The storm caused only minimal damage.
es.c: 暴风雨只造成了轻微破坏。

es.e: The cost to taxpayers would be minimal.
es.c: 纳税人的支出将是最少的。

es.e: This is a practical course, with only a minimal amount of theory.
es.c: 这是实践课程，只有少量理论。

d: v 脱轨 if a train derails or something derails it, it goes off the tracks

es.e: At least six people were killed and about twenty injured when a train was derailed in an isolated mountain region.
es.c: 火车在一片偏僻的山区脱轨，导致至少六人死亡，约二十人受伤。

d: n 障碍，阻碍 a rule, problem etc that prevents people from doing something, or limits what they can do

es.e: He advocated the removal of trade barriers.
es.c: 他提倡消除贸易壁垒。

d: n 创造力 skill at inventing things and thinking of new ideas

es.e: Inspecting the nest can be difficult and may require some ingenuity.
es.c: 仔细检查鸟巢可能有困难，也许需要一些巧妙的心思。

d: v 贿赂 to illegally give someone, especially a public official, money or a gift in order to persuade them to do something for you

es.e: The only way we could get into the country was by bribing the border officials.
es.c: 我们要进入这个国家，唯一的办法是贿赂边境官员。

d: n 大概估计，瞎猜估计 an attempt to judge a quantity by guessing it

es.e: Could you give us a guesstimate of the numbers involved?
es.c: 你能给我们大致估计一下相关数字吗？

d: n 协商 official discussions between the representatives of opposing groups who are trying to reach an agreement, especially in business or politics

es.e: The trader was obstinate in the negotiation.
es.c: 这个商人在谈判中拗强固执。

d: n 艰难 something that makes your life difficult or unpleasant, especially a lack of money, or the condition of having a difficult life

es.e: an economic policy that caused great hardship for many people
es.c: 造成许多人贫困的经济政策

es.e: Many students are suffering severe financial hardship.
es.c: 许多学生经济非常困难。

d: n 标记, 徽章 a small piece of metal, cloth, or plastic with a picture or words on it, worn to show rank, membership of a group, support for a political idea etc

es.e: We were each handed a badge with our name on it.
es.c: 我们每个人都拿到一个徽章，上面有我们的名字。

d: v 妥协 to reach an agreement in which everyone involved accepts less than what they wanted at first

es.e: She admitted that she was unable to compromise.
es.c: 她承认自己无法作出妥协。

d: n 过量，过度 a larger amount of something than is allowed or needed

es.e: After you apply the oil, wait 20 minutes before wiping off any excess.
es.c: 涂上油以后，等20分钟再擦掉多余部分。

d: n 子孙后代 someone who is related to a person who lived a long time ago, or to a family, group of people etc that existed in the past

es.e: He was a direct descendant of Napoleon Bonaparte.
es.c: 他是拿破仑·波拿巴的嫡系后裔。

d: v 实现 if you fulfill a hope, wish, or aim, you achieve the thing that you hoped for, wished for etc

es.e: Visiting Disneyland has fulfilled a boyhood dream.
es.c: 迪士尼乐园之游使童年梦想成真。

es.e: Being deaf hasn’t stopped Karen fulfilling her ambition to be a hairdresser.
es.c: 失聪并没有阻止卡伦实现当美发师的抱负。

d: adj 共同的 shared or made by every member of a group or society

es.e: a collective decision made by all board members
es.c: 董事会所有成员作出的集体决定

es.e: our collective responsibility for the environment
es.c: 我们对环境的共同责任

d: v 修订 to correct or make small changes to something that is written or spoken

es.e: The law was amended to include women.
es.c: 该法律经修改把女性也包括在内。

es.e: The defendant later amended his evidence.
es.c: 被告后来修改了证词。

es.e: ‘Steve stole it – or rather borrowed it,’ he amended.
es.c: “史蒂夫偷的——应该说是借的。”他改口道。

d: adj 纠缠的；复杂的 twisted together in an untidy mass

es.e: Your bedclothes are all tangled up.
es.c: 你的床褥乱糟糟的。

es.e: He had hair like tangled string.
es.c: 他的头发就像一团乱麻。

es.e: the tangled web of local politics
es.c: 地方政坛错综复杂的关系网

d: n 资格 if you have a qualification, you have passed an examination or course to show you have a particular level of skill or knowledge in a subject

es.e: He left school without any qualifications.
es.c: 他离校时没有拿到任何文凭。

d: v 回忆起，想起 to remember a particular fact, event, or situation from the past

es.e: You don’t happen to recall his name, do you?
es.c: 你不会恰巧还想得起他的名字吧？

es.e: As I recall, it was you who suggested this idea in the first place.
es.c: 我记得，是你首先提出这个想法的。

d: v 采纳 to start to deal with or think about something in a particular way

es.e: The courts were asked to adopt a more flexible approach to young offenders.
es.c: 法庭被要求对少年犯采取更为灵活的处理方法。

es.e: The store recently adopted a drug testing policy for all new employees.
es.c: 这家商店近来实行新雇员一律要做药检的政策。

es.e: California has adopted a tough stance on the issue.
es.c: 加利福尼亚州对这一问题持强硬立场。

d: adj 没有味道的 food or drink that is tasteless is unpleasant because it has no particular taste

es.e: How can you eat such tasteless food?
es.c: 你怎么能吃下这么无味的食物呢？

d: v 溺水 to die from being under water for too long, or to kill someone in this way

es.e: Many people drowned when the boat overturned.
es.c: 船翻后许多人淹死了。

es.e: Jane was drowned in the river.
es.c: 简在那条河里溺水身亡。

d: n 悲剧 a very sad event, that shocks people because it involves death

es.e: The tragedy happened as they were returning home from a night out.
es.c: 悲剧发生在他们夜里外出归来的路上。

es.e: Tragedy struck the family when their two-year-old son was killed in an accident.
es.c: 悲剧降临到这个家庭，他们两岁的儿子在一次事故中丧生。

d: n 发行量 the average number of copies of a newspaper or magazine that are usually sold each day, week, month etc

es.e: The Daily News once had the highest circulation of any daily in the country.
es.c: 《每日新闻报》一度在该国所有日报中拥有最高发行量。

d: adj 壮丽的，极好的 big and very impressive

es.e: a grand country house
es.c: 豪华的乡间大宅

es.e: The party was a grand affair.
es.c: 这个聚会场面隆重。

es.e: New Yorkers build on a grand scale.
es.c: 纽约人喜欢建高楼大厦。

d: adj 不足的 not good enough, big enough, skilled enough etc for a particular purpose

es.e: inadequate resources
es.c: 资源缺乏

es.e: The new air conditioning system proved inadequate.
es.c: 新的空调系统不够好。

d: n 家庭，一家人 all the people who live together in one house

es.e: A growing number of households have at least one computer.
es.c: 越来越多的家庭拥有至少一台电脑。

es.e: Families are classified by the occupation of the head of the household (= the person who earns the most money and is most respected in a house ) .
es.c: 家庭按一家之主的职业来分类。

d: n 授权 official permission to do something, or the document giving this permission

es.e: You need special authorization to park here.
es.c: 在此停车要有特别的许可。

es.e: Children may not leave the building without the authorization of the principal.
es.c: 没有校长的许可，孩子们不能离开这幢楼。

d: adj 辅助的 auxiliary workers provide additional help for another group of workers

es.e: an auxiliary nurse
es.c: 助理护士

es.e: auxiliary staff
es.c: 辅助员工

d: adj 不利的 not good or favourable

es.e: They fear it could have an adverse effect on global financial markets.
es.c: 他们担心这会对全球金融市场产生不利影响。

es.e: Miller’s campaign has received a good deal of adverse publicity.
es.c: 米勒的竞选活动招来许多负面报道。

d: adj 描写的，描述的 giving a description of something

es.e: the descriptive passages in the novel
es.c: 小说中的描写性段落

d: v 追踪 to find the origin or cause of sth

es.e: The police traced the call (= used special electronic equipment to find out who made the telephone call) to her ex-husband's number.
es.c: 警方用追踪装置查出是她前夫的电话号码打出的电话。

d: v 开花，茂盛 if a plant or a flower blooms, its flowers appear or open

es.e: Most roses will begin to bloom from late May.
es.c: 大多数玫瑰从五月末开始开花。

d: v 评价 to judge how good, useful, or successful something is

es.e: You should be able to evaluate your own work.
es.c: 你应该能够评估自己的工作。

es.e: We need to evaluate the success of the campaign.
es.c: 我们要评估一下这次运动是否成功。

es.e: It can be difficult to evaluate the effectiveness of different treatments.
es.c: 要对各种治疗方法的效果作出评估会很难。

d: adj 人文的 A humanistic idea, condition, or practice relates to humanism

es.e: Religious values can often differ greatly from humanistic morals.
es.c: 宗教价值观常常和人文主义道德观相去甚远。

d: adj 舒适的 a place that is cozy is small, comfortable, and warm

es.e: The living room was warm and cozy.
es.c: 客厅暖和又舒适。

d: n 犁 a piece of farm equipment used to turn over the earth so that seeds can be planted

es.e: There are new tractors and new ploughs in the machinery lot.
es.c: 机器设备场里有新拖拉机和新耕犁。

d: v 融化 if something solid melts or if heat melts it, it becomes liquid

es.e: It was warmer now, and the snow was beginning to melt.
es.c: 现在天气暖和了，雪开始融化。

es.e: Melt the butter in a saucepan.
es.c: 把黄油放在深平底锅里化开。

d: conj 以免 in order to make sure that something will not happen

es.e: She turned away from the window lest anyone see them.
es.c: 她转身离开窗边，免得有人看见他们。

d: adj 乐意的，愿意的 very willing to do something

es.e: She was ready and willing to work hard.
es.c: 她工作积极肯干。

d: adj 可怕的；令人敬畏的，令人惊叹的 very powerful or impressive, and often frightening

es.e: The building is grey, formidable, not at all picturesque.
es.c: 那幢建筑呈灰色，气势凛然，与漂亮沾不上边。

es.e: The new range of computers have formidable processing power.
es.c: 该系列的新型计算机处理能力惊人。

d: adj 可行的 a plan, idea, or method that is feasible is possible and is likely to work

es.e: a feasible solution
es.c: 可行的解决方法

d: prep 关于 a word used especially in letters or speeches to introduce the subject you are writing or talking about

es.e: Regarding your recent inquiry, I have enclosed a copy of our new brochure.
es.c: 关于你最近的咨询，我随信附上一本我们最新的手册。

d: n 指针；针 a long thin piece of metal on a scientific instrument that moves backwards and forwards and points to numbers or directions

es.e: a compass needle
es.c: 罗盘指针

es.e: a needle and thread
es.c: 针和线

d: n 尺寸；维 the length, height, width, depth, or diameter of something

es.e: a rectangle with the dimensions 5cm × 2cm
es.c: 长五厘米、宽两厘米的长方形

es.e: A diagram represents things in only two dimensions.
es.c: 示意图只能二维地呈现物体。

d: v 专业从事 to limit all or most of your study, business etc to a particular subject or activity

es.e: Simmons specialized in contract law.
es.c: 西蒙斯专攻合同法。

d: v 推翻 if you overturn something, or if it overturns, it turns upside down or falls over on its side

es.e: Leslie jumped to her feet, overturning her chair.
es.c: 莱斯莉一跃而起，碰倒了椅子。

es.e: His car overturned, trapping him inside.
es.c: 他的汽车发生侧翻，把他困在了里面。

d: v 收缩(shrink过去式) to become smaller, or to make something smaller, through the effects of heat or water

es.e: My sweater shrank in the wash.
es.c: 我的毛衣缩水了。

d: adv 不利地

es.e: Her health was adversely affected by the climate.
es.c: 那种气候损害了她的健康。

d: v 检查；阻止 to do something in order to find out whether something really is correct, true, or in good condition

es.e: Check the tiles carefully before you buy them.
es.c: 购买之前要把瓷砖仔细检查一下。

es.e: A first rule in solving any mystery is to check the facts.
es.c: 揭开谜团的第一条规则是核查事实。

es.e: He grinned, and then checked himself, not wanting to upset Jack.
es.c: 他咧嘴一笑，然后克制住自己，因为他不想让杰克不开心。

d: n 证词 a formal statement saying that something is true, especially one a  witness  makes in a court of law

es.e: Barker’s testimony is crucial to the prosecution’s case.
es.c: 巴克的证词对控方的指控起到了关键作用。

es.e: In his testimony, he denied that the company had ignored safety procedures.
es.c: 他在证词中否认公司忽视了安全程序。

d: adj 严格的 careful, thorough, and exact

es.e: a rigorous analysis of defence needs
es.c: 对国防需求的缜密分析

es.e: the rigorous standards required by the college
es.c: 大学规定的严格标准

d: adj 有特权的 having advantages because of your wealth, social position etc

es.e: Students from a privileged background have an advantage at university.
es.c: 出身于特权阶层的学生在大学里具有优势。

es.e: Only the privileged few can afford private education.
es.c: 只有享有特权的少数人才能上得起私立学校。

d: n 期望 a feeling or belief about the way something should be or how someone should behave

es.e: Some people have totally unrealistic expectations of both medical and nursing staff.
es.c: 有些人对医护人员的期望完全不切实际。

es.e: Women who have high expectations of marriage are often disappointed.
es.c: 对婚姻怀有很高期望的女性常常会感到失望。

d: n 偏见 an opinion about whether a person, group, or idea is good or bad that influences how you deal with it

es.e: Students were evaluated without bias.
es.c: 对学生的评估都是公正的。

d: n 诉讼 a problem or complaint that a person or organization brings to a court of law to be settled

es.e: The dispute culminated last week in a lawsuit against the government.
es.c: 这场针对政府诉讼案的争论在上星期达到了高潮。

d: adj 口才好的，雄辩的 able to express your ideas and opinions well, especially in a way that influences people

es.e: an eloquent appeal for support
es.c: 极具说服力的求助呼吁

d: v 缩减，缩小 to become smaller, or to make something smaller, through the effects of heat or water

es.e: I’m worried about washing that shirt in case it shrinks.
es.c: 我不太敢洗那件衬衫，怕它会缩水。

d: n 规则；管理 an official rule or order

es.e: There seem to be so many rules and regulations these days.
es.c: 如今好像条条框框很多。

es.e: regulations governing the safety of toys
es.c: 监控玩具安全的条例

es.e: All companies must comply with the regulations .
es.c: 所有公司都必须遵守规定。

d: n 代替品 If one thing is an alternative to another, the first can be found, used, or done instead of the second

es.e: New ways to treat arthritis may provide an alternative to painkillers.
es.c: 治疗关节炎的新方法可能会提供一种止痛药的替代品。

d: adj 潮湿的 slightly wet, especially in a way that is pleasant or suitable

es.e: Make sure the soil is moist before planting the seeds.
es.c: 播种之前要确保土壤湿润。

es.e: a rich, moist chocolate cake
es.c: 香浓软润的巧克力蛋糕

es.e: warm moist air
es.c: 温暖湿润的空气

d: v 超过 to be even better or greater than someone or something else

es.e: He had surpassed all our expectations .
es.c: 他超越了我们所有的预期。

es.e: The number of multiple births has surpassed 100,000 for the first time.
es.c: 多胎产首次突破了 10 万例。

d: n 布料 cloth used for making clothes, curtains etc

es.e: our new range of fabrics and wallpapers
es.c: 我们新的织物和墙纸系列

d: n 区分 a clear difference or separation between two similar things

es.e: There are obvious distinctions between the two wine-making areas.
es.c: 这两个酿酒区之间有明显的不同。

d: v 根除 to completely get rid of something such as a disease or a social problem

es.e: an attempt to eradicate inflation
es.c: 为消除通货膨胀所作的努力

es.e: This problem has now been completely eradicated.
es.c: 这个问题现已彻底杜绝。

d: adj 才华横溢的；极好的 extremely clever or skilful

es.e: a brilliant young musician
es.c: 一位才华横溢的年轻音乐家

es.e: a brilliant performance
es.c: 精湛的演出

es.e: I think that’s a brilliant idea .
es.c: 我觉得那是个绝妙的主意。

d: v 重新定义 If you redefine something, you cause people to consider it in a new way

es.e: Feminists have redefined the role of women.
es.c: 女权主义者们已重新定义了女性角色。

d: v 装备，武装 to provide weapons for yourself, an army, a country etc in order to prepare for a fight or a war

es.e: The local farmers have armed themselves with rifles and pistols.
es.c: 当地的农场主用步枪和手枪武装自己。

d: adv 强烈地

es.e: She disliked him intensely.
es.c: 她非常讨厌他。

es.e: The fast-food business is intensely competitive.
es.c: 快餐业竞争非常激烈。

d: adj 绝望的，不顾一切的 willing to do anything to change a very bad situation, and not caring about danger

es.e: I had no money left and was desperate.
es.c: 我身无分文，已经走投无路了。

es.e: Time was running out and we were getting desperate .
es.c: 时间越来越少，我们越来越感到绝望。

es.e: the missing teenager’s desperate parents
es.c: 失踪少年绝望的父母

d: n 性别歧视 the belief that one sex is weaker, less intelligent, or less important than the other, especially when this results in someone being treated unfairly

es.e: sexism in the workplace
es.c: 工作场所的性别歧视

d: v 使碰伤，擦伤 if part of your body bruises, or if you bruise part of your body, it gets hit or hurt and a bruise appears

es.e: She fell off her bike and bruised her knee.
es.c: 她从自行车上摔下来，擦伤了膝盖。

d: adj 卓越的；突出的 important

es.e: a prominent Russian scientist
es.c: 杰出的俄罗斯科学家

es.e: a prominent nose
es.c: 高鼻子

d: adj 综合的，全面的 including all the necessary facts, details, or problems that need to be dealt with

es.e: We offer our customers a comprehensive range of financial products.
es.c: 我们为客户提供全面的金融产品。

es.e: a comprehensive guide to British hotels and restaurants
es.c: 一本介绍英国酒店和餐厅的详尽指南

es.e: The following guidelines do not aim to be totally comprehensive.
es.c: 以下指导原则并非想要面面俱到。

d: n 预报，预测 a description of what is likely to happen in the future, based on the information that you have now

es.e: The weather forecast is good for tomorrow.
es.c: 天气预报说明天是晴天。

d: v 支持，拥护 If you champion a person, a cause, or a principle, you support or defend them

es.e: He passionately championed the poor.
es.c: 他曾热情地捍卫穷人。

d: n 说明 a detailed instruction about how a car, building, piece of equipment etc should be made

es.e: The bolts met all the engineering specifications.
es.c: 这些螺栓符合所有的工程设计规格。

d: n 布局，设计 the way in which something such as a town, garden, or building is arranged

es.e: All the flats in the building had the same layout.
es.c: 大楼里所有的公寓布局都是一样的。

d: n 集会 a large public meeting, especially one that is held outdoors to support a political idea, protest etc

es.e: About 1,000 people attended the rally in Hyde Park.
es.c: 大约有1,000人参加了海德公园的集会。

es.e: We decided to hold a rally to put pressure on the government.
es.c: 我们决定举行集会来对政府施压。

es.e: a mass rally (= large rally ) in support of the pay claim
es.c: 支持加薪要求的大型集会

d: adj 爱情的 connected or concerned with love

es.e: a romantic comedy
es.c: 爱情喜剧

es.e: I'm not interested in a romantic relationship.
es.c: 我对谈情说爱不感兴趣。

d: v 偏离 to change what you are doing so that you are not following an expected plan, idea, or type of behaviour

es.e: They stopped you as soon as you deviated from the script.
es.c: 你一偏离剧本，他们就会叫停。

d: adj 不足的 not enough, or not great enough

es.e: Insufficient resources have been devoted to the health service.
es.c: 用于医疗保健服务的资源不足。

d: v 提高 to increase or improve something and make it more successful

es.e: to boost exports/profits
es.c: 增加出口；提高利润

d: n 丑闻 an event in which someone, especially someone important, behaves in a bad way that shocks people

es.e: It caused quite a scandal when he left his wife.
es.c: 他离开妻子成了一大丑闻。

es.e: The college has recently been involved in a drugs scandal .
es.c: 这所大学最近卷入了毒品丑闻。

es.e: He has been at the centre of a political scandal .
es.c: 他成了一桩政治丑闻的焦点。

d: v 限制 to keep someone or something within the limits of a particular activity or subject

es.e: Vaughan is confined to a wheelchair .
es.c: 沃恩离不开轮椅。

d: adj 显著的 very easy to notice

es.e: The notice must be displayed in a conspicuous place.
es.c: 通告一定要贴在显眼的地方。

es.e: a bird with conspicuous white markings
es.c: 一种长有醒目白斑的鸟

es.e: I felt very conspicuous in my red coat.
es.c: 我穿着红外套，感觉自己十分显眼。

d: adj 重要的 having an important effect or influence, especially on what will happen in the future

es.e: His most significant political achievement was the abolition of the death penalty.
es.c: 他政治上最重大的成就是废除了死刑。

es.e: Please inform us if there are any significant changes in your plans.
es.c: 你们的计划如有重大变动，请通知我们。

d: adj 新颖的，新奇的 good or interesting because it has not been done, seen etc before

es.e: Ryan will bring a fresh approach to the job.
es.c: 瑞安将带来一种新的工作方法。

es.e: We need some fresh ideas .
es.c: 我们需要一些新的想法。

es.e: Let’s take a fresh look at the problem.
es.c: 我们换个角度来看这个问题吧。

d: v 放纵 to let someone have or do whatever they want, even if it is bad for them

es.e: His mother spoiled him, indulging his every whim.
es.c: 他母亲对他纵容娇惯，百依百顺。

d: adv 本能地

es.e: What do we instinctively do?
es.c: 出于本能，我们会怎么做？

es.e: He knew instinctively that something was wrong.
es.c: 他凭直觉知道出事了。

d: n 补充 someone or something that emphasizes the good qualities of another person or thing

es.e: This wine would be a nice complement to grilled dishes.
es.c: 这种葡萄酒配烧烤食物会很不错。

d: adj 满意的 happy and satisfied

es.e: Andy was a good husband, and Nicky was clearly very content.
es.c: 安迪是个好丈夫，尼基显然非常满足。

d: n 肮脏 the condition of being dirty and unpleasant because of a lack of care or money

es.e: We lived in squalor for a year and a half.
es.c: 我们在肮脏的环境里住了一年半。

d: n 疲惫 very great tiredness

es.e: Sam’s face was grey with fatigue.
es.c: 萨姆累得脸色灰白。

d: adj 令人敬畏的,令人赞叹的；极好的 extremely impressive, serious, or difficult so that you feel great respect, worry, or fear

es.e: an awesome responsibility
es.c: 一项令人惊惧的责任

es.e: the awesome sweep of the scenery
es.c: 连绵的壮丽景色

es.e: Their last concert was really awesome.
es.c: 他们上一场音乐会真棒。

d: adj 灵敏的，反应的 reacting quickly, in a positive way

es.e: a car with highly responsive steering
es.c: 方向盘操纵灵活的汽车

d: v 随声附和，发出回声 if a sound echoes, you hear it again because it was made near something such as a wall or hill

es.e: The sound of an engine echoed back from the thick forest.
es.c: 从茂密的森林里传来引擎的回声。

d: n 分歧 disagreement among the members of a group that makes them form smaller opposing groups

es.e: The Army was plagued by internal divisions .
es.c: 军队被内部分歧所困扰。

d: n 性别 the fact of being male or female

es.e: people of the same gender
es.c: 同性别的人

es.e: Discrimination on grounds of race or gender is forbidden.
es.c: 严禁种族歧视和性别歧视。

es.e: There may be gender differences in attitudes to paid work.
es.c: 对待有偿劳动的态度可能存在着性别差异。

d: n 相关，关联 a connection between two ideas, facts etc, especially when one may be the cause of the other

es.e: ...the correlation between smoking and disease.
es.c: …吸烟和疾病之间的关联。

d: n 伤亡人数 someone who is hurt or killed in an accident or war

es.e: The rebels have inflicted heavy casualties .
es.c: 叛乱者造成了大量的伤亡。

es.e: Our aim is to reduce road casualties .
es.c: 我们的目标是减少交通事故的伤亡人数。

d: adj 适当的 correct or suitable for a particular time, situation, or purpose

es.e: The timing of the announcement was particularly appropriate .
es.c: 通告发布的时机很合适。

es.e: Where appropriate , I delegate as much work as possible.
es.c: 只要合适，我就尽量把工作分派出去。

es.e: Mark box 1 or 2, as appropriate .
es.c: 把方框1和2中的合适者标出来。

d: adj 微妙的 not easy to notice or understand unless you pay careful attention

es.e: The pictures are similar, but there are subtle differences between them.
es.c: 这些图片很相似，但它们之间有细微的差别。

es.e: The warning signs of the disease are so subtle that they are often ignored.
es.c: 这种疾病的警示征兆不易察觉，因而往往被忽视。

es.e: a subtle form of racism
es.c: 隐性的种族歧视

d: adj 批评的；关键的 if you are critical, you criticize someone or something

es.e: He made some highly critical remarks.
es.c: 他发表了一些严厉的批判性言论。

es.e: It is absolutely critical for us to know the truth.
es.c: 我们知道真相是极其重要的。

d: adv 二选一地；非此即彼 You use alternatively to introduce a suggestion or to mention something different from what has just been stated.

es.e: Hotels are generally of a good standard and not too expensive. Alternatively you could stay in an apartment.
es.c: 旅馆一般标准高并且不太贵。或者你可以住公寓。

d: adj 亲密的 having an extremely close friendship

es.e: an intimate friend of Picasso’s
es.c: 毕加索的一个密友

es.e: an intimate relationship
es.c: 亲密的关系

es.e: She’s on intimate terms with people in government.
es.c: 她与政府官员关系密切。

d: n 分离 Disengagement is a process by which people gradually stop being involved in a conflict, activity, or organization.

es.e: This policy of disengagement from the European war had its critics.
es.c: 从欧战中逐渐撤军的政策遭到了批评。

d: n 休息室 a public room in a hotel or other building, that is used by many people as a place to relax

es.e: the television lounge
es.c: 电视放映室

d: n 姿势，手势 a movement of part of your body, especially your hands or head, to show what you mean or how you feel

es.e: Luke made an obscene gesture with his finger.
es.c: 卢克用手指做了一个下流的手势。

d: n 脚本，剧本 the written form of a speech, play, film etc

es.e: They write all their own scripts.
es.c: 他们所有的剧本都是自己写的。

es.e: a film script
es.c: 电影剧本

d: n 名声，声望 the respect and admiration that someone or something gets because of their success or important position in society

es.e: The king wanted to enhance his prestige through war.
es.c: 国王想通过战争来提高自己的威信。

es.e: This little-known British firm has now gained considerable prestige .
es.c: 这家名不见经传的英国公司如今已经声名鹊起。

es.e: the personal prestige attached to owning a large property
es.c: 拥有大房子所带来的体面

d: adj 尴尬的；棘手的；笨拙的 making you feel embarrassed so that you are not sure what to do or say

es.e: A laugh can help people over an awkward situation.
es.c: 笑可以助人化解尴尬。

es.e: It’ll be awkward getting cars in and out.
es.c: 这样汽车就不好进出了。

es.e: Amy made an awkward gesture with her hands.
es.c: 艾米用双手做了一个笨拙的手势。

d: n 企业家 someone who starts a new business or arranges business deals in order to make money, often in a way that involves financial risks

es.e: The entrepreneur takes business risks in the hope of making a profit.
es.c: 企业家为追求利润而冒险。

es.e: An entrepreneur is more than just a risk taker. He is a visionary.
es.c: 企业家不仅要能承担风险，还应富于远见。

d: adj 自动的 an automatic machine is designed to work without needing someone to operate it for each part of a process

es.e: an automatic weapon
es.c: 自动武器

es.e: an automatic gearbox
es.c: 自动变速箱

es.e: My camera is fully automatic .
es.c: 我的照相机是全自动的。

d: v 繁荣，兴旺 to become very successful or very strong and healthy

es.e: plants that thrive in tropical rain forests
es.c: 在热带雨林蓬勃生长的植物

es.e: a business which managed to thrive during a recession
es.c: 在经济萧条时期也能顺利发展的一家企业

d: v 丰富，使富裕 to improve the quality of something, especially by adding things to it

es.e: Add fertilizer to enrich the soil.
es.c: 施上肥料使土壤肥沃。

es.e: Education can greatly enrich your life.
es.c: 教育可以大大充实生活。

d: v 咀嚼；深思 to bite food several times before swallowing it

es.e: This meat’s so tough I can hardly chew it!
es.c: 这肉太老了，我几乎嚼不动！

es.e: Let me chew it over for a few days.
es.c: 让我好好考虑几天。

d: n 车辆 a machine with an engine that is used to take people or things from one place to another, such as a car, bus, or truck

es.e: a description of the stolen vehicle
es.c: 对被盗车辆的描述

es.e: Have you locked your vehicle?
es.c: 你锁车了吗？

d: adj 有趣的 something that is intriguing is very interesting because it is strange, mysterious, or unexpected

es.e: The magazine carries an intriguing mixture of high fashion, gossip and racing.
es.c: 这本杂志内容丰富有趣，有关时尚、花边新闻和赛马的内容都有。

d: n 隔离 when people of different races, sexes, or religions are kept apart so that they live, work, or study separately

es.e: The Supreme Court unanimously ruled that racial segregation in schools was unconstitutional.
es.c: 最高法院一致裁定学校实施的种族隔离措施违反宪法。

d: v 猛投 to throw something with a lot of force, especially because you are angry

es.e: Demonstrators were hurling bricks through the windows.
es.c: 示威者在向窗里掷砖块。

es.e: He hurled a chair across the set, smashing lamps and vases.
es.c: 他抓起一把椅子扔向片场的那头，把灯和花瓶都砸得粉碎。

d: v 孵化 if an egg hatches, or if it is hatched, it breaks, letting the young bird, insect etc come out

es.e: The eggs take three days to hatch.
es.c: 这些蛋要三天时间才能孵化。

d: n 危害 If you do someone or something a disservice, you harm them in some way

es.e: He said the protesters were doing a disservice to the nation.
es.c: 他表示，抗议者们的行为正对国家造成危害。

d: n 变化 a difference between similar things, or a change from the usual amount or form of something

es.e: White bread is really just a variation of French bread.
es.c: 白面包其实只是法式长条面包的一种变化形式。

d: adj 巨大的 very big in size or in amount

es.e: an enormous bunch of flowers
es.c: 巨大的花束

es.e: an enormous amount of money
es.c: 巨款

es.e: The team made an enormous effort.
es.c: 该队付出了巨大的努力。

d: n 恐吓，惊恐 a sudden feeling of fear

es.e: You really gave us a scare !
es.c: 你真的吓了我们一跳！

d: adj 按字母表顺序的 relating to the alphabet

es.e: The files are arranged in alphabetical order .
es.c: 这些文件按字母顺序排列。

d: adj 得出结论的 showing that something is definitely true

es.e: The investigation failed to provide any conclusive evidence.
es.c: 调查未能提供任何结论性的证据。

d: n 流行病 a large number of cases of a disease that happen at the same time

es.e: Over 500 people died during last year’s flu epidemic.
es.c: 去年流感大暴发期间有五百多人死亡。

d: adj 坚实的；稳固的 that you can rely on; having a strong basis

es.e: This provided a solid foundation for their marriage.
es.c: 这为他们的婚姻提供了坚实的基础。

es.e: The Irish team were solid as a rock in defence.
es.c: 爱尔兰队的防守坚如盘石。

es.e: These chains seem fairly solid.
es.c: 这些链子看着挺结实。

d: n 条款 a part of a written law or legal document covering a particular subject of the whole law or document

es.e: A confidentiality clause was added to the contract.
es.c: 合同中加上了一项保密条款。

d: n 服务人员 someone whose job is to look after or help customers in a public place

es.e: a car park attendant
es.c: 停车场的服务员

d: v 坍塌，崩塌 if a building, wall etc collapses, it falls down suddenly, usually because it is weak or damaged

es.e: Uncle Ted’s chair collapsed under his weight.
es.c: 椅子承受不了特德叔叔的重量，塌架了。

es.e: The roof had collapsed long ago.
es.c: 屋顶早就塌了。

d: v 发送，派遣 to send someone or something somewhere for a particular purpose

es.e: Goods are normally dispatched within 24 hours.
es.c: 货物一般在24小时内派送。

d: v 耸肩 to raise and then lower your shoulders in order to show that you do not know something or do not care about something

es.e: I just shrugged my shoulders and ignored him.
es.c: 我只是耸耸肩，没有理睬他。

es.e: Melanie shrugged and walked away.
es.c: 梅拉妮耸耸肩走开了。

d: adj 失业的，被解雇的；过剩的 if you are redundant, your employer no longer has a job for you

es.e: Seventy factory workers were made redundant in the resulting cuts.
es.c: 在继而发生的裁员中，70名工厂工人被解雇。

es.e: the removal of redundant information
es.c: 多余信息的删除

d: adj 机警的 able to think quickly and clearly；v 提醒 to make someone realize something important or dangerous

es.e: Jack was as mentally alert as a man half his age.
es.c: 杰克的头脑和年龄小他一半的人一样灵活。

es.e: campaigns to alert the public to the dangers of HIV
es.c: 让公众意识到艾滋病病毒危险的宣传活动

d: n 赤字 the difference between the amount of something that you have and the higher amount that you need

es.e: the country’s widening budget deficit
es.c: 这个国家日益严重的预算赤字

es.e: the US’s foreign trade deficit
es.c: 美国的对外贸易逆差
