d: v 调整，重建 to change the way in which something such as a government, business, or system is organized

es.e: proposals to radically restructure Britain’s electronics industry
es.c: 彻底整顿英国电子行业的提议

d: v 轻敲 to hit your fingers lightly on something, for example to get someone’s attention

es.e: He tapped the table nervously with his fingers.
es.c: 他紧张地用手指轻轻地敲打桌子。

d: adj 同步的 things that are simultaneous happen at exactly the same time

es.e: They grabbed each other’s hands in simultaneous panic.
es.c: 他们俩同时惊慌起来，相互抓住对方的手。

es.e: Up to twenty users can have simultaneous access to the system.
es.c: 最多可有20名用户同时登该系统。

es.e: The speeches will be broadcast live, with simultaneous translation (= immediate translation, as the person is speaking ) into English.
es.c: 这些演讲将作现场直播，并配有英语同声传译。

d: v 出现 if a problem or difficult situation arises, it begins to happen

es.e: A crisis has arisen in the Foreign Office.
es.c: 外交部出现了危机。

es.e: More problems like those at the nuclear power plant are certain to arise.
es.c: 核电厂肯定还会出现那样的问题。

d: n 野生动物 animals and plants growing in natural conditions

es.e: measures to protect the area’s wildlife
es.c: 保护该地区野生生物的措施

es.e: the destruction of wildlife habitats
es.c: 野生动植物生存环境的破坏

d: v 压倒，战胜 to defeat an army completely

es.e: In 1532 the Spaniards finally overwhelmed the armies of Peru.
es.c: 1532年，西班牙人最终打垮了秘鲁军队。

d: n 动力，积极性 eagerness and willingness to do something without needing to be told or forced to do it

es.e: Jack is an intelligent pupil, but he lacks motivation.
es.c: 杰克是一个很聪明的学生，但学习不够主动。

d: adj 细微的；精细的 needing to be dealt with carefully or sensitively in order to avoid problems or failure

es.e: There’s something I have to speak to you about – it’s a delicate matter .
es.c: 我有件事要跟你讲——是一件需要谨慎处理的事。

es.e: a plate with a delicate pattern of leaves
es.c: 有精致树叶图案的碟子

d: adj 显著的，杰出的 unusual or surprising and therefore deserving attention or praise

es.e: She has made remarkable progress.
es.c: 她取得了显著的进步。

es.e: a remarkable coincidence
es.c: 不寻常的巧合

es.e: He’s a remarkable man .
es.c: 他是个了不起的人。

d: n 奴隶制度 the system of having slaves

es.e: attempts to abolish slavery
es.c: 废除奴隶制的努力

d: adj 未经处理的 harmful substances that are untreated have not been made safe

es.e: untreated sewage
es.c: 未经处理过的污水

d: adj 怀疑的 thinking that someone might be guilty of doing something wrong or dishonest

es.e: His reluctance to answer my questions made me suspicious .
es.c: 他不愿回答我的问题，这引起我的怀疑。

es.e: She gave him a suspicious glance.
es.c: 她向他投去怀疑的一瞥。

es.e: You’ve got a very suspicious mind!
es.c: 你真是疑心太重！

d: adj 古代的 belonging to a time long ago in history, especially thousands of years ago

es.e: the ancient civilizations of Asia
es.c: 亚洲的古代文明

d: v 歪曲；扭曲 to report something in a way that is not completely true or correct

es.e: His account was badly distorted by the press.
es.c: 他的话被报界严重歪曲。

es.e: an expensive subsidy which distorts the market
es.c: 扰乱市场秩序的高价补贴

d: v 跳过 to not read, mention, or deal with something that would normally come or happen next

es.e: I decided to skip the first chapter.
es.c: 我决定跳过第一章。

d: adj 一厢情愿的

es.e: Stop your wishful thinking and be glad for what you do have instead of always wanting more.
es.c: 别再一厢情愿的妄想了，高高兴兴的接受你已经有的，别再奢求更多了。

es.e: This, I am sorry to say, is almost entirely wishful thinking.
es.c: 我很遗憾，这几乎完全是一厢情愿的想法。

d: n 企业管理 Entrepreneurship is the state of being an entrepreneur, or the activities associated with being an entrepreneur
n 新娘 a woman at the time she gets married or just after she is married

es.e: Guests toasted the bride and groom with champagne.
es.c: 客人们以香槟为新娘新郎敬酒。

d: v 展开 if a story unfolds, or if someone unfolds it, it is told

es.e: As the story unfolds, we learn more about Max’s childhood.
es.c: 随着故事的展开，我们对马克斯的童年有了更多的了解。

d: n 干涉 an act of interfering

es.e: Industrial relations should be free from state interference.
es.c: 劳资关系应不受政府干预。

d: n 攻击 a military attack to take control of a place controlled by the enemy

es.e: The refugee camp came under assault again last night.
es.c: 昨晚难民营再次遭袭。

es.e: an unsuccessful assault on the enemy lines
es.c: 对敌军防线失败的攻击

d: n 股东 someone who owns shares in a company or business

es.e: Shareholders have been told to expect an even lower result next year.
es.c: 股东们被告知明年的业绩还会更差。

d: n 突破性进展 an important new discovery in something you are studying, especially one made after trying for a long time

es.e: Scientists have made a major breakthrough in the treatment of cancer.
es.c: 科学家在癌症治疗方面取得了重大突破。

d: n 注脚 a piece of additional information that is not very important but is interesting or helps you understand something

es.e: There was an interesting footnote to the story.
es.c: 那则故事有个有趣的注脚。

d: adj 可应用的 if something is applicable to a particular person, group, or situation, it affects them or is related to them

es.e: What is a reasonable standard for one family is not applicable for another.
es.c: 对一个家庭合理的标准对于另一个家庭并不适用。

d: adj 受到争议的 causing a lot of disagreement, because many people have strong opinions about the subject being discussed

es.e: the controversial issue of welfare reform
es.c: 福利改革这一有争议的话题

es.e: a highly controversial (= very controversial ) plan to flood the valley in order to build a dam
es.c: 一个把山谷淹掉来建造水坝的极具争议的计划

es.e: He is a controversial figure (= person who does controversial things ) in the art world.
es.c: 他是艺术界极具争议的人物。

d: v 继承 to receive money, property etc from someone after they have died

es.e: inherited wealth
es.c: 继承的财富

d: v 使便利；促进 To facilitate an action or process, especially one that you would like to happen, means to make it easier or more likely to happen

es.e: The new airport will facilitate the development of tourism.
es.c: 新机场将促进旅游业的发展。

d: v 表明 to show a feeling, attitude etc

es.e: The shareholders have manifested their intention to sell the shares.
es.c: 股东们表明了要出售股票的意图。

d: adj 财政的 relating to money, taxes, debts etc that are owned and managed by the government

es.e: a fiscal crisis
es.c: 财政危机

es.e: a fiscal matter
es.c: 财政事务

d: n 长袍 a long loose piece of clothing worn for special ceremonies by judges, teachers, lawyers, and members of universities

es.e: ...an old headmaster in a flowing black gown.
es.c: …一位身着飘垂黑色礼袍的老校长。

es.e: a graduation gown
es.c: 毕业礼服

d: n 费用 a charge or payment that is set according to a standard scale

es.e: $20 an hour is the going rate (= the usual amount paid ) for private tuition.
es.c: 每小时20美元是私人授课的一般收费。

d: n 死亡率 the number of deaths during a particular period of time among a particular type or group of people

es.e: Mortality from heart disease varies widely across the world.
es.c: 心脏病死亡率世界各地差异很大。

d: v 拒绝 to say no politely when someone invites you somewhere, offers you something, or wants you to do something

es.e: Offered the position of chairman, Smith declined, preferring to keep his current job.
es.c: 对担任主席的邀约，史密斯拒绝了，他宁愿留在现在的职位上。

es.e: Mary declined a hot drink and went to her room.
es.c: 玛丽谢绝了热饮料，到自己的房间去了。

es.e: The minister declined to comment (= refused to speak to people who report the news ) about the progress of the peace talks.
es.c: 部长拒绝就和谈进程发表评论。

d: adj 悲哀的；令人惋惜的 If you are mournful, you are very sad

es.e: He looked mournful, even near to tears.
es.c: 他看上去很悲伤，几乎要掉泪了。

d: n 悖论 a statement that seems impossible because it contains two opposing ideas that are both true

es.e: The paradox is that fishermen would catch more fish if they fished less.
es.c: 悖论就是: 如果渔夫减少捕鱼，反而会打到更多的鱼。

d: adv 同步地，同时地

es.e: The game will be broadcast simultaneously on TV and radio.
es.c: 比赛将同时在电视和广播中进行转播。

d: n 策略 a planned series of actions for achieving something

es.e: the government’s long-term economic strategy
es.c: 政府的长期经济策略

es.e: a company’s business strategy
es.c: 公司的经营策略

d: n 识字， 有文化 the state of being able to read and write

es.e: a campaign to promote adult literacy
es.c: 提高成人文化水平的运动

es.e: basic literacy skills
es.c: 基本的读写技巧

d: n 冷漠 the feeling of not being interested in something, and not willing to make any effort to change or improve things

es.e: The campaign failed because of public apathy.
es.c: 由于公众反应冷淡，这次运动失败了。

d: n 繁荣 a quick increase of business activity

es.e: The boom has created job opportunities.
es.c: 经济繁荣创造了就业的机会。

es.e: the economic boom of the 1950s
es.c: 20世纪50年代的经济繁荣

es.e: The economy went from boom to bust (=  from increasing to decreasing  ) very quickly.
es.c: 经济很快就从繁荣走向了萧条。

d: v 迫使 if you are obliged to do something, you have to do it because the situation, the law, a duty etc makes it necessary

es.e: The storm got worse and worse. Finally, I was obliged to abandon the car and continue on foot.
es.c: 暴风雨越来越猛烈。最终，我被迫弃车徒步前行。

d: n 不兼容

es.e: Because of an antibody incompatibility, he is unable to receive a transplant.
es.c: 由于抗体不相容，他不能接受心脏移植。

d: n 商业 the buying and selling of goods and services

es.e: measures promoting local commerce and industry
es.c: 促进地方工商业发展的措施

d: v 归因于 If you attribute something to an event or situation, you think that it was caused by that event or situation

es.e: Women tend to attribute their success to external causes such as luck.
es.c: 女性往往把她们的成功归因于外因，如运气。

d: n 自助餐厅 a restaurant, often in a factory, college etc, where you choose from foods that have already been cooked and carry your own food to a table

es.e: the school cafeteria
es.c: 学校餐厅

d: n 残疾，跛子 someone who is unable to walk properly because their legs are damaged or injured - now considered offensive

es.e: She has gone from being a healthy, fit, and sporty young woman to being a cripple.
es.c: 她从一个健康、强壮、爱好体育运动的年轻姑娘变成了一个残疾人。

d: n 航天飞机 a space shuttle

es.e: The space shuttle had been scheduled to blast off at 04:38.
es.c: 航天飞机已经预定于凌晨4点38分发射升空。

d: n 噩梦 a very frightening dream

es.e: a recurring nightmare
es.c: 一再出现的噩梦

d: v 使惊讶 to make someone suddenly surprised or slightly shocked

es.e: Sorry, I didn’t mean to startle you.
es.c: 抱歉，我不是故意吓你一跳的。

d: n 残骸，碎片 the pieces of something that are left after it has been destroyed in an accident, explosion etc

es.e: She was hit by flying debris from the blast.
es.c: 她被爆炸产生的飞散碎片击中。

d: v 收集，组装 to put all the parts of something together

es.e: The aircraft will continue to be assembled in France.
es.c: 飞机将继续在法国组装。

d: n 看法；意识 Your perception of something is the way that you think about it or the impression you have of it

es.e: He is interested in how our perceptions of death affect the way we live.
es.c: 他对我们的死亡观如何影响我们的生活方式感兴趣。

d: adj 海滨的 in the sea or on the land near the coast

es.e: the coastal waters of Britain
es.c: 英国的近海水域

es.e: the coastal path
es.c: 海滨小道

d: v 放弃，抛弃 to leave someone or something and no longer help or support them

es.e: Helen was deserted by her husband.
es.c: 海伦被丈夫遗弃了。

es.e: Many of the party’s traditional voters deserted it at the last election.
es.c: 许多长期支持该党的选民在上一次选举中抛弃了它。

es.e: The price rise caused many readers to desert the magazine.
es.c: 价格上涨导致许多读者放弃了这本杂志。

d: n 同龄人 your peers are the people who are the same age as you, or who have the same type of job, social class etc

es.e: American children did less well in math than their peers in Japan.
es.c: 美国儿童的数学成绩不如日本的同龄儿童。

es.e: Staff members are trained by their peers.
es.c: 员工由同事培训。

d: v 体现 to be a very good example of an idea or quality

es.e: She embodies everything I admire in a teacher.
es.c: 她具备了我所钦佩的教师该具备的一切素质。

d: adj 同情的 caring and feeling sorry about someone’s problems

es.e: a sympathetic friend
es.c: 一个有同情心的朋友

es.e: a sympathetic attitude
es.c: 一种同情的态度

es.e: We hope always to provide a friendly sympathetic ear (= someone willing to listen to someone else’s problems ) .
es.c: 我们希望总能做到友善地倾听。

d: n 后补，援助 extra help or support that you can get if necessary

es.e: The police had backup from the army.
es.c: 警方得到了军方的增援。

es.e: We can use him as a backup if one of the other players drops out.
es.c: 如果有参赛者退出，我们可以用他作为替补。

es.e: a backup power supply
es.c: 备用电源

d: adv 显著地，尤其 in a way that is clearly different, important, or unusual

es.e: Emigration has notably increased over the past five years.
es.c: 在过去五年中，移居国外的人明显增加。

es.e: Notably absent from his statement was any hint of an apology.
es.c: 他的话里显然没有丝毫道歉的意思。

d: v 开发，开采 to develop and use minerals, forests, oil etc for business or industry

es.e: the urgent need to exploit the resources of the Irish Sea
es.c: 开发爱尔兰海资源的迫切需要

d: n 诗歌 poems in general, or the art of writing them

es.e: He reads a lot of poetry.
es.c: 他大量阅读诗歌。

es.e: a poetry magazine
es.c: 诗歌杂志

d: v 歧视；区别 to treat a person or group differently from another in an unfair way

es.e: Under federal law, it is illegal to discriminate against minorities and women.
es.c: 联邦法律规定，歧视少数民族和妇女是违法的。

es.e: He is incapable of discriminating between a good idea and a terrible one.
es.c: 他没能力在一个好主意和一个坏主意之间进行区分。

d: v 重新调整，再调整 to make a small change to something or to its position

es.e: He readjusted his glasses.
es.c: 他重新调了调眼镜。

d: adj 轻微的 small in degree

es.e: a slight improvement
es.c: 些许的改进

es.e: a slight increase
es.c: 少许的增加

es.e: a slight change of plan
es.c: 计划的略微变动

d: n 狭长的一块 a long narrow area of land

es.e: a strip of sand between the cliffs and the sea
es.c: 悬崖和大海之间的一块狭长沙地

d: v 解决，处理 to try to deal with a difficult problem

es.e: There is more than one way to tackle the problem.
es.c: 解决这个问题不止一个办法。

es.e: It took twelve fire engines to tackle the blaze .
es.c: 出动了12辆消防车来扑救那场大火。

d: adj 稳定的 continuing or developing gradually or without stopping, and not likely to change

es.e: Paul is making steady progress.
es.c: 保罗逐渐在进步。

es.e: a steady rain
es.c: 下个不停的雨

d: n 少数，少数民族 a small group of people or things within a much larger group

es.e: Gaelic is still spoken in Ireland by a tiny minority.
es.c: 爱尔兰仍有极少数人在说盖尔语。

d: adj 渴望成功的的 having a strong desire to have or achieve something

es.e: aspirational young women
es.c: 有抱负的年轻女性

d: n 训练，管教 a way of training someone so that they learn to control their behaviour and obey rules

es.e: The book gives parents advice on discipline.
es.c: 这本书指导父母如何管教孩子

d: n 门槛 the entrance to a room or building, or the area of floor or ground at the entrance

es.e: She opened the door and stepped across the threshold.
es.c: 她打开门，跨过门槛。

d: v 高飞 to fly, especially very high up in the sky, floating on air currents

es.e: She watched the dove soar above the chestnut trees.
es.c: 她看着鸽子在栗子树的上空展翅飞翔。

d: adj 不均衡的 not regular

es.e: His breathing had become uneven.
es.c: 他的呼吸变得不均匀

d: adj 关键的 something that is crucial is extremely important, because everything else depends on it

es.e: The conservation of tropical forests is of crucial importance .
es.c: 保护热带雨林至关重要。

d: n 体育运动 sports such as running and jumping

es.e: ...students who play intercollegiate athletics.
es.c: …参加大学校际体育运动的学生们。

d: adj 贫穷的 having very little food or money

es.e: a needy family
es.c: 贫困家庭

d: adj 热情的 feeling or showing a lot of interest and excitement about something

es.e: an enthusiastic supporter of reform
es.c: 改革的热心支持者

d: v 引发，引起 to make something happen very quickly, especially a series of events

es.e: The assassination triggered off a wave of rioting.
es.c: 这次暗杀事件引发了一阵骚乱。

es.e: Certain forms of mental illness can be triggered by food allergies.
es.c: 某些精神疾病可能由食物过敏引发。

es.e: His action triggered a massive response from the government.
es.c: 他的行动引发了政府的巨大反应。

d: adj 必须的；本质的 extremely important and necessary

es.e: Window locks are fairly cheap and absolutely essential.
es.c: 窗锁相当便宜，绝对有必要安装。

es.e: Even in small companies, computers are an essential tool.
es.c: 即使在小公司里，计算机也是不可或缺的工具。

es.e: The essential difference between Sam and me was the fact that I took life seriously.
es.c: 我和萨姆的根本区别在于我是认真对待生活的。

d: n 议程 a list of problems or subjects that a government, organization etc is planning to deal with

es.e: The Republicans have stuck to their conservative agenda.
es.c: 共和党人坚持自己的保守议题。

d: v 欠钱 to need to pay someone for something that they have done for you or sold to you, or to need to give someone back money that they have lent you

es.e: How much do I owe you (= often used to show that you want to pay for something )?
es.c: 我该付你多少钱？

d: n 公平 fairness in the way people are treated

es.e: Children have a strong sense of justice.
es.c: 儿童有很强的正义感。

es.e: His people came to him demanding justice.
es.c: 他的手下来找他，寻求公正。

d: n 捐赠者 a person, group etc that gives something, especially money, to help an organization or country

es.e: We urgently need more assistance from donor countries (= countries that give money, food etc to help in poor countries or disaster areas ) .
es.c: 我们急需捐赠国的更多援助。

es.e: An anonymous donor (= whose name is unknown ) has given £500 towards the restoration fund.
es.c: 一位匿名捐赠者向重建基金捐了500英镑。

d: v 证明……有罪 to prove or officially announce that someone is guilty of a crime after a trial in a law court

es.e: a convicted murderer
es.c: 已定罪的谋杀犯

d: v 低估 to think or guess that something is smaller, cheaper, easier etc than it really is

es.e: None of us should ever underestimate the degree of difficulty women face in career advancement.
es.c: 我们谁都不应低估妇女在职业发展中所面临的困难程度。

d: adj 平的 smooth and level, without raised or hollow areas, and not sloping or curving；n 公寓 a place for people to live that consists of a set of rooms that are part of a larger building

es.e: houses with flat roofs
es.c: 平顶房

es.e: a perfectly flat sandy beach
es.c: 十分平坦的沙滩

es.e: The countryside near there is flat as a pancake (= very flat ) .
es.c: 那儿附近的乡间地势非常平坦。

d: adj 机密的 spoken or written in secret and intended to be kept secret

es.e: a confidential government report
es.c: 一份机密的政府报告

es.e: Doctors are required to keep patients’ records completely confidential .
es.c: 医生必须对病人的病历完全保密。

es.e: The information will be regarded as strictly confidential (= completely confidential ) .
es.c: 这一信息将被视为绝对机密。

d: adj 意想不到的 used to describe something that is surprising because you were not expecting it

es.e: The experiment produced some unexpected results.
es.c: 这次试验产生了一些意想不到的结果。

es.e: Her death was totally unexpected.
es.c: 她的死完全出人意料。

es.e: Hague’s announcement was not entirely unexpected.
es.c: 黑格的声明并非完全出乎意料。

d: n 维他命 a chemical substance in food that is necessary for good health

es.e: Try to eat foods that are rich in vitamins and minerals.
es.c: 尽量吃富含维生素和矿物质的食物。

d: v 危害，危及 to risk losing or spoiling something important

es.e: large-scale military offensives which could jeopardize the UN peace process
es.c: 可能会破坏联合国和平进程的大规模军事进攻

d: adv 比例不均地，不成比例地

es.e: The lower-paid spend a disproportionately large amount of their earnings on food.
es.c: 低工资者将收入花在食物上的比例很大。

d: n 细菌 very small living things, some of which cause illness or disease

es.e: Is it possible to multiply bacteria in the laboratory?
es.c: 有可能在实验室繁殖细菌吗?

es.e: When you eat off the plate, all of those bacteria go into your stomach.
es.c: 当你吃掉了盘子里的食物时，这些细菌就会进入你的肚子。

d: v 达到，实现 to successfully complete something or get a good result, especially by working hard

es.e: Frances achieved very good exam results.
es.c: 弗朗西丝考试取得了优异成绩。

es.e: Wilson has achieved considerable success as an artist.
es.c: 威尔逊作为一名艺术家成就斐然。

es.e: She eventually achieved her goal of becoming a professor.
es.c: 她终于实现目标，当上了教授。

d: v 颠簸 to move up and down as you move forward, especially in a vehicle

es.e: A police car bumped down the track.
es.c: 一辆警车颠簸着行驶在小路上。

d: n 存在；生存 the state of existing

es.e: Scientists have many theories about how the universe first came into existence (= started to exist ).
es.c: 关于宇宙的起源，科学家有多种理论。

es.e: Pablo led a miserable existence when he first moved to San Juan.
es.c: 巴勃罗刚搬到圣胡安时，生活很悲惨。

d: v 扫除，清除 to clean the dust, dirt etc from the floor or ground, using a brush with a long handle

es.e: Bert swept the path in front of the house.
es.c: 伯特清扫了屋前的小路。

d: adj 精明的 good at judging what people or situations are really like

es.e: Malcolm is a shrewd businessman.
es.c: 马尔科姆是个精明的商人。

es.e: She was shrewd enough to guess who was responsible.
es.c: 她很精明，一猜就知道是谁干的。

es.e: Capra looked at her with shrewd eyes.
es.c: 卡普拉眼神犀利地看着她。

d: v 阐释，阐明 to make something much clearer and easier to understand

es.e: The report illuminated the difficult issues at the heart of science policy.
es.c: 报告阐明了科学方针核心部分的难点。

d: n 领域，方面 a general area of knowledge, activity, or thought

es.e: the spiritual realm
es.c: 精神领域

d: n 蓝图，设计图 a plan for achieving something

es.e: a blueprint for health-care reform
es.c: 医疗保健改革蓝图

d: n 养老金 an amount of money paid regularly by the government or company to someone who does not work any more, for example because they have reached the age when people stop working or because they are ill

es.e: At what age can you start drawing your pension ?
es.c: 从多少岁可以开始领取养老金？

es.e: If you are self-employed, you should think about taking out a private pension .
es.c: 如果你是自由职业者，应该考虑办理私人养老金事宜。

es.e: Many people find it hard to live on a basic state pension .
es.c: 许多人发现仅凭国家基本养老金不能养活自己。

d: n 管理；政府 the activities that are involved in managing the work of a company or organization

es.e: We’re looking for someone with experience in administration.
es.c: 我们正在寻找一个有管理经验的人。

es.e: The health service spends too much on administration.
es.c: 医疗服务部门在行政方面花费太多。

es.e: the Kennedy Administration
es.c: 肯尼迪政府

d: v 追踪 to search for a person or animal by following the marks they leave behind them on the ground, their smell etc；n 轨迹，踪迹 a line of marks left on the ground by a moving person, animal, or vehicle

es.e: Police have been tracking the four criminals all over Central America.
es.c: 警方一直在中美洲到处追捕这四名罪犯。

es.e: We followed the tyre tracks across a muddy field.
es.c: 我们顺着车辙穿过一块泥泞的田地。

d: v 仔细考虑 to spend time thinking carefully and seriously about a problem, a difficult question, or something that has happened

es.e: He continued to ponder the problem as he walked home.
es.c: 他一边往家走一边继续思考那个问题。

d: n 天堂 in some religions, a perfect place where people are believed to go after they die, if they have led good lives

es.e: The Koran describes paradise as a place containing a garden of delight.
es.c: 《古兰经》把天堂描绘成一个拥有快乐花园的地方。

d: adj 种族的 relating to a particular race, nation, or tribe and their customs and traditions

es.e: The school teaches pupils from different ethnic groups.
es.c: 该校教授不同种族的小学生。

es.e: ethnic Russians in Estonia
es.c: 居住在爱沙尼亚的俄罗斯人

es.e: plans to partition the republic along ethnic lines
es.c: 按种族分割该共和国的计划

d: v 加速 if a process accelerates or if something accelerates it, it happens faster than usual or sooner than you expect

es.e: measures to accelerate the rate of economic growth
es.c: 加快经济增长速度的措施

d: adj 痛苦的 making you feel very unhappy and upset

es.e: His photo stirred up bitter memories.
es.c: 他的照片勾起了痛苦的回忆。

d: n 野心，报复 determination to be successful, rich, powerful etc

es.e: He was young and full of ambition.
es.c: 他年轻，而且雄心勃勃。

d: v 承认 to admit something that you feel embarrassed about

es.e: Marsha confessed that she didn’t really know how to work the computer.
es.c: 玛莎承认自己其实并不会使用计算机。

es.e: He confessed to having a secret admiration for his opponent.
es.c: 他承认私底下很钦佩他的对手。

d: n 程度 how large, important, or serious something is, especially something such as a problem or injury

es.e: It’s too early to assess the full extent of the damage.
es.c: 要全面评估损失程度还为时过早。

es.e: Considering the extent of his injuries, he’s lucky to be alive.
es.c: 就他的伤势来说，他能活下来真是够幸运的。

d: n 会计 someone whose job is to keep and check financial accounts, calculate taxes etc

es.e: The boss dropped an accountant from the payroll.
es.c: 老板把一名会计师从在职人员名单中除了名。

es.e: The accountant checked this unnecessary spending in good time.
es.c: 会计及时卡住了这笔不必要的开支。

d: adj 纯粹的 You can use sheer to emphasize that a state or situation is complete and does not involve or is not mixed with anything else.

es.e: I’ll never forget the look of sheer joy on her face.
es.c: 我永远也不会忘记她满脸喜悦的神情。

es.e: sheer hypocrisy
es.c: 十足的虚伪

d: adj 故意的 intended or planned

es.e: a deliberate attempt to humiliate her
es.c: 对她的故意羞辱

es.e: The attack on him was quite deliberate.
es.c: 对他的袭击完全是有预谋的。

d: v 铺路 to cover a path, road, area etc with a hard level surface such as blocks of stone or concrete

es.e: a paved courtyard
es.c: 地面铺砌过的院子

d: n 措施 an action, especially an official one, that is intended to deal with a particular problem

es.e: New safety measures were being demanded after last night’s horrific train crash.
es.c: 昨晚发生严重的火车相撞事故后，民众要求制定新的安全措施。

es.e: The new bridge was erected as a temporary measure to replace the one which was destroyed by floods.
es.c: 建这座新桥是为了临时代替被洪水毁坏的那座桥。

d: adv 潜在地 something that is potentially dangerous, useful etc is not dangerous etc now, but may become so in the future

es.e: a potentially dangerous situation
es.c: 有潜在危险的局势

d: v 消除，移除；更新 to get rid of something so that it does not exist any longer

es.e: a cleaner that will remove wine stains
es.c: 可去除葡萄酒酒渍的清洁剂

es.e: The college removed rules that prevented women from enrolling.
es.c: 这所大学取消了禁止女性入学的规定。

d: adj 过敏的 having an allergy

es.e: an allergic reaction to nuts
es.c: 对坚果的过敏性反应

d: adj 可获得的，可利用的 something that is available is able to be used or can easily be bought or found

es.e: Tickets are available from the box office.
es.c: 售票处有票出售。

es.e: Meetings were held to update employees as soon as new information became available .
es.c: 一有新的信息就开会告诉员工。

es.e: Further building can continue when money is made available .
es.c: 有了资金就可以继续进一步的施工。

d: adj 初步的，最初的 happening at the beginning

es.e: an initial investment of £5,000
es.c: 5,000英镑的初始投资

es.e: The initial response has been encouraging.
es.c: 最初的反应情况很乐观。

d: n 共识，一致 an opinion that everyone in a group agrees with or accepts

es.e: The EU Council of Finance Ministers failed to reach a consensus on the pace of integration.
es.c: 欧盟财政部长会议未能就一体化的进度达成共识。

es.e: the current consensus of opinion
es.c: 目前观点上的一致

es.e: The general consensus was that technology was a good thing.
es.c: 大家都认为科技是好东西。

d: n 反对者 someone who disagrees with a plan, idea, or system and wants to try to stop or change it

es.e: Rodgers was not an opponent of the new airport.
es.c: 罗杰斯并不反对建设新机场。

d: v 改变 to make small changes to something in order to improve it and make it more suitable or effective

es.e: The feedback will be used to modify the course for next year.
es.c: 这些反馈意见将用于修改明年的课程。

es.e: The regulations can only be modified by a special committee.
es.c: 这些法规只能由特别委员会来修改。

d: v 表明，象征 to represent, mean, or be a sign of something

es.e: Some tribes use special facial markings to signify status.
es.c: 有些部落使用特殊的面部标记来表示地位。

es.e: The image of the lion signified power and strength.
es.c: 狮子的形象代表权力和力量。

d: v 积累 to gradually get more and more money, possessions, knowledge etc over a period of time

es.e: It is unjust that a privileged few should continue to accumulate wealth.
es.c: 少数特权阶级继续积聚财富，这是不公平的。

d: n 采矿业 the work or industry of getting gold, coal etc out of the earth

es.e: ...traditional industries such as coal mining and steel making.
es.c: …像采煤和炼钢这样的传统工业。

d: adj 暴力的 involving actions that are intended to injure or kill people, by hitting them, shooting them etc

es.e: the increase in violent crime
es.c: 暴力犯罪的增多

es.e: violent clashes between the police and demonstrators
es.c: 警方与示威者之间发生的暴力冲突

es.e: 31 people have been injured in violent incidents throughout the day.
es.c: 今天一天有31人在暴力事件中受伤。

d: n 逆境 a situation in which you have a lot of problems that seem to be caused by bad luck

es.e: his courage in the face of adversity
es.c: 他面对逆境的勇气

d: n 动力学 the branch of mechanics concerned with the forces that change or produce the motions of bodies

es.e: In its broadest sense, dynamics includes nearly the whole of mechanics.
es.c: 广义地说来, 动力学几乎包括了整个力学。

es.e: In order to succeed, you must master complicated knowledge of dynamics.
es.c: 要取得胜利，你必须掌握很复杂的动力学知识。

d: n 混乱 a situation in which everything is happening in a confused way and nothing is organized or arranged in order

es.e: The country was plunged into economic chaos.
es.c: 这个国家陷入了经济大混乱。

d: adj 持续的；坚持不懈的 continuing to exist or happen, especially for longer than is usual or desirable

es.e: persistent rumours
es.c: 持续流传的谣言

es.e: persistent headaches
es.c: 持续头疼

es.e: a persistent problem
es.c: 长期问题

d: n 仪式 a ceremony that is always performed in the same way, in order to mark an important religious or social occasion

es.e: ancient pagan rituals
es.c: 古老的异教仪式

es.e: the importance of religion and ritual in our lives
es.c: 我们生活中宗教和宗教仪式的重要性

es.e: The lady of the house performs the sacred ritual of lighting two candles.
es.c: 由女主人来完成点燃两根蜡烛的神圣仪式。

d: n 标准 A criterion is a factor on which you judge or decide something

es.e: The most important criterion for entry is that applicants must design and make their own work.
es.c: 参加的最重要标准就是申请人必须设计并制作自己的作品。

d: v 强加于 to force someone to have the same ideas, beliefs etc as you

es.e: Parents should beware of imposing their own tastes on their children.
es.c: 父母应该提防把自己的兴趣强加给孩子。

d: adj 不知疲倦的 working very hard for a long period of time in order to do something – used to show approval

es.e: untiring efforts to help the homeless
es.c: 帮助无家可归者的不懈努力

d: adj 相反的 contrary ideas, opinions, or actions are completely different and opposed to each other

es.e: Two contrary views emerged.
es.c: 出现了两种相反的观点。

es.e: The men shouted contrary orders.
es.c: 这些人大声喊叫的命令互相矛盾。

d: adj 有营养的 food that is nutritious is full of the natural substances that your body needs to stay healthy or to grow properly

es.e: Wholemeal bread is more nutritious than white bread.
es.c: 全麦面包比白面包更有营养。

es.e: Nuts and fruit make nutritious snacks.
es.c: 坚果和水果是有营养价值的零食。

es.e: The cookbook contains many simple yet highly nutritious meals.
es.c: 那本烹饪书里有许多简单却营养价值很高的食谱。

d: n 焦虑 the feeling of being very worried about something

es.e: his feelings of anxiety
es.c: 他焦虑的心情

es.e: A high level of anxiety was created by the introduction of cameras into the factory.
es.c: 工厂安装了摄像头，这引起了工人的高度不安。

es.e: It can help if you discuss your anxieties with someone.
es.c: 与别人谈谈自己的忧虑会有帮助的。

d: adj 有意义的 making you feel happy and satisfied because you feel you are doing something useful or important, even if you do not earn much money

es.e: Teaching can be a very rewarding career.
es.c: 教书可以是一种很有意义的职业。

d: adj 直接的 honest about your feelings or opinions and not hiding anything

es.e: She is very blunt, very straightforward, and very honest.
es.c: 她直言不讳，非常坦率，也非常诚实。

d: n 血统, 后裔 your family origins, especially your nationality or relationship to someone important who lived a long time ago

es.e: young men and women of Asian descent
es.c: 亚裔男女青年

es.e: The emperor claimed descent from David.
es.c: 这个皇帝自称是大卫王的后代。

d: n 友好 friendly behaviour towards visitors

es.e: Thanks for your hospitality over the past few weeks.
es.c: 感谢你几周来的热情款待。

d: n 材料，东西 used when you are talking about things such as substances, materials, or groups of objects when you do not know what they are called, or it is not important to say exactly what they are

es.e: I’ve got some sticky stuff on my shoe.
es.c: 我鞋子上有什么黏糊糊的东西。

es.e: How do you think you’re going to fit all that stuff into the car?
es.c: 你说这么多东西你怎么装进车里？

es.e: I felt sorry for the ones who had to eat the awful stuff.
es.c: 我很同情那些只能吃这种难吃东西的人。

d: v 反映；反射；思考 to show the image of sb/sth on the surface of sth such as a mirror, water or glass

es.e: His face was reflected in the mirror.
es.c: 他的脸映照在镜子里。

es.e: The windows reflected the bright afternoon sunlight.
es.c: 窗户反射着午后明媚的阳光。

es.e: He had time to reflect on his successes and failures.
es.c: 他有时间反思他的成功和失败。

d: n 木工活 the skill or work of a carpenter

es.e: I don't think he's really learning carpentry; he's only playing at it.
es.c: 我看他并不真正在学木工, 他只是在玩玩罢了。

d: v 解码 if a computer decodes data, it receives it and changes it into a form that can be used by the computer or understood by a person

es.e: The software decodes the information embedded in the satellite broadcasts.
es.c: 这种软件能够解读卫星广播中的信息。

d: n 缺点，瑕疵 a mistake, mark, or weakness that makes something imperfect

es.e: A design flaw (= a mistake or weakness in the way something was made ) caused the engine to explode.
es.c: 一个设计缺陷导致了引擎爆炸。

d: v 揭露 to make known something that was previously secret or unknown

es.e: He may be prosecuted for revealing secrets about the security agency.
es.c: 他可能因泄露安全部门的机密而被起诉。

es.e: a test that can reveal a teacher’s hidden skills
es.c: 能够展现老师潜在技能的测试

d: v 辅导 to teach someone as a tutor

es.e: He was privately tutored.
es.c: 他是由家庭教师教的。

d: v 使习惯 to make yourself or another person become used to a situation or place

es.e: She tried to accustom herself to the tight bandages.
es.c: 她尝试着使自己习惯那些紧绷的绷带。

d: n 熟人 someone you know, but who is not a close friend

es.e: She was a casual acquaintance of my family in Vienna.
es.c: 她是我们家在维也纳的一个交情不深的朋友。

es.e: He heard about the job through a mutual acquaintance (=  someone you and another person both know  ) .
es.c: 他是通过一个双方都认识的人知道有这份工作的。

d: n 分布，分配 the act of sharing things among a large group of people in a planned way

es.e: the distribution of aid supplies
es.c: 救济物资的分发

d: n 趋势 a general tendency in the way a situation is changing or developing

es.e: The current trend is towards more part-time employment.
es.c: 当前的趋势是雇用更多的兼职人员。

es.e: the general trend towards the centralization of political power
es.c: 政治权力集中化的普遍趋势

es.e: A disturbing trend is that victims of violence are getting younger.
es.c: 一个令人担心的趋势是，暴力行为的受害者越来越年轻。

d: v 激怒 to make someone feel annoyed or impatient, especially by doing something many times or for a long period of time

es.e: It really irritates me when he doesn’t help around the house.
es.c: 家里的事情他一点都不帮忙，真让我恼火。

d: adj 本质的，固有的 being part of the nature or character of someone or something

es.e: the intrinsic interest of the subject
es.c: 该话题本身的趣味

d: v 认为 to think of something in a particular way or as having a particular quality

es.e: French and German were deemed essential.
es.c: 法语和德语被认为是必需的。

d: v 唤起 to make you become interested, expect something etc

es.e: Matt’s behavior was arousing the interest of the neighbors.
es.c: 马特的行为渐渐引起了邻居的兴趣。

d: adj 郊区的 related to a suburb, or in a suburb

es.e: a quiet, suburban street
es.c: 一条安静的郊区街道

d: v 追求 to continue doing an activity or trying to achieve something over a long period of time

es.e: She plans to pursue a career in politics.
es.c: 她计划从政。

es.e: Students should pursue their own interests , as well as do their school work.
es.c: 除了完成课业之外，学生也应该追求自己的兴趣。

es.e: a campaign promise to pursue policies that will help the poor
es.c: 贯彻扶贫政策的竞选承诺

d: n 意识形态 a set of beliefs on which a political or economic system is based, or which strongly influence the way people behave

es.e: the ideologies of fascism and terrorism
es.c: 法西斯主义和恐怖主义的意识形态

es.e: a new ideology based on individualism
es.c: 基于个人主义的新思想体系

d: n 门外汉 someone who is not trained in a particular subject or type of work, especially when they are being compared with someone who is

es.e: To the layman (= laymen in general ) all these plants look pretty similar.
es.c: 对外行的人来说，这些植物看起来都很相似。

es.e: If you don’t understand what the doctor says, ask to have it explained in layman’s terms (= in simple language ).
es.c: 如果你听不懂医生的话，就请他用通俗易懂的语言来解释一下。

d: adj 即时的，瞬间的 happening immediately

es.e: modern methods of instantaneous communication
es.c: 现代的即时通信方法

d: adj 晕船的 feeling ill when you travel in a boat, because of the movement of the boat in the water

es.e: It was quite rough at times, and she was seasick.
es.c: 海上有时波涛汹涌，她就晕船。

d: v 缺少 to not have something that you need, or not have enough of it

es.e: Alex’s real problem is that he lacks confidence.
es.c: 亚历克斯的真正问题是缺乏信心。

d: v 夸张 to make something seem better, larger, worse etc than it really is

es.e: I couldn’t sleep for three days – I’m not exaggerating.
es.c: 我三天没睡觉了——一点不夸张。

d: v 放大 to make something seem bigger or louder, especially using special equipment

es.e: At the Sheffield arena, the speakers were magnified ten times on a giant screen.
es.c: 在谢菲尔德体育馆，演讲者在一个巨大的屏幕上被放大了十倍。

es.e: A public address system magnifies all the little noises and coughs.
es.c: 扩音系统会放大任何细小的噪音和咳嗽声。

d: n 利用

es.e: Computer has found an increasingly wide utilization in all fields.
es.c: 电子计算机已越来越广泛地在各个领域得到应用。

d: v 扭曲 to bend or turn something, such as wire, hair, or cloth, into a particular shape

es.e: She twisted her handkerchief into a knot.
es.c: 她把手帕绕成一个结。

d: n 探险，远征 a long and carefully organized journey, especially to a dangerous or unfamiliar place, or the people that make this journey

es.e: an expedition to the North Pole
es.c: 北极探险

es.e: another Qomolangma expedition
es.c: 又一次珠穆朗玛峰探险

d: v 转换 to change from doing or using one thing to doing or using another

es.e: The terrorists will switch tactics .
es.c: 恐怖分子会改变战术。

d: n 继承；遗产 money, property etc that you receive from someone who has died

es.e: Lucinda has to fight for her life and her inheritance in this gripping novel.
es.c: 在这部扣人心弦的小说里，露辛达不得不为自己的生命与所继承的遗产进行抗争。

d: v 赞助 to give money to a sports event, theatre, institution etc, especially in exchange for the right to advertise；n 赞助商 a person or company that pays for a show, broadcast, sports event etc, especially in exchange for th

es.e: The competition was sponsored by British Airways.
es.c: 此项比赛由英国航空公司赞助。

es.e: Eastman Kodak is a major sponsor of the Olympics.
es.c: 伊士曼柯达公司是奥运会的主要赞助商。

d: n 恶化，退化

es.e: a serious deterioration in relations between the two countries
es.c: 两国关系的严重恶化

d: adj 持续的，不间断的 continuing, or continuing to develop

es.e: their ongoing search for a new director
es.c: 他们仍在寻找一个新主任

es.e: ongoing negotiations
es.c: 还在进行的谈判

es.e: The discussions are still ongoing.
es.c: 讨论仍在继续。

d: adj 新鲜的 pleasantly different from what is familiar and boring

es.e: It made a refreshing change to talk to someone new.
es.c: 和刚认识的人谈话感觉很新鲜。

d: adv 顺便地，附带 You use incidentally to introduce a point that is not directly relevant to what you are saying, often a question or extra information that you have just thought of

es.e: "I didn't ask you to come. Incidentally, why have you come?"
es.c: “我没有叫你来。顺便问一下，你为什么来呢？”

d: v 监禁 to put someone in prison or to keep them somewhere and prevent them from leaving

es.e: The government imprisoned all opposition leaders.
es.c: 政府把反对派领导人全部监禁起来。

es.e: She was imprisoned within his strong arms.
es.c: 她被他强壮的手臂搂着。

d: v 呈现，给予 to give something to someone, for example at a formal or official occasion

es.e: She was presented with an award .
es.c: 她被授予一个奖项。

d: adj 无知的，未受过教育的 not having enough knowledge or information

es.e: Parents were left anxious, uninformed, and isolated.
es.c: 家长们忧心忡忡，不知道情况到底如何，感到孤立无援。

es.e: uninformed criticism from uninformed journalists
es.c: 来自不了解情况的新闻记者的毫无根据的批评

d: v 重叠 If one thing overlaps another, or if you overlap them, a part of the first thing occupies the same area as a part of the other thing. You can also say that two things overlap.

es.e: When the bag is folded, the bottom overlaps one side.
es.c: 把包折叠起来时，其底部与一边就重合了。

es.e: Overlap the slices carefully so there are no gaps.
es.c: 把薄片小心地叠放在一起，那样就没有间隙。

d: adj 苗条的 someone who is slim is attractively thin

es.e: a slim young woman
es.c: 身材苗条的年轻女子

es.e: a slim waist
es.c: 纤腰

d: adj 城市的，都市的 relating to towns and cities

es.e: unemployment in urban areas
es.c: 城市地区的失业状况

es.e: the deprived sections of the urban population
es.c: 城市人口中的贫困群体

d: v 排列；分级 to arrange objects in a line or row

es.e: There were several pairs of riding boots ranked neatly in the hall.
es.c: 门厅里整齐地摆放着几双马靴。

es.e: It is not always easy to rank the students in order of ability.
es.c: 把学生按能力排名并非总是容易的。

d: adj 不值得信任的，怀疑的 someone who is untrustworthy cannot be trusted

es.e: I think he is shallow, vain and untrustworthy.
es.c: 我觉得他肤浅、虚荣，并不值得信赖。

d: adv 自动地；不经思考地 by the action of a machine, without a person making it work

es.e: The doors opened automatically as we approached.
es.c: 我们走近时，门自动开了。

es.e: Of course I automatically said yes.
es.c: 当然，我脱口而出说是的。

d: adj 应负责的，有责任的 responsible for the effects of your actions and willing to explain or be criticized for them

es.e: The hospital should be held accountable for the quality of care it gives.
es.c: 医院应当对医护质量负责。

d: adj 合作的 a job or piece of work that involves two or more people working together to achieve something

es.e: ...a collaborative research project.
es.c: …一个合作研究项目。

d: n 做法 something that people do often, especially a particular way of doing something or a social or religious custom

es.e: religious beliefs and practices
es.c: 宗教信仰和习俗

es.e: dangerous working practices
es.c: 危险的工作方法

d: n 勤奋 careful and thorough work or effort

es.e: She shows great diligence in her schoolwork.
es.c: 她上学非常用功。

d: n 受害者 someone who has been attacked, robbed, or murdered

es.e: The victim received head injuries from which she died a week later.
es.c: 受害人头部受伤，一周后死亡。

es.e: a credit card fraud ring that stole millions of dollars from unsuspecting victims
es.c: 从毫无戒心的受害者手中盗取数百万美元的信用卡诈骗团伙

d: v 催促 to strongly suggest that someone does something

es.e: The charity urged quick action.
es.c: 慈善机构敦促迅速采取行动。

d: n 多产，肥沃 the ability of the land or soil to produce good crops

es.e: It symbolizes growth, harmony, freshness, and fertility.
es.c: 它是生长、和谐、新鲜和丰饶的象征。

d: n 基金会 an organization that gives or collects money to be used for special purposes, especially for charity or for medical research

es.e: the British Heart Foundation
es.c: 英国心脏病基金会

d: n 接待 a particular type of welcome for someone, or a particular type of reaction to their ideas, work etc

es.e: She was unsure of her reception after everything that had happened.
es.c: 发生了这些事后，她对自己是否还受欢迎没把握。

es.e: The delegates gave him a warm reception.
es.c: 代表团热烈欢迎他。

d: n 精英 a group of people who have a lot of power and influence because they have money, knowledge, or special skills

es.e: a struggle for power within the ruling elite
es.c: 统治阶层内部的争权夺利

d: n 自杀 the act of killing yourself

es.e: More people commit suicide at Christmas than at any other time.
es.c: 圣诞节期间自杀的人比其他任何时候都多。

es.e: My mother attempted suicide on many occasions.
es.c: 我母亲多次试图自杀。

es.e: He apparently left a suicide note (= letter explaining his reasons for killing himself ) on his desk.
es.c: 他显然在桌上留了封绝笔信。

d: adj 无能力的，不胜任的 not having the ability or skill to do a job properly

es.e: an incompetent manager
es.c: 不称职的经理

es.e: weak incompetent leadership
es.c: 软弱不称职的领导

d: adj 巨大的 very big, fast, powerful etc

es.e: Suddenly, there was a tremendous bang, and the whole station shook.
es.c: 突然一声巨响，整个车站都晃动了。

es.e: She was making a tremendous effort to appear calm.
es.c: 她竭力表现出平静的样子。

es.e: She praised her husband for the tremendous support he had given her.
es.c: 她称赞丈夫给了她巨大支持。

d: adj 可回收利用的 used materials or substances that are recyclable can be recycled

es.e: recyclable cardboard packaging
es.c: 可回收利用的纸板包装材料

d: v 想象 to form a picture of someone or something in your mind

es.e: I tried to visualize the house while he was describing it.
es.c: 我一边听他描述，一边想象那房子的样子。

d: n 运用 the use of power, influence etc to make something happen

es.e: the exertion of authority
es.c: 行使权力

d: adj 疲软的，萧条的 with less business activity than usual

es.e: Business remained slack throughout the day.
es.c: 一整天生意都很冷清。

d: adj 严格的 rigid methods, systems etc are very strict and difficult to change

es.e: rigid and authoritarian methods of education
es.c: 死板、专断的教育方法

d: adj 有机的 relating to farming or gardening methods of growing food without using artificial chemicals, or produced or grown by these methods

es.c: 有机耕作对环境更有利。

es.e: organic gardening
es.c: 有机园艺

d: n 繁殖 the act or process of producing babies, young animals, or plants

es.e: Scientists studied the reproduction, diet, and health of the dolphins.
es.c: 科学家研究了海豚的繁殖情况、进食规律和健康状况。

es.e: sexual reproduction
es.c: 有性繁殖

d: v 用带绑住 to fasten something or someone in place with one or more straps

es.e: soldiers with grenades strapped to their belts
es.c: 腰带上绑着手榴弹的士兵

d: n 精确性 the quality of being very exact or correct

es.e: The choir sang with precision.
es.c: 合唱团的演唱准确无误。

d: v 标准化 to make all the things of one particular type the same as each other

es.e: Attempts to standardize English spelling have never been successful.
es.c: 统一英语拼写的尝试从未成功过。

es.e: standardized tests
es.c: 标准化测试

d: adv 适当地 named, described etc in a way that seems very suitable

es.e: The aptly named Skyline Restaurant provides spectacular views of the city below.
es.c: 天际餐厅名副其实，可以俯瞰城市美景。

d: n 促销 an activity intended to help sell a product, or the product that is being promoted

es.e: a winter sales promotion
es.c: 冬季促销活动

d: v 瘫痪，麻痹 if something paralyzes you, it makes you lose the ability to move part or all of your body, or to feel it

es.e: Her legs were partly paralysed in the crash.
es.c: 在撞车事故中她的双腿部分瘫痪。

es.e: A guy with paralysed legs is not supposed to ride horses.
es.c: 一个双腿瘫痪的人不该骑马。

d: n 退化，变质 the process of becoming worse or less acceptable in quality or condition

es.e: social/moral degeneration
es.c: 社会倒退；道德沦丧

es.e: Intensive farming in the area has caused severe degeneration of the land.
es.c: 这个地区的集约化农业使得土壤严重贫瘠化。

d: v 抑制，避免 to not do something that you want to do

es.e: Please refrain from smoking in this area.
es.c: 请勿在此处吸烟。

d: n 口味 the particular taste of a food or drink

es.e: Which flavor do you want - chocolate or vanilla?
es.c: 你要哪种味道的，巧克力还是香草？

es.e: a dry wine with flavors of honey and apricot
es.c: 带有蜂蜜和杏子口味的干葡萄酒

d: n 冒险 an exciting experience in which dangerous or unusual things happen

es.e: a great adventure
es.c: 一大奇遇

es.e: Ahab’s adventures at sea
es.c: 亚哈的海上历险

es.e: an adventure story
es.c: 一个历险故事

d: v 使痛苦 to think about a difficult decision very carefully and with a lot of effort

es.e: All the way home she agonized about what she should do.
es.c: 回家一路上，她都在发愁该怎么办。

d: v 增加 to increase gradually in amount or degree

es.e: Tension here is mounting , as we await the final result.
es.c: 我们等待着最终结果，这里的气氛也越来越紧张。

es.e: Casualties on both sides of the battle have continued to mount.
es.c: 交战双方的伤亡人数继续增加。

d: v 反对 to disagree with something such as a plan or idea and try to prevent it from happening or succeeding

es.e: Congress is continuing to oppose the President’s health care budget.
es.c: 国会继续反对总统的医疗保健预算。

d: adj 理所应当的 actions, reactions, decisions etc that are justifiable are acceptable because they are done for good reasons

es.e: justifiable anger
es.c: 情有可原的愤怒

es.e: Are these experiments morally justifiable?
es.c: 这些实验合乎道德准则吗？

d: v 促进 If people promote something, they help or encourage it to happen, increase, or spread

es.e: You don't have to sacrifice environmental protection to promote economic growth.
es.c: 你们没有必要牺牲环保来促进经济增长。

d: adj 可再生的 renewable energy replaces itself naturally, or is easily replaced because there is a large supply of it

es.e: renewable energy such as solar power
es.c: 太阳能等可再生能源

es.e: an industry based on renewable resources
es.c: 基于可再生资源的行业

d: n 假设，假说 an idea that is suggested as an explanation for something, but that has not yet been proved to be true

es.e: One hypothesis is that the victim fell asleep while driving.
es.c: 一种假设是受害人开车时睡着了。

d: n 展示；讲话 the way in which something is said, offered, shown, or explained to others

es.e: desktop devices for the presentation of information
es.c: 显示信息用的桌面设备

es.e: James Watson, Philip Mayo and I gave a slide and video presentation.
es.c: 詹姆斯·沃森、菲利普·梅奥和我一起做了一场有幻灯和录像片的讲座。

d: v 迎合 To cater to a group of people means to provide all the things that they need or want

es.e: We cater to an exclusive clientele.
es.c: 我们满足一个特殊客户群的需求。

d: adj 公正的 unbiased information, opinions, advice etc is fair because the person giving it is not influenced by their own or other people’s opinions

es.e: We aim to provide a service that is balanced and unbiased.
es.c: 我们的目标是提供一种公平公正的服务。

es.e: an unbiased observer
es.c: 一名公正的观察员

d: adj 沉浸的，身临其境的 providing information or stimulation for a number of senses, not only sight and sound

es.e: “Right now, we’re just getting to the phase where people appreciate how an “immersive” digital environment can be as complex and rich as sensation, ” he says.
es.c: “现在，我们要进入一个阶段，让人们能够领会到‘沉浸式’数字环境可以像感觉一样复杂而丰富，”他说

d: n 领域 an area of activity, interest, or knowledge, especially one that a particular person, organization etc deals with

es.e: Looking after the house was viewed as a woman’s domain.
es.c: 料理家务被认为是女性的份内之事。

d: adj 原始的；简单的 belonging to a simple way of life that existed in the past and does not have modern industries and machines

es.e: a primitive society
es.c: 原始社会

es.e: a primitive nomadic tribe
es.c: 原始的游牧部落

es.e: The first station buildings were quite primitive.
es.c: 最初的车站建筑很简陋。

d: adj 急迫的 very important and needing to be dealt with immediately

es.e: He was in urgent need of medical attention.
es.c: 他急需治疗。

es.e: The report called for urgent action to reduce lead in petrol.
es.c: 报告呼吁迅速采取行动，减少汽油中的铅含量。

es.e: an urgent message
es.c: 一封急报

d: v 威胁 to say that you will cause someone harm or trouble if they do not do what you want

es.e: Postal workers are threatening a strike if they don’t receive a pay increase.
es.c: 邮政工人威胁如果不加薪，他们就要罢工。

d: n 王位 the position and power of being a king or queen

es.e: He is next in line to the throne (= will become king when the present ruler dies ) .
es.c: 他是第一王位继承人。

es.e: In 1913, George V was on the throne (= was ruling ) .
es.c: 1913年乔治五世在位。

d: adj 资金不足的 a project, organization etc that is underfunded has not been given enough money to be effective

es.e: For years we have argued that the FDA is underfunded.
es.c: 数年来我们一直在讲食品及药物管理局经费不足。

d: n 监狱 a place where criminals are kept as part of their punishment, or where people who have been charged with a crime are kept before they are judged in a law court

es.e: He’s been in jail for three months already.
es.c: 他已经入狱三个月。

d: n 评估，评价 a process in which you make a judgment about a person or situation, or the judgment you make

es.e: a reading assessment test
es.c: 阅读评估测试

d: v 使挫败，使沮丧 if something frustrates you, it makes you feel annoyed or angry because you are unable to do what you want

es.e: The fact that he’s working with amateurs really frustrates him.
es.c: 与生手共事着实让他沮丧。

d: n 废除 when a law or a system is officially ended

es.c: 巴西和加勒比海地区对奴隶制的废除很大程度上遵循了美国的模式。

d: n 侦探 a police officer whose job is to discover information about crimes and catch criminals

es.e: detectives from the anti-terrorist squad
es.c: 反恐怖主义小组的侦探

es.e: a detective story/novel
es.c: 侦探故事 / 小说

d: n 摩天大楼 a very tall modern city building

es.e: The skyscraper towers into the clouds.
es.c: 那幢摩天大楼高耸入云。

es.e: The majesty of the skyscraper awed me .
es.c: 这幢摩天大厦的雄伟气势令我惊叹。

d: n 腐败 dishonest, illegal, or immoral behaviour, especially from someone with power

es.e: officials charged with bribery and corruption
es.c: 被指控受贿和贪污的官员

es.e: The investigation uncovered widespread corruption within the police force.
es.c: 这项调查揭发出了警察机关内部普遍的腐败。

d: adj 无法容忍的 If you describe someone as intolerant, you mean that they do not accept behaviour and opinions that are different from their own

es.e: people who are intolerant of other people’s political beliefs
es.c: 不能容忍他人政治信仰的人

d: v 刺穿 to make a small hole in or through something, using an object with a sharp point
