es.c: 把玉米蒸到用叉子可以轻易扎透。

es.e: Rose underwent emergency surgery after a bullet pierced her lung.
es.c: 罗丝被子弹射穿肺部，接受了紧急手术。

d: v 弥补 to replace or balance the effect of something bad

es.e: Because my left eye is so weak, my right eye has to work harder to compensate.
es.c: 因为我左眼视力差，右眼就要辛苦点来弥补一下。

d: n 差距 a big difference between two situations, amounts, groups of people etc

es.e: ...the gap between rich and poor.
es.c: …贫富差距。

d: v 崇拜，喜爱 to admire and love someone very much

es.e: He absolutely worships her.
es.c: 他太崇拜她了。

d: n 美术馆 a large building where people can see famous pieces of art

es.e: an exhibition of African art at the Hayward Gallery
es.c: 海沃德美术馆的非洲艺术展览

d: n 教练 someone who trains a person or team in a sport

es.e: a tennis coach
es.c: 网球教练

es.e: the Norwegian national coach
es.c: 挪威国家队教练

d: v 取消 to decide that something that was officially planned will not happen

es.e: Our flight was cancelled.
es.c: 我们的航班取消了。

es.e: I’m afraid I’ll have to cancel our meeting tomorrow.
es.c: 恐怕我得取消我们明天的会议。

es.e: You’ll just have to ring John and cancel.
es.c: 你只能打电话给约翰取消了。

d: n 罢工 a period of time when a group of workers deliberately stop working because of a disagreement about pay, working conditions etc

es.e: The government has promised that the army will be called in to help if there is a firemen’s strike.
es.c: 政府承诺，如消防员罢工，就将调军队来协助。

d: n 叛逆 an organized attempt to change the government or leader of a country, using violence

es.e: an armed rebellion
es.c: 武装叛乱

d: v 分心，分散注意 to take someone’s attention away from something by making them look at or listen to something else

es.e: Try not to distract the other students.
es.c: 尽量不要让其他学生分心。

d: adj 必须的,必要的 extremely important and needing to be done or dealt with immediately

es.e: It is imperative that politicians should be good communicators.
es.c: 政治家应该是很好的沟通者，这很重要。

d: n 地质学 the study of the rocks, soil etc that make up the Earth, and of the way they have changed since the Earth was formed

es.e: He was visiting professor of geology at the University of Georgia.
es.c: 他曾是佐治亚大学的地质学客座教授。

d: v 影响 to influence someone so that they change their opinion

es.e: Don’t allow yourself to be swayed by his promises.
es.c: 你可不要听了他的许诺就改变主意呀。

d: n 服装 a set of clothes worn by an actor or by someone to make them look like something such as an animal, famous person etc

es.e: the film’s lavish costumes and spectacular sets
es.c: 影片中奢华的戏装和壮观的场景

es.e: Hallowe’en costumes
es.c: 万圣节前夕化装服

d: adj 手工的；体力的 manual work involves using your hands or your physical strength rather than your mind

es.e: People in manual occupations have a lower life expectancy.
es.c: 干体力活的人预期寿命较短。

d: adj 可量化的 Something that is quantifiable can be measured or counted in a scientific way

es.e: A clearly quantifiable measure of quality is not necessary.
es.c: 一种确切的可计量的质量检测是不必要的。

d: n 费用，花销 the action of spending or using time, money, energy etc

es.e: the expenditure of time and money on your house or garden
es.c: 你在房子或花园上所花费的时间和金钱

d: v 繁殖；导致 if animals breed, they mate in order to have babies

es.e: Eagles breed during the cooler months of the year.
es.c: 鹰在一年中较凉爽的季节交配繁殖。

d: v 出现 to appear or come out from somewhere

es.e: The flowers emerge in the spring.
es.c: 花儿在春天开放。

d: adj 著名的 well known or famous, especially because of some special quality or ability

es.e: a noted author
es.c: 著名作家

d: v 安放 to carefully put something in a particular position；n 位置；职位 the place where someone or something is, especially in relation to other objects and places

es.e: Position the cursor before the letter you want to delete.
es.c: 把光标放在你想删去的字母之前。

es.e: Our hotel was in a superb central position near St Mark’s Square.
es.c: 我们的酒店处于极佳的中心位置，在圣马克广场附近。

es.e: Bruce is thinking of applying for the position.
es.c: 布鲁斯正在考虑申请那个职位。

d: n 灭绝 when a particular type of animal or plant stops existing

es.e: species in danger of extinction
es.c: 有灭绝危险的物种

es.e: They were hunted almost to extinction.
es.c: 它们遭受猎杀，几近灭绝。

es.e: Conservationists are trying to save the whale from extinction.
es.c: 生态环境保护工作者正努力挽救鲸类以防止其灭绝。

d: n 接待员 someone whose job is to welcome and deal with people arriving in a hotel or office building, visiting a doctor etc

es.e: You tell the receptionist that you are expecting a call from this client and to put them through.
es.c: 你告诉传达员你正在等待一个来自这个客户的电话，并允许将他们接进来。

d: adj 鲁莽的 not caring or worrying about the possible bad or dangerous results of your actions

es.e: He was accused of causing death by reckless driving .
es.c: 他被控因鲁莽驾驶致人死亡。

es.e: a reckless disregard for safety
es.c: 不顾安全的鲁莽行为

es.e: He ran into the burning house with reckless abandon (= without caring about the danger ) .
es.c: 他不顾危险冲入着火的房子里。

d: n 虐待 cruel or violent treatment of someone；v 滥用 to deliberately use something for the wrong purpose or for your own advantage

es.e: several cases of child abuse
es.c: 数宗虐待儿童案

es.e: An independent committee will look into alleged human rights abuses.
es.c: 一个独立委员会将对涉嫌践踏人权的行为进行调查。

es.e: Williams abused his position as Mayor to give jobs to his friends.
es.c: 威廉斯滥用市长权力，给不少朋友安排了工作。

d: v 指控 to say that you believe someone is guilty of a crime or of doing something bad

es.e: The professor stands accused of (=  has been accused of  ) stealing his student’s ideas and publishing them.
es.c: 那位教授被指控剽窃学生的观点拿去发表。

d: n 生物化学 the scientific study of the chemistry of living things

es.e: ...the effects of air pollutants on the biochemistry of plants or animals.
es.c: …大气污染物对植物或动物生化过程的影响。

d: n 乐观 a tendency to believe that good things will always happen

es.e: There are grounds for cautious optimism.
es.c: 有理由保持谨慎乐观。

d: v 预测 to say that something will happen, before it happens

es.e: Sales were five percent lower than predicted.
es.c: 销售额比预期低5%。

es.e: As Liz had predicted , the rumours were soon forgotten.
es.c: 正如利兹所预料的，流言很快就被淡忘了。

d: adv 臭名昭著地

es.e: He is notoriously indiscreet about his private life.
es.c: 他在私生活方面的不检点是出了名的。

d: n 董事会 a group of people in a company or other organization who make the rules and important decisions

es.e: a board meeting
es.c: 董事会会议

es.e: a board member
es.c: 董事会成员

d: v 形成 to exist in a way that may cause a problem, danger, difficulty etc

es.e: Rising unemployment is posing serious problems for the administration.
es.c: 失业率上升正在给政府造成严重的问题。

d: n 备忘录 a  memo

es.e: ...a memorandum from the Department of Defense on its role.
es.c: …一份来自国防部的有关其角色的备忘录。

d: adj 迷惑的，困扰的 confusing and difficult to understand or explain

es.e: a puzzling fact
es.c: 令人费解的情况

es.e: Gary found her reaction puzzling.
es.c: 加里对她的反应感到迷惑。

d: adj 可靠的 someone or something that is reliable can be trusted or depended on

es.e: Judged by the ordinary standards,he was reliable
es.c: 用一般的标准衡量，他是可信赖的。

es.e: Miller was a quiet and reliable man.
es.c: 米勒是个话不多且可靠的人。

d: n 代替 when you get something that is newer or better than the one you had before

es.e: Our old car is badly in need of replacement.
es.c: 我们的旧车急需更换。

es.e: replacement windows
es.c: 新换的窗户

d: v 增强，强化 to give support to an opinion, idea, or feeling, and make it stronger

es.e: The film reinforces the idea that women should be pretty and dumb.
es.c: 这部影片强化了这个观点——女人要漂亮，而且要笨一些。

d: v 传授，教授 to give information, knowledge, wisdom etc to someone

es.e: She had information that she couldn’t wait to impart.
es.c: 她得到了消息，迫不及待地想告诉别人。

d: n 多样性 the fact of including many different types of people or things

es.e: ...the cultural diversity of Latin America.
es.c: …拉丁美洲文化的多样性。

d: n 职业 a job or profession

es.e: Please state your name, address and occupation.
es.c: 请写明你的姓名、地址和职业。

es.e: professional and managerial occupations
es.c: 专业及管理工作

es.e: manual occupations
es.c: 体力工作

d: adj 激烈的，强烈的 having a very strong effect or felt very strongly

es.e: Young people today are under intense pressure to succeed.
es.c: 如今的年轻人面临要出人头地的巨大压力。

es.e: the intense heat of the desert
es.c: 沙漠的炽热

es.e: The pain was so intense I couldn’t sleep.
es.c: 疼得我都睡不着觉。

d: adv 大幅度地；戏剧性地

es.e: Prices have fallen dramatically.
es.c: 价格突然暴跌。

d: n 意识 knowledge or understanding of a particular subject or situation

es.e: Health officials have tried to raise awareness (=  improve people’s knowledge  ) about AIDS.
es.c: 卫生部官员努力提高人们对艾滋病的认识。

d: adv 几乎 almost

es.e: Virtually all the children come to school by bus.
es.c: 几乎所有的孩子都乘公交车上学。

es.e: He was virtually unknown before running for office.
es.c: 他在参加竞选之前几乎不为人知。

d: n 成熟 the quality of behaving in a sensible way like an adult

es.e: Beth shows a maturity way beyond her 16 years.
es.c: 贝丝表现出一种远远超出她16岁年龄的成熟。

es.e: One day you’ll have the maturity to understand.
es.c: 有一天等你长大后你就明白了。

d: adj 罕见的，稀少的 not seen or found very often, or not happening very often

es.e: This species of plant is becoming increasingly rare.
es.c: 这种植物越来越罕见。

es.e: I only saw Helen on the rare occasions when I went into her shop.
es.c: 我只有偶尔去海伦店里时才会见到她。

es.e: It is very rare for her to miss a day at school.
es.c: 她很少有哪一天不上学的。

d: v 限制，控制 to control or limit something in order to prevent it from having a harmful effect

es.e: measures to curb the spread of the virus
es.c: 控制病毒扩散的措施

d: v 恩惠；善意的行为 something that you do for someone in order to help them or be kind to them

es.e: Could you do me a favour and tell Kelly I can’t make it?
es.c: 你帮个忙告诉凯莉说我来不了好吗？

d: n 生产力 the rate at which goods are produced, and the amount produced, especially in relation to the work, time, and money needed to produce them

es.e: high productivity levels in manufacturing
es.c: 制造业中的高生产率

es.e: It cost the country $4 million in lost productivity .
es.c: 它对该国造成了400万美元的生产力损失。

d: n 机制 a system that is intended to achieve something or deal with a problem

es.e: existing mechanisms for decision making
es.c: 现行的决策机制

es.e: The Army has set up mechanisms to help jobless ex-soldiers get work.
es.c: 军队建立了帮助无工作的退伍军人找到工作的机制。

d: n 直升飞机 a type of aircraft with large metal blades on top which turn around very quickly to make it fly

es.e: She swore she saw him putting the helicopter down in a cornfield.
es.c: 她肯定地说她看到他把那架直升飞机降落到了玉米地里。

es.e: The helicopter is staying over our heads.
es.c: 那架直升机就在我们头顶的上方。

d: n 有效性；真实性 the state of being legally or officially acceptable

es.e: The period of validity of the agreement has expired.
es.c: 本协议的有效期已过。

es.e: Shocked by the results of the elections, they now want to challenge the validity of the vote.
es.c: 震惊于这些选举的结果，他们现在想质疑投票的可信性。

d: adj 相关的 directly relating to the subject or problem being discussed or considered

es.e: Relevant documents were presented in court.
es.c: 法庭上出示了相关的文件。

es.e: We received all the relevant information.
es.c: 我们收到了所有相关信息。

d: n 奇迹 something very lucky or very good that happens which you did not expect to happen or did not think was possible

es.e: It’s a miracle you weren’t killed!
es.c: 你没有死真是奇迹！

es.e: By some miracle, we managed to catch the plane.
es.c: 我们奇迹般地赶上了飞机。

es.e: the economic miracle of the 1950s
es.c: 20世纪50年代的经济奇迹

d: n 肥料 a substance that is put on the soil to make plants grow

es.e: ...farming without any purchased chemical, fertilizer or pesticide.
es.c: …不使用任何购买的化学品、肥料或杀虫剂的耕作。

d: adj 阴凉的 protected from the sun or producing shade

es.e: a shady street
es.c: 背阴的街道

es.e: It was nice and shady under the trees.
es.c: 树下好阴凉。

d: n 民意测验 the process of finding out what people think about something by asking many people the same question, or the record of the result

es.e: A recent poll found that 80% of Californians support the governor.
es.c: 最近的一项民意调查发现80%的加利福尼亚人支持州长。

es.e: Polls indicate that education is the top issue with voters.
es.c: 民意调查显示，教育是选民心中的头等大事。

es.e: Labour is ahead in the polls.
es.c: 工党在民意调查中处于领先地位。

d: n 对策 an action taken to prevent another action from having a harmful effect

es.e: new countermeasures against terrorism
es.c: 对抗恐怖主义的新措施

d: adj 世间的，尘世的 relating to ordinary life rather than spiritual or religious ideas

es.e: He seemed very calm and far removed from worldly concerns.
es.c: 他显得非常淡定，完全没有俗世的忧虑。

d: n 立法者 someone who has the power to make laws or belongs to an institution that makes laws

es.e: ...an attempt to get U.S. legislators to change the system.
es.c: …让美国立法者改变体制的一次努力。

d: n 活动 a series of actions intended to achieve a particular result relating to politics or business, or a social improvement

es.e: Jones ran a good campaign.
es.c: 琼斯的活动搞得很成功。

es.e: Police have launched a campaign to crack down on drug dealers.
es.c: 警方发起了一场严厉打击毒贩的运动。

d: n 可能性 how likely it is that something will or will not happen

es.e: You can narrow the odds of a nasty accident happening in your home by being more safety-conscious.
es.c: 增强安全意识可以减少家中发生意外危险的可能性。

es.e: The odds against a plane crash are around a million to one.
es.c: 发生空难的可能性仅有约百万分之一。

es.e: I’m afraid that the odds are heavily against her winning (= it is not likely ).
es.c: 恐怕她获胜的可能性很小。

d: v 引导，带领 to lead or guide a group of people somewhere, making sure that they go where you want them to go

es.e: The tour guides shepherded the rest of the group onto the bus.
es.c: 导游把团中的其他人带上了巴士

d: n 计划表 a plan of what someone is going to do and when they are going to do it

es.e: How can he fit everything into his busy schedule ?
es.c: 他是怎么把所有的事情都排进自己忙碌的时间表的？

d: v 取得，获取 to find information, especially on a computer

es.e: Users can access their voice mail remotely.
es.c: 用户可以远程获取语音邮件。

d: n 猫头鹰 a bird with large eyes that hunts at night

es.e: An owl hooted nearby.
es.c: 一只猫头鹰在附近啼叫。

es.e: The owl is sacred for many Californian Indian people.
es.c: 对于很多加利福尼亚的印第安人而言，猫头鹰是圣物。

d: v 口译；解释 to translate spoken words from one language into another

es.e: They spoke good Spanish, and promised to interpret for me.
es.c: 他们西班牙语说得很好，答应替我翻译。

es.e: Freud’s attempts to interpret the meaning of dreams
es.c: 弗洛伊德对梦的含义的解析

d: n 干涉 the act of becoming involved in an argument, fight, or other difficult situation in order to change what happens

es.e: government intervention to regulate prices
es.c: 政府介入控制物价

d: v 抱怨；惋惜 to complain or say that you are disappointed about something

es.e: He was bemoaning the fact that lawyers charge so much.
es.c: 他抱怨律师收费太高。

d: v 决定 to decide to do something

es.e: We determined to leave at once.
es.c: 我们决定立即离开。

d: v 引起，导致 if you incur something unpleasant, it happens to you because of something you have done

es.e: She wondered what she’d done to incur his displeasure this time.
es.c: 她奇怪她这次做了什么引起他的不悦。

d: adj 字面的 the literal meaning of a word or expression is its basic or original meaning

es.e: A trade war is not a war in the literal sense.
es.c: 贸易战不是字面意义上的战争。

d: n 提议，主题 a suggestion, or something that is suggested or considered as a possible thing to do

es.e: He telephoned Stuart with a proposition.
es.c: 他打电话给斯图尔特提了个建议。

es.e: I’ve got a proposition to put to you.
es.c: 我要向你提个建议。

d: n 可行

es.e: a feasibility study on the proposed new airport
es.c: 关于建议中新机场的可行性研究

d: adj 破坏性的，毁灭性的 causing damage to people or things

es.e: the destructive power of modern weapons
es.c: 现代武器的破坏力

d: v 使非国有化 to sell a business or industry that is owned by the state, so that it is then owned privately

es.e: The government started to denationalize financial institutions.
es.c: 政府开始将金融机构私有化。

d: n 度假胜地 a place where a lot of people go for holidays

es.e: Lagoon Reef is one of the best resort hotels.
es.c: 潟湖礁是最好的度假酒店之一。

d: v 忙于，从事；雇佣 If you engage in an activity, you do it or are actively involved with it

es.e: I have never engaged in drug trafficking.
es.c: 我从来没有从事过贩毒。

es.e: Her father engaged a tutor to improve her maths.
es.c: 她爸爸请了一位家庭教师给她补习数学。

d: v 解除，消除 to reduce the size of your army, navy etc, and the number of your weapons

es.e: Getting the rebels to disarm will not be easy.
es.c: 要让叛乱分子解除武装并非易事。

d: adv 大约

es.e: The yolk contains all the fat and approximately half of the protein of the egg.
es.c: 蛋黄含有鸡蛋中全部的脂肪和大约一半的蛋白质。

d: v 遮盖，遮蔽 to put something over or be over something in order to hide, close, or protect it

es.e: Cover the pot and bake for an hour.
es.c: 把锅盖上，烘烤一小时。

d: n 证实

es.e: In this example, the validation fails.
es.c: 在这个示例中，验证失败。

es.e: In the next tip in this series, we'll examine the other side of validation: exception handling.
es.c: 在本系列的下一篇技巧文章中，我们将研究验证的另一方面：异常处理。

d: adj 广泛传播的 existing or happening in many places or situations, or among many people

es.e: the widespread use of chemicals in agriculture
es.c: 化学品在农业中的广泛使用

d: adj 不道德的 morally unacceptable

es.e: unethical medical practices
es.c: 不道德的医疗行为

d: v 撤销，撤退 to stop taking part in an activity, belonging to an organization etc, or to make someone do this

es.e: calls for Britain to withdraw from the European Union
es.c: 要求英国退出欧盟的呼声

d: v 接替，转播 if radio or television signals are relayed, they are received and sent, especially so that they can be heard on the radio or seen on television

es.e: The broadcasts were relayed by satellite.
es.c: 这些电视节目通过卫星进行转播。

d: adv 流利地

es.e: She can speak English fluently.
es.c: 她能流利地说英语。

es.e: I can't speak English fluently as I am out of practice.
es.c: 我不能流利地说英语， 因为我已荒疏了。

es.e: We should train our students to speak English fluently and accurately.
es.c: 我们应培养学生流利而准确地讲英语。

d: adv 神秘地

es.e: She was silent, smiling mysteriously.
es.c: 她沉默不语，神秘地笑着。

es.e: My watch had mysteriously disappeared.
es.c: 我的手表不知怎么就不见了。

d: v 阻碍 to make it difficult for something to develop or succeed

es.e: His career has been hindered by injury.
es.c: 由于受伤，他的事业受到了阻碍。

es.e: policies that will hinder rather than help families
es.c: 对家庭有害无益的政策

d: n 会议；学年 a formal meeting or group of meetings, especially of a law court or parliament

es.e: Board members met in closed session (= with nobody else present ) .
es.c: 委员会成员举行了闭门会议。

d: adj 博士后的 A postdoctoral student has completed his or her doctorate and is doing further study or research

es.e: Most postdoctoral work is funded by the research councils.
es.c: 大部分的博士后的工作都是由研究会资助的。

d: v 优先 to deal with one thing first, because it is the most important

es.e: The public wants to see the fight against crime prioritized.
es.c: 公众希望能把打击犯罪放在第一位。

d: adj 两党的 involving two political parties, especially parties with opposing views

es.e: a bipartisan committee
es.c: 一个由两党代表组成的委员会

d: n 勉强，不情愿 when someone is unwilling to do something, or when they do something slowly to show that they are not very willing

es.e: Wells finally agreed, but with reluctance.
es.c: 韦尔斯最终同意了，但很勉强。

d: adj 直觉的 an intuitive idea is based on a feeling rather than on knowledge or facts

es.e: He seemed to have an intuitive awareness of how I felt.
es.c: 他好像凭直觉就知道我的感受。

d: v 引用 to repeat exactly what someone else has said or written

es.e: He quoted a short passage from the Bible.
es.c: 他引用了《圣经》里的一小段。

es.e: A military spokesman was quoted as saying that the border area is now safe.
es.c: 报道引述军方一位发言人的话，说边境地区现在很安全。

d: adj 务实的，讲求实际的 dealing with problems in a sensible practical way instead of strictly following a set of ideas

es.e: Williams took a more pragmatic approach to management problems.
es.c: 威廉斯在管理问题上采用的是一种更务实的做法。

d: v 减轻，缓解 to make something less painful or difficult to deal with

es.e: measures to alleviate poverty
es.c: 扶贫措施

d: adj 潜在的，基础的 the cause, idea etc that is the most important, although it is not easily noticed

es.e: the underlying causes of her depression
es.c: 她抑郁的根本原因

es.e: There is an underlying assumption that younger workers are easier to train.
es.c: 有一种潜在的假设，认为年轻一些的雇员容易培训。

d: v 产生 to produce or cause something

es.e: a useful technique for generating new ideas
es.c: 能产生新创意的有用技术

es.e: The program would generate a lot of new jobs.
es.c: 这个项目将创造许多新的就业岗位。

d: n 失常 If you refer to a dysfunction in something such as a relationship or someone's behaviour, you mean that it is different from what is considered to be normal.

es.e: ...his severe emotional dysfunction was very clearly apparent.
es.c: ...他情绪的严重异常是显而易见的。

d: adj 入侵的 an invasive disease spreads quickly and is difficult to stop

es.e: invasive bladder cancers
es.c: 扩散性膀胱癌

d: v 忽视 to behave as if you had not heard or seen someone or something

es.e: The phone rang, but she ignored it.
es.c: 电话铃响了，但她只当没听见。

es.e: Sam rudely ignored the question.
es.c: 萨姆粗鲁地对这个问题不予理睬。

d: adj 具体的 a specific thing, person, or group is one particular thing, person, or group

es.e: games suitable for specific age groups
es.c: 适合特定年龄组的游戏

es.e: a specific example of alcohol’s effect on the body
es.c: 酒精对身体影响的具体例子

d: adj 高雅的，雅致的 beautiful, attractive, or graceful

es.e: a tall, elegant young woman
es.c: 身材高挑、举止优雅的年轻女子

es.e: You can dine in elegant surroundings.
es.c: 你可以在雅致的环境中进餐。

d: adj 资金的，资本的 relating to money that you use to start a business or to make more money

es.e: capital investments
es.c: 资本投资

d: v 表明 to show that a particular situation exists, or that something is likely to be true

es.e: The study indicates a connection between poverty and crime.
es.c: 研究显示贫穷和犯罪有关联。

d: adj 适合的；胜任的 someone who is eligible for something is able or allowed to do it, for example because they are the right age

es.e: Students on a part-time course are not eligible for a loan.
es.c: 非全日制课程的学生没有资格申请贷款。

d: n 程序 a way of doing something, especially the correct or usual way

es.e: On board, we were given the usual talk on safety procedures (= what to do if an accident happens, or to prevent an accident ) .
es.c: 在飞机上，我们听了例行的飞行安全讲解。

d: adj 不现实的 unrealistic ideas or hopes are not reasonable or sensible

es.e: Some parents have totally unrealistic expectations of teachers.
es.c: 有些家长对老师抱着完全不切实际的期望。

d: v 发生 to happen

es.e: A third of accidental deaths occur in the home.
es.c: 有三分之一的意外死亡发生在家里。

es.e: The explosion occurred at 5.30 a.m.
es.c: 爆炸发生在清晨5点30分。

d: v 加重，加剧 to make a bad situation, an illness, or an injury worse

es.e: Their money problems were further aggravated by a rise in interest rates.
es.c: 由于利率上调，他们的财务问题更加严重。

es.e: Building the new road will only aggravate the situation .
es.c: 建造那条新路只会使情况恶化。

d: adv 坦率地 used to show that you are saying what you really think about something

es.e: Frankly, I think the Internet is overrated.
es.c: 坦率地说，我认为因特网被高估了。

es.e: His behaviour was frankly disgraceful.
es.c: 他的行为老实说是可耻的。

d: adj 令人兴奋的 interesting and exciting

es.e: a thrilling 3-2 victory
es.c: 比分为3比2的激动人心的胜利

d: adj 不可逆的；不可取消的 irreversible damage, change etc is so serious or so great that you cannot change something back to how it was before

es.e: Fossil fuels have caused irreversible damage to the environment.
es.c: 矿物燃料已对环境造成了不可挽回的破坏。

d: adj 海洋的 relating to the sea and the creatures that live there

es.e: the enormous variety of marine life
es.c: 海洋生物繁多的种类

es.e: the effects of oil pollution on marine mammals
es.c: 石油污染对海洋哺乳动物的影响

es.e: marine biology
es.c: 海洋生物学

d: adj 种族间的 between different races of people

es.e: interracial marriage
es.c: 种族间的通婚

d: adj 严重的 grave problems, situations, or worries are very great or bad

es.e: Matthew’s life is in grave danger .
es.c: 马修的生命危在旦夕。

es.e: The report expressed grave concern over the technicians’ lack of training.
es.c: 报告中对技术人员缺乏培训深表忧虑。

es.e: I have grave doubts about his ability.
es.c: 我十分怀疑他的能力。

d: adj 无证明的 without the required official papers, permits, etc.

es.e: The place is rife with smugglers, dealers, undocumented immigrants, and slaves.
es.c: 这里到处都是走私者、交易商、无证移民甚至奴隶。

es.e: “The plan would bring undocumented workers already in this country out of the shadows without amnesty and without animosity,” he said.
es.c: 他说："这项方案将使已在美国的无证件非法移民无需通过大赦、也不引起敌对情绪地摆脱阴影。

d: v 任命 to choose someone for a position or a job

es.e: officials appointed by the government
es.c: 政府任命的官员

d: adj 修辞的 using speech or writing in special ways in order to persuade people or to produce an impressive effect

es.e: a speech full of rhetorical phrases
es.c: 充满华丽辞藻的演讲

d: n 动力，势头 the ability to keep increasing, developing, or being more successful

es.e: incentives to maintain the momentum of European integration
es.c: 保持欧洲一体化发展势头的激励措施

es.e: Governments often lose momentum in their second term of office.
es.c: 政府往往会在第二届任期中丧失冲劲。

d: v 值得 to have earned something by good or bad actions or behaviour

es.e: What have I done to deserve this?
es.c: 我做了什么事，要得到这样的报应？

es.e: I’m sorry for the kids. They deserve better (= deserve to be treated in a better way ) .
es.c: 我为这些孩子感到难过，他们应该过得更好。

es.e: Ledley deserves a place in the team.
es.c: 莱德利应该在队里占有一席之地。

d: adv 激烈地，猛烈地

es.e: Output has been drastically reduced.
es.c: 产量已急剧下降。

es.e: Things have started to go drastically wrong.
es.c: 情况变得完全失控。

d: n 粒子，微粒 a very small piece of something

es.e: dust particles
es.c: 尘埃

d: adj 微型的 much smaller than normal

es.e: miniature roses
es.c: 微型玫瑰

es.e: a miniature railway
es.c: 微型铁路

es.e: He looked like a miniature version of his father.
es.c: 他看上去像是他父亲的微缩版。

d: v 值得 to be good, important, or serious enough for praise or attention；n 优点 an advantage or good feature of something

es.e: The results have been encouraging enough to merit further investigation.
es.c: 结果令人振奋，值得进一步调查研究。

es.e: It’s a fascinating book which merits attention.
es.c: 这是本引人入胜的书，值得关注。

es.e: The merit of the report is its realistic assessment of the changes required.
es.c: 这份报告的优点就是它对所要求的变动进行了实事求是的评估。

d: n 种类 a group of people or things that are all of the same type

es.e: people in the over-45 age category
es.c: 属45岁以上年龄组的人

es.e: Seats are available in eight of the ten price categories .
es.c: 座位共有10种票价，现有8种可售。

es.e: Williams’ style does not fit easily into the category of jazz.
es.c: 威廉斯的风格不能轻易归入爵士乐的范畴。

d: n 责任；债务 legal responsibility for something, especially for paying money that is owed, or for damage or injury

es.e: Tenants have legal liability for any damage they cause.
es.c: 承租人造成任何损坏都要负法律责任。

es.e: The company had assets of $138 million and liabilities of $120.5 million.
es.c: 该公司有1.38亿美元资产和1.205亿美元的负债。

d: v 黑客攻击 to secretly find a way of getting information from someone else’s computer or changing information on it

es.e: He managed to hack the code.
es.c: 他设法窃取了密码。

d: v 重要；要紧 to be important, especially to be important to you, or to have an effect on what happens

es.e: If I have to stay late at work tonight, it won’t matter because we can go out another night.
es.c: 如果今晚我必须工作到很晚的话，那也没关系，我们可以改天晚上再出去。

es.e: Does it matter what I think?
es.c: 我怎么想重要吗？

es.e: Do you think it matters that the cups and saucers don’t match?
es.c: 你觉得茶杯与杯托不相配要紧吗？

d: adj 残酷的 very cruel and violent

es.e: a brutal man
es.c: 一个凶残的男人

d: n 生物多样性 the variety of plants and animals in a particular place

es.e: the biodiversity of the rainforest
es.c: 热带雨林中的生物多样性

d: adv 随后 after an event in the past

es.e: The book was subsequently translated into 15 languages.
es.c: 该书后来被译成 15 种语言。

es.e: Subsequently, the company filed for bankruptcy.
es.c: 随后，该公司申请了破产。

d: v 困扰 to annoy someone, especially by interrupting them when they are trying to do something

es.e: Danny, don’t bother Ellen while she’s reading.
es.c: 丹尼，埃伦看书的时候不要去打扰她 。

es.e: Would it bother you if I put on some music?
es.c: 我放点音乐会你介意吗？

d: adj 下意识的，潜意识的 subconscious feelings, desires etc are hidden in your mind and affect your behaviour, but you do not know that you have them

es.e: a subconscious fear of failure
es.c: 对失败下意识的恐惧

d: adj 基因的 relating to genes or genetics

es.e: genetic defects
es.c: 遗传性缺陷

es.e: each person’s genetic make-up
es.c: 每个人的遗传特征

es.e: genetic research
es.c: 基因研究

d: n 再次发生 an occasion when something that has happened before happens again

es.e: Police are out in force to prevent a recurrence of the violence.
es.c: 警察大规模地行动防止暴力的再次发生。

d: n 缺点 a fault or a lack of something that means that something or someone is not perfect

es.e: All the cars are tested for defects before they leave the factory.
es.c: 所有汽车在出厂前都经过品质检验。

es.e: a genetic defect
es.c: 遗传缺陷

d: n 零售商 a person or business that sells goods to customers in a shop

es.e: Furniture and carpet retailers are among those reporting the sharpest annual decline in sales.
es.c: 据称年销售额下滑幅度最大的零售商中包括家具和地毯零售商。

d: n 备忘录 a short official note to another person in the same company or organization

es.e: I sent him a memo reminding him about the meeting.
es.c: 我发给他一个通知，提醒他开会的事。

d: n 连锁店 a number of shops, hotels, cinemas etc owned or managed by the same company or person

es.e: ...a large supermarket chain.
es.c: …一家大型连锁超市。

d: n 执行官 a group of people who are in charge of an organization and make the rules

es.e: the union’s executive
es.c: 工会的领导层

d: n 芭蕾 a performance in which dancing and music tell a story without any speaking

es.e: We’re going to the ballet tomorrow evening.
es.c: 我们明天晚上要去看芭蕾舞演出。

d: n 入学人数 the number of people who have arranged to join a school, university, course etc

es.e: Student enrollments have more than doubled.
es.c: 学生注册人数翻了一倍多。

d: v 提出 to suggest something as a plan or course of action

es.e: the changes currently proposed by the local planning authorities
es.c: 目前由地方规划局提议的改革

es.e: the proposed budget cuts
es.c: 所提出的预算削减

d: adj 疯狂的 extremely worried and frightened about a situation, so that you cannot control your feelings

es.e: A bird had been locked in and was by now quite frantic.
es.c: 一只鸟被关了起来，到现在它都非常狂躁。

d: adv 据说 used when reporting something that people say is true, although it has not been proved

es.e: a sports car, allegedly stolen in Manchester
es.c: 据说是在曼彻斯特被偷的一辆跑车

d: v 操纵 to make someone think and behave exactly as you want them to, by skilfully deceiving or influencing them

es.e: He was one of those men who manipulated people.
es.c: 他是那种要摆布别人的人。

es.e: You have the constant feeling you are being manipulated.
es.c: 你总感觉自己是被人控制着的。

d: n 报道 when a subject or event is reported on television or radio, or in newspapers

es.e: live coverage of the match (= the match is broadcast at the same time that it is happening )
es.c: 这场比赛的现场直播

d: adj 新颖的 not like anything known before, and unusual or interesting

es.e: Protesters found a novel way of demonstrating against steeply rising oil prices.
es.c: 抗议者们找到一种新奇的示威方式来反对石油价格的飙升。

d: adj 之前的 A previous event or thing is one that happened or existed before the one that you are talking about

es.e: She has a teenage daughter from a previous marriage.
es.c: 她有个出自前一次婚姻的十几岁的女儿。

d: n 中立 the state of not supporting either side in an argument or war

es.e: Some of the nations declared neutrality.
es.c: 有的国家宣布中立。

d: v 强调 to emphasize the fact that something is important or true

es.e: The Labour Department figures underscore the shaky state of the economic recovery.
es.c: 劳工部的数字突出显示了经济复苏的不稳定。

d: adj 必不可少的 someone or something that is indispensable is so important or useful that it is impossible to manage without them

es.e: Mobile phones have become an indispensable part of our lives.
es.c: 移动电话已经成为我们生活中的必需品。

d: v 迷惑 to confuse someone or make them feel slightly anxious because they do not understand something

es.e: a question that continues to puzzle scientists
es.c: 一直困扰科学家的问题

es.e: He was puzzled by the reactions to his remark.
es.c: 他对自己的话引起的反应感到困惑不解。

es.e: What puzzles me is why his books are so popular.
es.c: 令我不解的是，他的书为什么如此受欢迎。

d: v 阐明，说明 to make the meaning of something clearer by giving examples

es.e: Let me give an example to illustrate the point.
es.c: 让我举个例子来说明这一点。

es.e: She illustrated her discussion with diagrams.
es.c: 她用图表来说明她的论述。

d: n 卫生环境，卫生设备 the protection of public health by removing and treating waste, dirty water etc

es.e: Overcrowding and poor sanitation are common problems in prisons.
es.c: 过度拥挤和卫生状况差是监狱里的普遍问题。

d: adj 防守的，防御的 used or intended to protect someone or something against attack

es.e: The prince drew up his forces in a strong defensive position.
es.c: 亲王将部队布成坚固的防御阵势。

es.e: The rockets are a purely defensive measure against nuclear attack.
es.c: 火箭弹纯粹是针对核攻击的防御性措施。

d: n 视角，观点 a way of thinking about something, especially one which is influenced by the type of person you are or by your experiences

es.e: His father’s death gave him a whole new perspective on life.
es.c: 父亲的死使他对生活有了全新的看法。

d: n 迁徙，移居 the movement of large numbers of people, birds or animals from one place to another

es.e: seasonal migration
es.c: 季节性迁徙

es.e: mass migrations
es.c: 大规模的迁移

d: v 漂浮 if something floats, it moves slowly through the air or stays up in the air

es.e: I looked up at the clouds floating in the sky.
es.c: 我仰望着天上的浮云。

es.e: Leaves floated gently down from the trees.
es.c: 叶子从树上轻轻飘落。

d: adj 灵活的 a person, plan etc that is flexible can change or be changed easily to suit any new situation

es.e: We can be flexible about your starting date.
es.c: 你具体从哪天开始，我们可以灵活一点。

es.e: The government needs a more flexible approach to education.
es.c: 政府在处理教育问题上需要更加灵活。

d: adj 有能力的 having the qualities or ability needed to do something

es.e: I don’t think he’s capable of murder.
es.c: 我认为他没有能力杀人。

es.e: The company isn’t capable of handling an order that large.
es.c: 那家公司没有能力应付那么大的订单。

es.e: I’m perfectly capable of looking after myself, thank you!
es.c: 我完全能够自己照顾自己，多谢了！

d: adj 实践的；实用的 relating to real situations and events rather than ideas, emotions etc

es.e: Candidates should have training and practical experience in basic electronics.
es.c: 应征者应该具备基础电子学方面的培训和实践经验。

es.e: the practical problems of old age
es.c: 老年的实际问题

es.e: They provide financial and practical help for disabled students.
es.c: 他们为残障学生提供经济上的援助以及实际的帮助。

d: n 领域，领土 land that is owned or controlled by a particular country, ruler, or military force

es.e: Hong Kong is a Chinese territory.
es.c: 香港是中国的领土。

d: n 城市化 Urbanization is the process of creating cities or towns in country areas

es.e: The urbanization level increased from 19.39 percent in 1980 to 28.85 percent in 1995.
Countries and regions all over the world face the challenge of urbanization.
es.c: 全球各地的国家和地区都面临城市化的挑战。

d: n 特权 a special advantage that is given only to one person or group of people

es.e: He had no special privileges and was treated just like every other prisoner.
es.c: 他不享受特权，待遇和任何其他犯人一样。

d: adj 即将来临的 a forthcoming event, meeting etc is one that has been planned to happen soon

es.e: the forthcoming elections
es.c: 即将到来的选举

es.e: Keep an eye on the noticeboards for forthcoming events .
es.c: 请注意布告牌上的活动预告。

d: v 拓宽，变宽 to become wider, or to make something wider

es.e: They’re widening the road.
es.c: 他们正在拓宽马路。

es.e: The river widens and splits.
es.c: 这条河有变宽的河段，也有分流的河段。

d: n 扣款 the process of taking away an amount from a total, or the amount that is taken away

es.c: 扣除税款等之后，你的月薪大约有700英镑。

d: adj 虚拟的；事实上的 made, done, seen etc on the Internet or on a computer, rather than in the real world

es.e: The website allows you to take a virtual tour of the art gallery.
es.c: 这个网站可让你对美术馆作一番虚拟参观。

es.e: constructing virtual worlds
es.c: 构筑虚拟世界

es.e: Argentina came to a virtual standstill while the game was being played.
es.c: 阿根廷在比赛进行期间全国上下事实上进入了停顿状态。

d: v 自夸 to talk too proudly about your abilities, achievements, or possessions

es.e: ‘I wouldn’t be afraid,’ she boasted.
es.c: “我才不怕呢。”她吹嘘道。

d: adj 货币的 relating to money, especially all the money in a particular country

es.e: the government’s tight monetary policy
es.c: 政府从紧的货币政策

es.e: objects of little monetary value
es.c: 不值钱的物件

d: adj 暗淡的；愚蠢的 fairly dark or not giving much light, so that you cannot see well

es.e: in the dim light of the early dawn
es.c: 在微弱的晨曦里

es.e: a dim glow
es.c: 昏暗的微光

es.e: You can be really dim sometimes!
es.c: 有时候你可真笨啊！

d: adj 理智的 reasonable, practical, and showing good judgment

es.e: She seems very sensible.
es.c: 她好像很明智。

es.e: sensible advice
es.c: 合理的建议

es.e: It’s sensible to keep a note of your passport number.
es.c: 把你的护照号码记下来是明智的。

d: n 婴儿 a baby or very young child

es.e: An infant’s skin is very sensitive.
es.c: 幼儿的皮肤非常敏感。

d: n 先例 an action or official decision that can be used to give support to later actions or decisions

es.e: a legal precedent
es.c: 判例

d: v 激活 to make an electrical system or chemical process start working

es.c: 烹调时的油烟可能会触发警报器。

es.e: The yeast’s growth is activated by sugar and warmth.
es.c: 糖分和温暖的环境会激发酵母菌的生长。

d: v 实现 to succeed in doing something, especially after trying very hard

es.e: We have accomplished all we set out to do.
es.c: 所有计划要做的事情，我们都已完成。

es.e: Mission accomplished (=  we have done what we intended to do  ) .
es.c: 大功告成。

d: n 移民 the process of entering another country in order to live there permanently

es.e: He called for a common European policy on immigration.
es.c: 他要求欧洲国家实施共同的移民政策。

d: v 赞同 to think that someone or something is good, right, or suitable

es.e: Catherine’s parents now approve of her marriage.
es.c: 凯瑟琳的父母现在认可她的婚姻了。

es.e: I don’t approve of cosmetic surgery.
es.c: 我不赞同整型手术。

d: n 悲观主义者 someone who always expects that bad things will happen

es.e: Don’t be such a pessimist!
es.c: 别这么悲观！

d: adj 挑衅的 behaving in an angry threatening way, as if you want to fight or attack someone

es.e: Jim’s voice became aggressive.
es.c: 吉姆的声音凶了起来。

es.e: Teachers apparently expect a certain amount of aggressive behaviour from boys.
es.c: 老师显然料到男孩子多少会有些好勇斗狠的行为。

d: adj 有毒的 containing poison, or caused by poisonous substances

es.e: fumes from a toxic waste dump
es.c: 有毒废料堆产生的毒气

es.e: a highly toxic pesticide
es.c: 毒性很强的杀虫剂

d: n 裁定 an official decision, especially one made by a court

es.e: Goodwin tried to have the court ruling overturned.
es.c: 古德温试图推翻法院的裁决。

d: v 延长 to deliberately make something such as a feeling or an activity last longer

es.e: I was trying to think of some way to prolong the conversation.
es.c: 我在想方设法拖长这次谈话。

d: n 紧张 a nervous worried feeling that makes it impossible for you to relax

es.e: The tension was becoming unbearable, and I wanted to scream.
es.c: 这种紧张变得难以忍受，我真想大声尖叫。

d: n 专家 someone who knows a lot about a particular subject, or is very skilled at it

es.e: an attorney who is a specialist in banking law
es.c: 一名专攻银行法的律师

d: v 遭遇 to experience something, especially problems or opposition

es.e: The doctor had encountered several similar cases in the past.
es.c: 那位医生过去曾碰到过好几个类似病例。

d: v 收割，收获 to cut and collect a crop of grain

es.e: The peasants leaned down to reap wheat.
es.c: 农民们俯身收割小麦。

d: n 研究所，学会，学院 an organization that has a particular purpose such as scientific or educational work, or the building where this organization is based

es.e: research institutes
es.c: 研究所

d: n 维修 the repairs, painting etc that are necessary to keep something in good condition

es.e: the cost of repairs and maintenance
es.c: 维修保养费

es.e: The theatres were closed on Saturday and Sunday for routine maintenance .
es.c: 戏院周六和周日关闭进行例行维护。

es.e: Engineers are carrying out essential maintenance work on the main line to Cambridge.
es.c: 机修工正在对通往剑桥的干线进行必要的养护。

d: n 传奇 an old, well-known story, often about brave people, adventures, or magical events

es.e: Local legend has it that (= says that ) the island was the original Garden of Eden.
es.c: 当地传说这个岛就是伊甸园的原型。

d: adj 无理由的，无根据的 not based on facts or reason

es.e: Fortunately my suspicions proved groundless .
es.c: 幸好我的猜疑后来证明是没有根据的。

es.e: Mr Kay’s lawyer said the accusations were groundless.
es.c: 凯先生的律师说这是无端的指控。

d: v 承担；着手，开始 to accept that you are responsible for a piece of work, and start to do it

es.e: Dr Johnson undertook the task of writing a comprehensive English dictionary.
es.c: 约翰逊博士担负起编写一本综合性英语词典的工作。

d: n 商品 a product that is bought and sold

es.e: agricultural commodities
es.c: 农业商品

es.e: Commodity prices fell sharply.
es.c: 商品价格急剧下跌。

d: v 刺激；激励 to encourage or help an activity to begin or develop further

es.e: the President’s plan to stimulate economic growth
es.c: 总统刺激经济增长的计划

es.e: Her interest in art was stimulated by her father.
es.c: 她对艺术的兴趣是她父亲激发的。

d: adj 困难的，粗暴的 difficult to do or deal with

es.e: It was a tough race.
es.c: 比赛打得很艰难。

es.e: She’s had a tough life.
es.c: 她的生活十分艰辛。

es.e: The company admitted that it had been a tough year.
es.c: 公司承认那是艰难的一年。

d: adj 重要的 extremely important and necessary for something to succeed or exist

es.e: The work she does is absolutely vital.
es.c: 她所做的工作至关重要。

es.e: It is vital to be honest with your children.
es.c: 对自己的孩子坦诚十分重要。

es.e: The tourist industry is of vital importance to the national economy.
es.c: 旅游业对国家的经济至关重要。

d: n 脚踝 the joint between your foot and your leg

es.e: slender ankles
es.c: 纤细的脚踝

d: adj 手术的 relating to or used for medical operations

es.e: surgical techniques
es.c: 外科技术

d: adj 奇怪的；特有的 strange, unfamiliar, or a little surprising

es.e: There was a peculiar smell in the kitchen.
es.c: 厨房里有一股怪味。

es.e: Something peculiar is going on.
es.c: 出了怪事。

es.e: It seems very peculiar that no one noticed Kay had gone.
es.c: 没有人注意到凯已经走了，这好像很奇怪。

d: v 褪色 to lose colour and brightness, or to make something do this

es.e: the fading evening light
es.c: 渐暗的暮色

es.e: a pair of faded jeans
es.c: 一条褪了色的牛仔裤

es.e: The sun had faded the curtains.
es.c: 太阳把窗帘晒得褪了色。

d: n 追求 when someone tries to get, achieve, or find something in a determined way

es.e: the pursuit of liberty and happiness
es.c: 对自由和幸福的追求

d: adj 复杂的，精密的；老于世故的 a sophisticated machine, system, method etc is very well designed and very advanced, and often works in a complicated way

es.e: sophisticated software
es.c: 很先进的软件

es.e: a highly sophisticated weapons system
es.c: 非常精密的武器系统

es.e: British voters have become much more sophisticated.
es.c: 英国的选民已经变得成熟多了。

d: n 游说者 A lobbyist is someone who tries actively to persuade a government or council that a particular law should be changed or that a particular thing should be done

es.e: Lobbyists for the tobacco industry have expressed concerns about the restriction of smoking in public places.
es.c: 烟草业的游说者们对在公共场所限制吸烟表示关切。

d: v 减少 to become smaller in size, importance, or value, or make something do this

es.e: Gradually her anxiety lessened.
es.c: 她的焦虑慢慢减轻了。

d: n 手枪 a small gun that you hold in one hand when you fire it

es.e: They were yesterday convicted of illegally using a handgun.
es.c: 他们昨天被判犯有非法使用手枪罪。

es.e: They began to tussle with each other for the handgun.
es.c: 他们互相扭打起来,抢夺那支手枪。

d: adj 有影响力的 having a lot of influence and therefore changing the way people think and behave

es.e: He had influential friends.
es.c: 他有一些有影响力的朋友。

es.e: a highly influential art magazine
es.c: 一本极有影响力的艺术杂志

d: adj 冷静的，超然的 not reacting to or becoming involved in something in an emotional way

es.e: Try to take a more detached view .
es.c: 尽量采取更为客观的态度。

d: n 传记 a book that tells what has happened in someone’s life, written by someone else

es.e: ...recent biographies of Stalin.
es.c: …近年的斯大林传记。

d: n 课程 the subjects that are taught by a school, college etc, or the things that are studied in a particular subject

es.e: Languages are an essential part of the school curriculum.
es.c: 语言是学校课程中必不可少的部分。

es.e: curriculum planning
es.c: 课程安排

d: n 利润 the difference between what it costs a business to buy or produce something and what they sell it for

es.e: Margins are low and many companies are struggling.
es.c: 利润很少，很多公司都在苦苦挣扎。

es.e: Within 10 years they had a gross profit margin of 50%.
es.c: 10年里他们的毛利率达到了50%。

d: adv 无畏地，大胆地 With a lack of fear.

es.e: He gazed fearlessly at the gunman.
es.c: 他毫不畏惧地注视着那枪手。

d: adv 随机地 Without method or conscious decision; indiscriminately.

es.e: The winning numbers are randomly selected by computer.
es.c: 中奖号码是由电脑随机选取的。

es.e: My phone seems to switch itself off randomly.
es.c: 我的手机好像随时自动关机。

d: n 歧视 the practice of treating one person or group differently from another in an unfair way

es.e: laws to prevent discrimination
es.c: 防止歧视的法律

d: n 刺激 something that helps a process to develop more quickly or more strongly

es.e: Tax cuts provided the stimulus which the slow economy needed.
es.c: 减税为不景气的经济带来了其所需的刺激。

d: n 能力 the ability to do something well

es.e: Typing is considered by most employers to be a basic competence.
es.c: 大多数雇主认为打字是一项基本技能。

d: v 溜走 to go somewhere secretly and quietly in order to avoid being seen or heard

es.e: Sometimes he would sneak out of his house late at night to be with me.
es.c: 有时候他会在深夜偷偷溜出他的家来陪伴我。

d: v 超过 to be more than a particular number or amount

es.e: Working hours must not exceed 42 hours a week.
es.c: 工作时间每周不得超过42小时。

es.e: His performance exceeded our expectations.
es.c: 他的表现出乎我们的预料。

d: n 气流；骚乱 irregular and violent movements of air or water that are caused by the wind

es.e: The plane encountered severe turbulence and winds of nearly two-hundred miles an hour.
es.c: 那架飞机遇到了强湍流和时速近二百英里的强风。

es.e: A period of political turbulence followed the civil war
es.c: 内战结束之后紧接着的是一段政治动荡时期。

d: v 解决 if you address a problem, you start trying to solve it

es.e: Our products address the needs of real users.
es.c: 我们的产品满足真正用户的需要。
